overview: The Army Ordnance Corps (AOC) under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India has released the short notice for AOC Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026.

A total of 2,615 vacancies are announced for various Group C posts including Tradesman Mate (1799), Fireman (508), Multi-Tasking Staff MTS (142), Junior Office Assistant JOA (104), and Material Assistant (50).
Candidates who have passed 10th, 12th, or Graduation degree from a recognized Board/University are eligible to apply depending on the specific post.

The online application process will commence on 24 August 2026 and the last date to submit online applications is 22 September 2026. The written examination is tentatively scheduled for November 2026.

overview: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB), Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu / ZamZam Complex Rambagh, Srinagar, has issued Advertisement Notification No. 08 of 2026 dated 04th August 2026 for direct recruitment to 518 UT, Divisional, and District Cadre posts across four key government departments: Health and Medical Education (421 posts), Higher Education (48 posts), Agriculture Production (46 posts), and Labour and Employment (3 posts).

The 518 vacancies span critical technical, paramedical, and executive designations including Junior Pharmacist (211 posts), Junior Staff Nurse (48 posts), Junior Laboratory Assistant (48 posts), Female Multipurpose Public Health Worker / FMPHW (46 posts), Horticulture Technician Grade-IV (45 posts), Junior Lab Technician (40 posts), Male Multipurpose Public Health Worker / MMPHW (19 posts), Junior Ophthalmic Technician (17 posts), Health Educator (15 posts), Sanitary Inspector (14 posts), Junior Theatre Technician (10 posts), Supervisor (3 posts), Senior Canning Attendant (1 post), and Para Medical Assistant (1 post).

Candidates must be bona fide Domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir possessing a valid Domicile Certificate issued on or before the cut-off date (09 October 2026). Educational criteria range from Matriculation, 10+2 with specialized technical training/diplomas (Basic Horticulture, Pharmacy, GNM, Lab Tech, Operation Theatre, Ophthalmic Tech, FMPHW/MMPHW) to Bachelor's Degree in Science. Pay scales range from Level-2 (₹19,900 – ₹63,200) up to Level-6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400).

Selection will be strictly determined by candidate merit in the Objective Type Written/OMR examination (English medium only, with 0.25 negative marking). There is no viva-voce or interview. Online application registration commenced on 10 September 2026 and closes on 09 October 2026 at www.jkssb.nic.in.

Step 2 - New Registration: Create a candidate profile using your active email address and mobile number.
Step 3 - Fill Application Form: Fill in your personal details, parentage, date of birth strictly as per Matriculation certificate, and J&K Domicile details.
Step 4 - Cadre / Item Preferences: Select the post Item Numbers (104 to 181) you are eligible for and rank your preferred cadres/districts carefully.
Step 5 - Upload Documents: Upload your live photograph, signature (10 KB - 20 KB), valid Category Certificate (max 100 KB PDF), and Qualification Certificates (max 100 KB PDF).

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of Munitions India Limited at https://munitionsindia.in/career or Department of Defence Production portal at https://ddpdoo.gov.in.

Step 3: Fill out the application form completely in BLOCK LETTERS using a blue/black ballpoint pen.

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has released official recruitment notification Rc No. 189 / Rect. / Rect-2 / 2026 dated 29th July 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 7,112 executive and uniformed posts across Telangana Police Department, Special Protection Force (TSPF), Telangana Fire & Disaster Response Department, and Prisons & Correctional Services Department.

The vacancy matrix includes 3,697 posts of Stipendiary Cadet Trainee (SCT) Police Constable (Civil), 1,052 posts of SCT Police Constable (AR), 24 posts of SCT Police Constable (SAR CPL) (Men), 1,380 posts of SCT Constable in Telangana Special Protection Force, 751 posts of Fire Fighter in Fire & Disaster Response Services, 196 posts of Warder (Male), and 12 posts of Warder (Female) in Prisons Department. All posts carry a revised pay scale of ₹24,280 – ₹72,850 plus admissible allowances.

Candidates who have passed Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent recognized by the State Government as on 29th July 2026 are eligible to apply (valid LMV driving license required for Fire Fighter). Under G.O. Ms No. 87 dated 18-05-2026, the Government of Telangana has granted a uniform 5-year upper age limit relaxation for direct recruitment to uniformed services, raising the basic general upper age ceiling from 22 to 27 years as on 1st July 2026, with further 5-year relaxations for SC, ST, BC, and EWS candidates (up to 32 years).

The selection scheme comprises Preliminary Written Test (PWT - 200 Questions, 200 Marks), Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET with 1600m/800m Run, Long Jump, and Shot Put), and Final Written Examination (FWE - 200/100 Marks) followed by Document Verification and Medical Fitness. 95% of district cadre posts are reserved for Local Candidates of Telangana under the Presidential Order 2018. Online application registration is live on www.tgprb.in through 16 September 2026.

howToApply: Step 1 - Registration: Visit the official TSLPRB website at www.tgprb.in. Register using your 10-digit mobile phone number as your User ID. Keep this number active throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Step 2 - Post Selection & Fee Payment: Select the post(s) you wish to apply for based on your eligibility. Calculate the fee (taking note of multi-post rebates for SC/ST or other categories). Pay the fee via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Step 3 - Part-I Application: Log in with your User ID. Click 'Apply Online' in the main menu to fill in Part-I Application Form with personal, academic, and category details.

Step 4 - Upload Photograph & Signature: Upload a single combined JPG file containing your recent passport-size photograph with your specimen signature below it. File size must be between 30 KB and 100 KB in JPG format.
Step 5 - Declaration & OTP Confirmation: Read all instructions, check 'I AGREE', and confirm your submission with the OTP received on your registered mobile number.

Step 6 - Part-II Application (After PWT): Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Written Test will log in again to fill Part-II Application, exercise post/cadre preferences (Post Codes 21 to 28), and upload scanned certificates.
Step 7 - Print Application Form: Download and print multiple copies of the submitted Part-I and Part-II Application Forms and fee payment receipt for document verification.

importantInstructions: 95% Local Reservation: In accordance with the Presidential Order 2018, 95% of vacancies in Police Districts/Commissionerates (Civil PC & AR PC), Revenue Districts (Fire Fighter), and Contiguous District Cadres (Warders) are strictly reserved for Local Candidates of Telangana.

Uniform +5 Years Age Hike: All candidates benefit from the Government of Telangana G.O. Ms No. 87 granting a uniform 5-year upper age extension for uniformed services, setting the unreserved age limit to 18–27 years as on 01 July 2026.

Multi-Post Common Physical Test: Candidates applying for more than one notification issued by TSLPRB within 3 months will undergo PMT/PET only once, and the scores/measurements will remain valid across all notifications.
Negative Marking in PWT: 20% negative marking applies to wrong answers in the Preliminary Written Test (0.20 marks deducted per wrong answer). Unattempted questions carry zero marks.
Single Application Profile: Candidates must not register multiple profiles. One mobile login ID is used across all concurrent TSLPRB notifications.
No Modification Post-Submission: Once Part-I or Part-II applications are submitted, no corrections or changes will be entertained. Ensure all entries are double-checked before generating OTP.
Compulsory Attendance: Candidates must appear for all scheduled tests (PWT, PMT, PET, FWE). Absence in any stage automatically results in outright disqualification.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 under Notification Rc No. 189?
faqs.answer: A total of 7,112 vacancies are notified: 3,697 SCT Police Constable (Civil), 1,052 SCT Police Constable (AR), 24 SCT Police Constable (SAR CPL) (Men), 1,380 SCT Constable in SPF, 751 Fire Fighter in Fire Services Department, 196 Warder (Male), and 12 Warder (Female) in Prisons Department.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification and age limit for TSLPRB Police Constable posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent recognized by the Telangana State Government as on 29 July 2026 (plus valid LMV driving license for Fire Fighter). The age limit is 18 to 27 years for General/OC candidates as on 01 July 2026 (including the uniform 5-year hike under G.O. Ms No. 87), relaxable up to 32 years for BC, SC, ST, and EWS candidates.

faqs.question: What are the physical standards (Height & PET) required for Men and Women?
faqs.answer: Minimum Height: Men must be at least 167.6 cms (160 cms for ST Agency candidates); Women must be at least 152.5 cms (150 cms for ST Agency candidates). In the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Men must complete the 1600 meters Run within 7 minutes 15 seconds, and Women must complete the 800 meters Run within 5 minutes 20 seconds. Qualifying Long Jump (Men: 4.00m, Women: 2.50m) and Shot Put (Men: 6.00m, Women: 4.00m) are also conducted.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for the Preliminary Written Test (PWT)?
faqs.answer: The Preliminary Written Test (PWT) consists of one paper of 200 objective multiple-choice questions for 200 marks with a duration of 3 hours (Intermediate Standard). It covers English, Arithmetic, General Science, History of India, Geography/Polity/Economy, Current Affairs, Reasoning, and Telangana State Topics. A negative marking penalty of 20% (0.20 marks) is deducted for each incorrect answer.

faqs.question: How does the final selection process work for Civil Constable vs AR Constable?
faqs.answer: For SCT Police Constable (Civil), Fire Fighter, and Warders, final selection is based 100% on the score obtained in the Final Written Examination (200 marks). For SCT Police Constable (AR), SAR CPL, and SPF Constable, final selection is based on 200 aggregate marks comprising 100 marks from the Final Written Examination and 100 normalized marks from the Physical Efficiency Test (1600m / 800m Run).

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online application registration on the official TSLPRB portal (www.tgprb.in) closes on 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit Part-I applications, upload photos with signatures, and pay the fee well before the deadline.

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has issued three major detailed recruitment notifications (Rc. Nos. 225, 279, and 234/Rect./2026) dated 29th July 2026 along with an official Press Note dated 10th September 2026 for direct recruitment to 325 executive and technical posts across the Telangana Police Department, Telangana Special Protection Force (TSPF), Telangana State Disaster Response & Fire Services Department, and Telangana Prisons & Correctional Services Department.

The advertised vacancies comprise 275 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 225/Rect./Rect-1/2026 (SCT Sub Inspector of Police Civil - 148, Reserve Sub Inspector AR - 14, Reserve Sub Inspector SAR CPL - 3, Reserve Sub Inspector TGSP - 12, SPF Sub Inspector - 44, Station Fire Officer - 39, Deputy Jailor Men - 14, Deputy Jailor Women - 1); 23 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 279/Rect./Rect-3/2026 for SCT Assistant Sub Inspector (Fingerprint Bureau); and 27 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 234/Rect./Rect-3/2026 for technical posts of SCT Police Constable Mechanics (7) and SCT Police Constable Driver (20).

Under Government Order GO Ms No. 129 dated 09-09-2026 (read with GO Ms No. 87 and GO Ms No. 122), the Government of Telangana has raised the upper age limit by an unprecedented total of 10 years for Constables and 5 years for SI/ASI cadre in uniformed services. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on the official portal (www.tgprb.in) until 5:00 PM on 16 September 2026.

overview: Airports Authority of India (AAI), Eastern Region, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata has issued an official notification No. 01/2026/ER/APPRENTICE for engagement of Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Apprentices for the training year 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

A total of 140 apprentice training seats are available: 35 for Graduate Apprentices, 35 for Diploma Apprentices, and 70 for ITI Apprentices across RHQ ER Kolkata and various airports in the Eastern Region (West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Sikkim, and Andaman & Nicobar Islands).
Candidates who have passed their Degree, Diploma, or ITI course in or after 2024 as on 30/06/2026 are eligible to apply.

Eligible candidates must register and apply online through the respective apprenticeship portals — National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal for Graduate/Diploma apprentices and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal for ITI apprentices.

overview: Local Self Government Department (स्वायत्त शासन विभाग), Rajasthan, Jaipur, has published Advertisement No. 01/2026 dated 27th July 2026 for the massive direct recruitment of 24,752 Safai Karmchari (सफाई कर्मचारी) posts under the Rajasthan Contractual Hiring to Civil Posts Rules, 2022.

A total of 24,752 vacancies are distributed across 183 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in Rajasthan, including Non-Scheduled Areas (24,277 posts) and Scheduled Areas (475 posts). Major ULB vacancies include Jaipur (4,811), Kota (1,357), Bikaner (1,084), Jodhpur (890), Udaipur (300), Sikar (480), Alwar (426), Bharatpur (450), and Dholpur (340).

Interested candidates who are native residents of Rajasthan and possess at least 01 year of continuous experience in cleaning work can submit their application online through Rajasthan SSO Portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) or LSG Portal from 15th August 2026 to 28th September 2026 (23:59 PM).

Selection will be carried out ULB-wise through a computer-generated Lottery Process (लॉटरी प्रक्रिया) among candidates holding valid 1-year experience certificates. Complete ULB vacancy list, age criteria, OTR fee details, and application steps are detailed below.

faqs.question: Where can I get the 1-year experience certificate?
faqs.answer: The 1-year sanitation work experience certificate must be issued by a competent authority as specified in the official recruitment notification. The experience should clearly show that you have worked in cleaning/sanitation-related duties for at least one year. Before applying, ensure your certificate matches the prescribed format and issuing authority mentioned in the notification. Submitting an invalid certificate may lead to rejection of your application.

faqs.question: Is a contractor (Thekedar) experience certificate valid?
faqs.answer: It depends on whether the contractor and the experience certificate satisfy the conditions laid down in the official notification. A certificate issued by a private contractor is not automatically valid. Candidates should carefully verify that the issuing authority and the certificate format are accepted by the recruitment rules before applying.

faqs.question: Is sanitation work experience from a government hospital valid?
faqs.answer: If you worked in sanitation or cleaning duties in a government hospital and your experience certificate has been issued by the competent authority in accordance with the recruitment rules, it may be considered valid. The final decision will be taken by the recruiting authority during document verification.

faqs.question: Is experience from a hotel, private office, or private company accepted?
faqs.answer: Experience from a hotel, private office, or private company may be accepted only if it fulfills all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification and is supported by a valid experience certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates should not assume that every private-sector certificate will be accepted.

faqs.question: Can an NCC or NSS certificate be used instead of the experience certificate?
faqs.answer: No. NCC, NSS, Scout, or similar certificates cannot replace the mandatory 1-year sanitation work experience certificate. These certificates may reflect extracurricular participation but do not count as professional sanitation work experience unless specifically stated in the official notification.

faqs.question: Will selection be through a lottery or a written exam?
faqs.answer: As per the official notification, there is no written examination for this recruitment. The selection process will be carried out according to the procedure prescribed by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates should rely only on the official notification and avoid rumours circulating on social media regarding the selection process.

faqs.question: Is the selection based on money or corruption?
faqs.answer: No candidate should believe or pay money to anyone claiming to guarantee selection. The recruitment process is conducted by the competent government authority. If anyone demands money in exchange for selection, candidates should immediately report the matter to the concerned authorities. Trust only official notifications and announcements.

faqs.question: Should there be a written examination?
faqs.answer: Many candidates believe that a written examination would make the recruitment process more transparent. However, the recruitment process is decided by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates must follow the selection method prescribed in the official notification.

faqs.question: Is the salary only ₹7,000?
faqs.answer: No. The amount of ₹7,000 generally refers to the fixed remuneration during the probation/training period, if applicable. After successful completion of the probation period, employees receive salary according to the applicable Pay Matrix and government rules, along with admissible allowances. Candidates should refer to the official notification for exact salary details.

faqs.question: Will Safai Karamcharis have to clean drains and perform sanitation work?
faqs.answer: Yes. The duties of a Safai Karamchari generally include sanitation work such as cleaning roads, public places, drains, waste collection, and maintaining cleanliness as assigned by the local body. The exact responsibilities depend on the department and place of posting.

faqs.question: Can PWD (Persons with Disabilities) candidates apply?
faqs.answer: PWD candidates can apply if vacancies are reserved for their disability category and they satisfy all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the notification. Candidates should carefully check the reservation details and the list of eligible benchmark disabilities before submitting their application.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates who satisfy the prescribed age limit, required sanitation work experience, and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification can apply. All applicants must also fulfill the document and category requirements specified by the recruiting authority.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates from other states can generally apply if they fulfill the eligibility conditions. However, they may not receive the benefit of reservation available to Rajasthan domicile candidates unless specifically provided in the notification.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Forest Guard Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: The Rajasthan Government has not yet officially announced the next Forest Guard recruitment. Candidates should regularly check the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB/RSMSSB) website and trusted job portals for the latest updates.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: As of now, no official notification has been released for the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI recruitment. Once the notification is published, details regarding vacancies, eligibility, syllabus, and the application process will be available on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment?
faqs.answer: The syllabus will be released only after the official notification is published. Generally, ITI recruitments include questions related to the candidate's trade, General Knowledge, Reasoning, Mathematics, and basic language skills, depending on the specific post. Candidates should wait for the official syllabus before starting focused preparation.

faqs.question: What is the package offered for SIDBI CCA posts?

overview: IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), a prestigious wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL) - a 100% Government of India Enterprise, has officially announced a rolling advertisement for the engagement of Individual Consultants (IC) on a full-time, contractual basis. With a mandate to deliver expert Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to Central & State Governments, Local Bodies, and Private Developers across India, IPL is building a robust database of highly qualified professionals. This rolling recruitment campaign operates continuously throughout the year, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications at any time to be considered for active project requirements in multiple sectors, including roads, highways, ports, power, water supply, renewable energy, tourism, and solid waste management.

This recruitment campaign offers a wide array of opportunities, spanning across 65 specialized consultant profiles. These encompass diverse areas such as Project & Contract Management, Procurement, Financial & Costing, IT & MIS, Digital Public Infrastructure, Legal Management, Corporate Communications, Tourism Development, Master Planning, PPP & Investment, and Environmental Affairs. The vacancies are not fixed to a static count, as hiring is on a rolling basis, meaning candidate requirements are fulfilled dynamically as mandates arise. The position grades range from Young Professionals to Senior Consultants (Grades I, II, and III) based on years of post-qualification experience. Selected professionals will be stationed at IPL's Head Office in New Delhi or branch offices and project sites across various States including Amaravati (AP), Chennai, Ahmedabad, the Northeast Region, and other locations on an "Anywhere in India" basis.

The eligibility criteria vary depending on the specific IC Code of interest. Educational requirements range from Graduate degrees in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech), Architecture, Planning, or Law (LLB/LLM) to Postgraduate degrees, MBA/PGDM, CA, CWA, or CFA from recognized premium national or international institutes. Remuneration is highly attractive and structured based on experience: Young Professionals receive a fixed pay of ₹70,000 per month; Grade I Consultants receive between ₹80,000 and ₹1,45,000; Grade II Consultants earn from ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000; and Senior Consultants (Grade III) are eligible for ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000 per month. The upper age limits are 32, 45, 50, and 62 years respectively.

Interested and qualified candidates can apply either by email or physical post. The application window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement, running on a rolling basis. Candidate selection is based entirely on an Interview process (either in Delhi or via online mode), which follows preliminary shortlisting of applicants matching the company's rigorous experience, suitability, and business criteria. There is no application fee for any category, making this a transparent, merit-based entry into one of India's leading government-backed infrastructure advisory firms.

education: General Educational Requirements (Varies by IC Code):
• Engineering Graduates (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/M.Tech/M.Plan) in relevant disciplines (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, IT, Computer Science, etc.).
• Postgraduates/Master's degrees in technology, engineering, finance, economics, business management (MBA/PGDM), planning, or equivalent from premier national/international institutes.
• Law Graduates (LLB or LLM) from recognized premier universities or national law schools.
• Professionally qualified Chartered Accountants (CA), Certified Cost Accountants (CWA), or Certified Financial Analysts (CFA) or Company Secretaries.
• Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management/Environmental Studies/ESG/Sustainability/Urban Design/Tourism from reputed institutes.
Experience Requirements (Grade-wise):
• Young Professional (Grade YP): Minimum 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Consultant Grade I (Grade I): Minimum 3 to 8 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Consultant Grade II (Grade II): Minimum 8 to 15 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Senior Consultant Grade III (Grade III): Minimum 15 years or more of relevant post-qualification experience.
General Conditions:
• All educational qualifications must be obtained from recognized universities, institutes, or boards approved by UGC, AICTE, or AIU (Government of India).
• Candidates with qualification acquired from a foreign (international) Institute/University must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Competent Authority.

salary.initialPay:
The monthly remuneration ranges are structured according to the Grade Codes:

• Young Professional (YP): Fixed at ₹70,000 per month (Requires 1 year experience)
• Consultant (Grade I): ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000 per month (Requires 3 - 8 years experience)
• Consultant (Grade II): ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000 per month (Requires 8 - 15 years experience)

faqs.question: What is the full form of IPL, and who is its parent organization?
faqs.answer: IPL stands for IIFCL Projects Limited, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a 100% Government of India Enterprise.

faqs.question: What is the main objective of IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL)?
faqs.answer: The main objective of IPL is to provide Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to various Central & State Governments, their affiliates, Local Bodies, and Private Developers, along with Capacity Building and Policy Advocacy services.

faqs.question: What is the nature of the engagement for the Individual Consultants (IC) positions?
faqs.answer: The engagement of Individual Consultants is on a full-time, contractual basis. Selected candidates are not allowed to take up any other appointment, engagement, or assignment during their contract period.

faqs.question: Where will the selected Individual Consultants be stationed?
faqs.answer: Selected consultants are expected to be stationed at IPL's Head Office in Delhi, and/or any of its branch offices, and/or across various States wherein IPL is currently working or intends to work under mandate.

faqs.question: What does rolling recruitment mean for this IPL notification?
faqs.answer: It means that applications are accepted and evaluated throughout the year on an as-and-when needed basis. IPL maintains an active database of applications, and candidates are selected from this pool whenever vacancies arise in specific areas of work.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the rolling applications window?
faqs.answer: The applications window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement.

faqs.question: What are the four grades of Individual Consultants, and what is their required experience?
faqs.answer: The grades are: (1) Young Professional with 1 year experience; (2) Consultant Grade I with 3 - 8 years experience; (3) Consultant Grade II with 8 - 15 years experience; and (4) Senior Consultant with 15 years or more experience.

faqs.question: What is the monthly remuneration for a Young Professional?
faqs.answer: A Young Professional is paid a fixed monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade I?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade I is ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade II?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade II is ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Senior Consultant (Grade III)?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Senior Consultant (Grade III) is ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000.

faqs.question: How is the final remuneration decided for selected candidates?
faqs.answer: The final remuneration within the corresponding grade band is decided based on the candidate's expectations, experience, and expertise. The decision of IPL is final and binding.

faqs.question: Is TA/DA provided for official tours during the engagement?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consultants are allowed to undertake official tours as required by their duties, and TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation are paid or reimbursed as per the company's policy.

faqs.question: What are the upper age limits for different grades of consultants?
faqs.answer: The upper age limits are: 32 years for Young Professional, 45 years for Consultant Grade I, 50 years for Consultant Grade II, and 62 years for Senior Consultant.

faqs.question: What are the essential academic qualifications required to apply?
faqs.answer: Qualifications depend on the specific IC Code but generally include regular Graduation/Post Graduation in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/M.Tech/M.Plan), Master's/Postgraduate degrees, MBA, CA, CWA, CFA, LLB, or LLM from recognized premier institutes.

faqs.question: Are candidates with degrees from foreign universities eligible?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided they can produce an equivalency certificate issued by a Competent Authority certifying that their foreign qualification is treated at par with qualifications offered by Indian Institutes/Universities.

faqs.question: What is the selection procedure for these consultant posts?
faqs.answer: The selection is done through a Personal Interview after preliminary screening and shortlisting of applications based on qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirements.

faqs.question: Where will the Personal Interviews be conducted, and is travel allowance provided?
faqs.answer: Shortlisted applicants will attend the interview in Delhi or online. No travel expense reimbursement (TA/DA) is paid for appearing in the interview.

faqs.question: What is the initial period of engagement for these contractual positions?
faqs.answer: Individual Consultants are engaged for an initial fixed period of two years.

faqs.question: Can the period of contract be extended, and what is the maximum limit?
faqs.answer: Yes, the contract can be extended by one year at a time up to a maximum tenure of 5 years (i.e. 2+1+1+1 years), contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on KPIs.

faqs.question: How can candidates apply for this recruitment, and are there different email addresses?
faqs.answer: Candidates must apply by email or post. There are separate email addresses: recruitment1@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 01 to 10; recruitment2@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 13 to 46; and recruitment3@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 11, 12, and 47 to 65.

faqs.question: What documents must be submitted along with the application?
faqs.answer: Submission requires: the filled application form in MS Word (Editable) and PDF formats (signed on each page), a signed Advertisement Notice, copies of educational certificates/marksheets, experience certificates, latest salary slips, and an equivalency certificate if applicable.

faqs.question: What is the subject line format required for sending the application by email?
faqs.answer: The Subject Line format must be: "Application_ IC CODE_ [Insert IC Code] _ [Name of Applicant]" (e.g. Application_ IC CODE_ 01 _ Rahul Sharma).

faqs.question: What is the physical postal address to submit applications?
faqs.answer: AGM- HR, IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), 3rd Floor, Tower - E, World Trade Centre (WTC), Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi - 110029.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for more than one Individual Consultant post?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the applicant must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code.

faqs.question: What happens if a candidate provides incorrect or falsified documents?
faqs.answer: Their candidature will stand cancelled immediately at any stage of selection, and if detected after appointment, their services are liable to be terminated without any compensation.

overview: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC), Lucknow has officially announced the detailed notification for the Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari (Livestock Extension Officer) Mains Examination 2026 (Advt No: 17-Exam/2026, पशुधन प्रसार अधिकारी मुख्य परीक्षा (प्रा०अ०प०-2025)/17). A total of 1,251 vacancies are being recruited under the Directorate of Animal Husbandry, Uttar Pradesh (पशुपालन निदेशालय, उत्तर प्रदेश), comprising 1,248 posts under General Recruitment and 3 backlog posts under Special Recruitment.

Candidates possessing a valid Score Card of Preliminary Eligibility Test 2025 (UPSSSC PET-2025) with positive (non-zero and non-negative) marks and holding an Intermediate (10+2) with Science (Biology group) along with a recognized 2-Year Diploma in Livestock Extension (पशुधन प्रसार डिप्लोमा) from a statutory Veterinary University or Veterinary College are eligible to apply. The age limit is 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026, with relaxation applicable for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and other categories of Uttar Pradesh.

All selected appointees will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-5 (₹29,200 to ₹92,300/-) with starting basic pay of ₹29,200/- per month plus standard allowances. Candidates will be shortlisted for the Mains Written Examination (100 Questions / 100 Marks / 2 Hours) in a 15-times ratio based on normalized PET-2025 scores. Online applications and fee submissions can be completed on the commission portal https://upsssc.gov.in from 09 September 2026 to 29 September 2026.

syllabus.section: Part-1: Subject Knowledge – Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science (65 Questions / 65 Marks)
topics: 1. Introduction to Animal Husbandry (पशुपालन का परिचय): Importance of animal husbandry in India, livestock development programs, basic concepts of animal husbandry (5 Marks)
2. Animal Anatomy and Physiology (पशु शरीर रचना एवं शरीर क्रिया विज्ञान): Digestive system, respiratory system, blood circulation, reproductive system of farm animals (5 Marks)
3. Animal Nutrition (पशु पोषण): Classification of nutrients, balanced diet, fodder and fodder production techniques (5 Marks)
4. Animal Breeding and Artificial Insemination (पशु प्रजनन एवं कृत्रिम गर्भाधान): Basic concepts of breeding, insemination techniques, breed improvement programs (5 Marks)
5. Dairy Management (डेयरी प्रबंधन): Selection of dairy animals, housing and management, milk production techniques, milk hygiene (5 Marks)
6. Poultry Farming (कुक्कुट पालन): Poultry breeds, housing and management, disease control and vaccination (5 Marks)
7. Animal Health and Disease Management (पशु स्वास्थ्य एवं रोग प्रबंधन): Common infectious and non-infectious diseases, vaccination schedules, first aid in livestock (5 Marks)
8. Livestock Extension Education (पशुधन प्रसार शिक्षा): Principles of extension education, communication skills, rural livestock development programs (5 Marks)
9. Rearing of Cattle, Buffalo, Sheep, Goat, and Pig (गाय, भैंस, भेड़, बकरी एवं सूकर पालन): Breeds, housing and management, production techniques, disease control and management (5 Marks)
10. Dairy and Animal Product Technology (डेयरी एवं पशु उत्पाद प्रौद्योगिकी): Milk processing, dairy product manufacturing, quality control and testing (5 Marks)
11. Livestock Economics and Entrepreneurship (पशुधन अर्थशास्त्र एवं उद्यमिता): Project formulation, cost-benefit analysis, self-employment schemes in animal husbandry (5 Marks)

12. Field Training and Practical Work (फील्ड ट्रेनिंग एवं प्रायोगिक कार्य): Veterinary hospital training, artificial insemination training, rural extension programs, field surveys and project work (5 Marks)
13. Practical Section (व्यावहारिक भाग): Animal identification and management, vaccination and administration of medicines, milk testing, fodder production, record keeping (5 Marks)

syllabus.section: Part-2: Computer and Information Technology Concepts & Innovations (15 Questions / 15 Marks)

Internet Protocol (IP) Address, IT Gadgets and their applications

Operation of Printer, Tablet, and Mobile devices
Important elements of Word Processing (MS-Word) and Excel Processing (MS-Excel)
Operating System, Social Networking, e-Governance

Technological Developments in IT: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data Processing, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Internet of Things (IoT), and India's achievements in this field

syllabus.section: Part-3: General Information Related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (20 Questions / 20 Marks)
topics: History, Culture, Art, Architecture, Festivals, and Folk Dance of Uttar Pradesh
Literature, Regional Languages, Heritage, Social Customs, and Tourism in Uttar Pradesh
Geographical Landscape, Environment, Natural Resources, Climate, Soil, Forests, Wildlife, Mines and Minerals of UP
Economy, Agriculture, Industry, Business, and Employment opportunities in Uttar Pradesh
Polity, Administration, Governance, and Revenue System of Uttar Pradesh
Current Events, Major State Schemes, and Achievements of Uttar Pradesh State in various fields

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official UPSSSC website at https://upsssc.gov.in.
Step 2: Under the 'Live Advertisement' segment, click on Advt No. 17-Exam/2026 (Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Mains Exam).
Step 3: Authenticate and log in through your UPSSSC PET-2025 Registration Number either via Personal Details (DoB, Gender, Category) or via registered Mobile/Email OTP.
Step 4: Your personal details, photo, and signature from PET-2025 will be automatically displayed. Review and verify them.

Step 5: Fill in the mandatory qualification details: Select 'Yes' for 10+2 Intermediate with Science (Biology) and enter the Board, Passing Year, Roll Number, and Marks. Select 'Yes' for 2-Year Livestock Extension Diploma and provide statutory institution details.
Step 6: Complete the self-declaration, enter the verification captcha code, and click 'Save and Submit'.

Step 7: Proceed to fee payment and pay the ₹25/- online processing fee via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI (or download SBI e-Challan for branch deposit). Take a printout of the final submitted Application Form and keep the Application Number secure.
documentsRequired: UPSSSC PET-2025 Registration Number and Score Card.
Class 10th (High School) Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate for Date of Birth verification.
Class 12th (Intermediate) Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate with Science (Biology group).
Two-Year Diploma in Livestock Extension (पशुधन प्रसार डिप्लोमा) Certificate from a recognized Veterinary University/College.
Uttar Pradesh Domicile Certificate (मूल निवास प्रमाण पत्र) for reservation/age relaxation benefits.
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer) in prescribed UP Government format.
Income & Asset Certificate for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) valid for FY 2026-27 (based on FY 2025-26 income, issued between 01 April 2026 and 29 September 2026).
Disability Certificate (PwBD) / Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate / DFF certificate (where applicable).
importantInstructions: Mandatory PET 2025 Score: Only candidates with a valid PET-2025 score card with non-zero positive normalized marks can apply. Candidates with zero or negative marks will not be considered.
Crucial Date for Eligibility: Candidates must hold the complete requisite qualifications (10+2 Biology + 2-Yr Livestock Diploma) on or before 29 September 2026.
EWS Certificate Requirement: EWS certificate must be issued between 01 April 2026 and 29 September 2026 based on the income of financial year 2025-26 and valid for financial year 2026-27.
Mains Shortlisting: Shortlisting for the Main Examination will be done in a 15-times ratio of advertised vacancies category-wise based on normalized PET-2025 score.
Correction Window: Permitted details in the application form can be edited until 06 October 2026. No corrections will be accepted after this date.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 1,251 vacancies are announced under the Directorate of Animal Husbandry, UP: 1,248 posts under General Recruitment (UR: 500, OBC: 345, SC: 254, ST: 25, EWS: 124) and 3 posts under Special Recruitment (OBC backlog: 3).

faqs.question: Is UPSSSC PET-2025 mandatory for applying to Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must possess a valid UPSSSC PET-2025 Score Card with positive (non-zero and non-negative) normalized marks. Shortlisting for the Main Written Examination will be done in a 15-times ratio of vacancies based on PET-2025 scores.

faqs.question: What is the required educational qualification for Livestock Extension Officer?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) with Science (Biology group) from the UP Board or equivalent, AND hold a recognized 2-Year Diploma Course in Livestock Extension (पशुधन प्रसार डिप्लोमा) from a statutory Veterinary University or Veterinary College established by law, along with Hindi knowledge.

faqs.question: What are the application start and closing dates for UPSSSC Advt 17-Exam/2026?
faqs.answer: Online registration, fee payment, and application submission start on 09 September 2026 and close on 29 September 2026. Fee reconciliation and form modification can be done up to 06 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for UPSSSC Livestock Extension Officer?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026 (born between 02 July 1986 and 01 July 2005). Upper age relaxation of 5 years is applicable to UP domicile SC, ST, OBC, state government employees, and outstanding sportspersons, and up to 15 years for PwBD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the salary and pay scale for Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari in UP?
faqs.answer: The post carries Pay Matrix Level-5 (₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-) with initial basic pay of ₹29,200/- per month plus DA, HRA, and medical allowances, resulting in an in-hand starting monthly salary of approx. ₹42,000/- to ₹48,000/-.

faqs.question: What is the application fee to submit the online form?
faqs.answer: At the initial application stage, an online processing fee of ₹25/- is payable by all candidates across all categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS). The Main Examination fee will be charged separately only from candidates shortlisted for the Main Exam.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern and negative marking for the Main Exam?
faqs.answer: The Main Examination consists of 100 objective MCQs for 100 Marks with a duration of 2 Hours (120 minutes). Sectional division: Part-1 Subject Knowledge (Animal Husbandry) - 65 marks; Part-2 Computer & IT - 15 marks; Part-3 UP General Knowledge - 20 marks. There is a negative marking of 0.25 (1/4th) mark for each incorrect answer.

Step 2: Create an Account by entering Name, Date of Birth, Father's Name, Mother's Name, active Mobile Number, and valid Email ID. Authenticate identity via DigiLocker or Aadhaar verification.
Step 3: Log in using your credentials, select Centralised Employment Notice CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS).
Step 4: Choose ONLY ONE RRB and indicate your priority order of Railway Zones and post categories.
Step 5: Fill in technical qualifications, select your Exam Group (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Allied), and enter academic details.
Step 6: Capture a live photograph directly via webcam or mobile front camera in dark non-white clothing against a plain light background.
Step 7: Upload scanned signature in running handwriting with black ink on white paper (JPG, 30-49 KB, min 140x60 pixels).
Step 8: SC/ST candidates requesting free sleeper class train travel must upload valid caste certificate in PDF format (under 400 KB).
Step 9: Pay the examination fee (₹500 for UR/OBC/EWS; ₹250 for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Women) online before 15 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in RRB JE Recruitment 2026 (CEN 04/2026)?

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for RRB Junior Engineer (JE) and DMS?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering or B.E./B.Tech degree in relevant disciplines (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, IT, CS, Automobile, Production, etc.). For DMS, a Diploma in Engineering in any discipline is acceptable.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for RRB Junior Engineer?
faqs.answer: Selected Junior Engineers and DMS are placed in Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with starting basic pay of ₹35,400/- per month plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and other Railway allowances (Gross approx ₹55,000 - ₹65,000/month).

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial cut-off date for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as on 01 January 2027. Relaxations apply: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for RRB JE Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The selection consists of four stages: 1st Stage CBT (Screening - 100 Marks), 2nd Stage CBT (Merit - 150 Marks with Virtual Calculator), Document Verification (1:1 ratio), and Medical Fitness Examination.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and is there a refund?

overview: Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS), Jaipur in compliance with order No. 1669 dated 11.08.2026 and No. 1675 dated 13.08.2026 of the Directorate of Medical Health & Family Welfare, Government of Rajasthan, has officially released the detailed Information Booklet for the Medical Officer Direct Recruitment Examination 2026 (MODRE-2026) for filling 600 Posts of Medical Officer (Medical).

The selection of candidates will be determined on the basis of an Offline OMR-based written examination comprising 100 multiple choice questions (MCQs) of 100 marks with NO negative marking, tentatively scheduled to be conducted on Sunday, 13 December 2026 at test centres in Jaipur. Appointees will be placed in Pay Level L-14 (₹15,600 - ₹39,100), receiving a fixed monthly pay of ₹39,300 plus ₹17,400 Medical Nursing Allowance (Total ₹56,700 per month) during the 1-year probation period.

Candidates possessing an MBBS degree recognized by NMC and registered with the Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC) on or before 13 December 2026 are eligible to apply. Online applications and fee deposition can be completed through the official portal (www.ruhsraj.org) between 14 September 2026 and 13 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 600 vacancies have been officially announced for Medical Officer (Medical) under MODRE-2026 by RUHS, Jaipur for the Directorate of Medical Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What is the date of the RUHS Medical Officer (MODRE-2026) Examination?
faqs.answer: The offline (OMR-based) MODRE-2026 examination is tentatively scheduled to be held on Sunday, 13 December 2026. Admit cards will be available for printing tentatively from 08 December 2026.

faqs.question: Is there any negative marking in the RUHS Medical Officer examination?
faqs.answer: No. As per the official Information Booklet, there is NO negative marking in the MODRE-2026 examination. The test consists of 100 multiple choice questions of 1 mark each (Total 100 marks) to be completed in 2 hours (120 minutes).

faqs.question: What is the medium and syllabus for MODRE-2026?
faqs.answer: The question paper will be in English Language only. The syllabus comprises all pre-clinical, para-clinical, and clinical subjects studied during the 4.5-year MBBS curriculum prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

faqs.question: What is the salary / pay scale for Medical Officers in Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: Appointed Medical Officers are placed in Pay Level L-14 (Pay Band ₹15,600 - ₹39,100). During the 1-year probation period, candidates will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of ₹39,300/- plus ₹17,400/- Medical Nursing Allowance, totaling ₹56,700/- per month.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 22 and 45 years of age as on 01 January 2027. Reserved category candidates of Rajasthan receive age relaxations: 5 years for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS males, 10 years for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS females, 5 years for General females, and up to 50 years for Ex-servicemen. Widows and divorced women have no upper age limit.

faqs.question: Is Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC) registration compulsory to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess a Permanent Registration Certificate from the Rajasthan Medical Council (RMC). The certificate issue date must be on or before the date of the offline examination (13 December 2026). If not available during application filling, candidates are permitted to upload it on 14-15 December 2026.

faqs.question: Can candidates currently undergoing medical internship apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates currently completing their compulsory rotating internship are eligible to apply, provided they upload a certificate/letter from the Principal & Controller of their medical college mentioning their expected internship completion date, and obtain their permanent RMC registration on or before 13 December 2026.

faqs.question: Can MBBS graduates from states outside Rajasthan apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates from other states are eligible to apply. However, they will be treated as Unreserved (General) candidates and will not be eligible for category, age relaxation, or fee concession benefits. They must also obtain permanent RMC registration on or before 13 December 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for RUHS Medical Officer MODRE-2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹5,000/- for General, BC/MBC (Creamy Layer), and all out-of-state candidates. Candidates belonging to SC and ST categories of Rajasthan state pay a concessional fee of ₹2,500/-. Fees must be deposited online and are non-refundable.

faqs.question: What is the rule regarding the number of children for Rajasthan government recruitment?
faqs.answer: Under Department of Personnel (DOP) notification dated 08.04.2003, any candidate having more than two children born on or after 01 June 2002 is disqualified from government appointment in Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What documents are required to be uploaded during online form filling?
faqs.answer: Candidates must upload a scanned photo (50-200 KB), live webcam photo, scanned signature, left and right thumb impressions, photo ID proof, MBBS degree and marksheet, UG attempt certificate, internship certificate, and RMC registration certificate.

faqs.question: What is the permitted dress code for the MODRE-2026 exam?
faqs.answer: Male candidates must wear half-sleeve shirt/t-shirt, trousers, and slippers/chappals. Female candidates must wear salwar suit or saree, half-sleeve/full-sleeve kurta, slippers/chappals, and simple rubber band. Shoes, socks above ankle, belts, watches, and jewelry are strictly prohibited.

faqs.question: Where will the examination centres for MODRE-2026 be located?
faqs.answer: The examination centres will be located preferably in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The exact venue and reporting time will be specified on the candidate's admit card.

faqs.question: What are the official helpline and contact details for RUHS MODRE-2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates facing issues may contact the Candidate Care Support Helpline at +91-8796266228 or email rajmomedical2026@ruhsraj.org. The official website is www.ruhsraj.org.

overview: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), East Coast Railway (ECoR), Bhubaneswar has published a centralized employment notification (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27 dated 21/08/2026) for the engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the training year 2026–2027.

A total of 1,599 training slots are notified across 25 designated technical and vocational trades in various workshops and divisions under the jurisdiction of East Coast Railway, including Carriage Repair Workshop (CRW) Mancheswar (250 slots), Khurda Road Division (773 slots), Sambalpur Division (262 slots), Rayagada Division (292 slots), and ECoR Zonal Headquarters at Bhubaneswar (22 slots).

Selection will be made purely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th with minimum 50% marks). There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or personal interview. Furthermore, candidates completing Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments holding National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will receive preference for up to 20% of vacancies in open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

Eligible Indian citizens with 10th Pass (min 50% aggregate) and ITI / NTC Certificate in the relevant trade (or 12th PCB for Medical Lab Technician) can submit their online application through the official RRC Bhubaneswar portal (www.rrcbbs.org.in) starting from 26 August 2026 (17:00 hrs) until the closing deadline on 15 September 2026 (17:00 hrs).

selectionProcess.description: The merit list for each unit/division will be prepared solely on the basis of aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th), subject to a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.

Marks in all subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects) will be reckoned for percentage calculation — 'best of five' calculation is strictly prohibited. CGPA must be converted to equivalent percentage.

In case two or more applicants secure identical marks, preference will be given to the older candidate by date of birth. If DOB is also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.
There will be NO written test, computer-based examination, or viva voce. Selection is 100% merit-based.
Candidates shortlisted based on trade-wise and community-wise merit will be called for Document Verification at Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar.
Final engagement is subject to verification of original certificates and submission of Medical Fitness Certificate in Annexure 'F' issued by a Gazetted Doctor (Assistant Surgeon or above).

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the official nodal website of Railway Recruitment Cell, Bhubaneswar: www.rrcbbs.org.in.
Step 2: Locate and click on 'Engagement of Act Apprentices over ECoR for the year 2026–27' (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27).
Step 3: Register by providing your active email ID, mobile number, and 12-digit Aadhaar Number (or 28-digit Enrolment ID).
Step 4: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (all subjects aggregate marks), ITI trade details, and choose ONE Division/Workshop carefully.
Step 5: Upload scanned photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI) and signature (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI).
Step 6: Upload scanned copies of Class 10th marksheet/certificate, ITI marksheet & NTC/provisional certificate, Caste/EWS/Disability certificate (if applicable).
Step 7: Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹100/- online (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted).
Step 8: Review all submitted information carefully, submit the application before 15/09/2026 (17:00 hrs), and download/print the finalized application form.

faqs.question: What is the official notification number and date for ECoR Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification number is ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27, dated 21/08/2026.

faqs.question: What are the opening and closing dates for online application?
faqs.answer: The online application opens on 26 August 2026 at 17:00 hrs and closes on 15 September 2026 at 17:00 hrs.

faqs.question: Is there any written examination or interview for selection?
faqs.answer: No. There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or interview. Selection is made solely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks in Matriculation (Class 10th) with a minimum of 50% marks.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for ECoR Act Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10th) under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized board, plus possess an ITI Certificate (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant trade affiliated to NCVT/SCVT. For Medical Lab Tech (Pathology), 12th Pass with PCB (min 50% marks in both 10th & 12th) is required.

faqs.question: Are Diploma or Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) degree holders eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: No. Engineering graduates and Diploma holders are not eligible to apply under this notification as they fall under a separate apprenticeship scheme.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for ECoR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Applicants must be between 15 to 24 years of age as on 15 September 2026 (closing date). Upper age relaxation applies for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

faqs.question: How much is the application fee and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General/OBC/EWS male candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and Women applicants of all categories are 100% exempted from paying any fee (₹0).

faqs.question: How is the 10th class percentage calculated for the merit list?
faqs.answer: The percentage is calculated based on the total marks of ALL subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects). The 'best of five' calculation is strictly not permitted.

faqs.question: What benefit do Railway Apprentices (CCAA) receive in future Railway jobs?
faqs.answer: Candidates who successfully complete Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments and hold National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will be given preference for up to 20% of vacancies in direct open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one Division or Workshop under ECoR?
faqs.answer: No. Applicants are permitted to choose only ONE Division or Workshop. The choice once submitted cannot be changed.

faqs.question: Can a candidate possessing ITI in multiple trades apply separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applicants possessing ITI qualifications in more than one trade may apply separately for each relevant trade.

faqs.question: Where will the Document Verification (DV) be conducted?
faqs.answer: Document Verification for all shortlisted candidates across all units will take place centrally at the Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faqs.question: What are the photo and signature upload specifications?
faqs.answer: Photograph: Recent colour photo, 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI in JPG/JPEG format (taken within 3 months, clear front view without cap/goggles). Signature: 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI.

faqs.question: What is the date of issue requirement for OBC-NCL certificate?
faqs.answer: OBC-NCL certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026 in the prescribed Central Government format (Annexure 'C') along with a Self-Declaration form (Annexure 'D').

faqs.question: Will hostel accommodation be provided during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: No. No hostel accommodation is provided during training. Apprentices must make their own boarding and lodging arrangements.

faqs.question: Does completion of apprenticeship guarantee permanent employment in Railways?
faqs.answer: No. As per the Apprentices Act, 1961, it is not obligatory for Railways to offer permanent employment upon training completion. However, CCAA holders get up to 20% quota/preference in Railway Level-1 direct recruitments.

faqs.question: What is the stipend paid during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices will be paid a monthly stipend at the prescribed rates as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Railway Board directives issued from time to time.

overview: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) on behalf of Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Limited (BSFC), under the Department of Food & Consumer Protection, Government of Bihar, has officially released detailed recruitment advertisement No. BCECEB(BSFC)-2026/01 dated 24.08.2026 for filling up 259 regular vacancies across 5 major non-gazetted and executive cadres on regular basis.

The 259 total vacancies are allocated as follows: 81 posts of Assistant Manager (सहायक प्रबंधक) in Pay Level-7 (GP ₹4600), 06 posts of Assistant Accounts Officer (सहायक लेखा पदाधिकारी) in Pay Level-7 (GP ₹4600), 11 posts of Accountant (लेखापाल) in Pay Level-4 (GP ₹2400), 38 posts of Quality Controller (गुणवत्ता नियंत्रक) in Pay Level-4 (GP ₹2400), and 123 posts of Lower Division Clerk / Lower Grade Clerk (निम्नवर्गीय लिपिक - LDC) in Pay Level-2 (GP ₹1900).

Online registration and application submission begins on 25 August 2026 and closes on 24 September 2026 (11:59 PM). The Computer Based Test (CBT) will comprise 100 objective multiple-choice questions (100 marks) of 2 hours and 15 minutes duration with no negative marking. For the LDC post, a computer typing proficiency test (Hindi @ 30 wpm / English @ 35 wpm) is qualifying in nature.

topics: General Awareness: Indian History, Bihar History & Culture, Geography, Indian Constitution & Polity, Five Year Plans, Economic Scenarios, Current Events (National & International).

reservation.title: State Reservation Policy & Horizontal Quotas
detailsList: Vertical Reservation: Scheduled Caste (SC): 16%, Scheduled Tribe (ST): 1%, Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 18%, Backward Class (BC): 12%, Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): 10%, Backward Classes Women (WBC): 3%.
Horizontal Reservation for Women (35%): 35% horizontal reservation is provided across all categories for women of Bihar domicile.

Horizontal Reservation for Divyangjan (4% / 8 Posts): VI (Visual Impairment): 2 Posts, DD (Deaf & Hard of Hearing): 1 Post, OH (Locomotor Disability): 3 Posts, MM (Mental / Multiple Disabilities): 2 Posts.
Horizontal Reservation for Freedom Fighters (2% / 5 Posts): 2% reservation for grandchildren (पोता/पोती/नाती/नातिनी) of freedom fighters of Bihar.
Domicile Requirement: All reservation benefits (age relaxation, fee concession, vertical & horizontal seat reservation) are admissible strictly to permanent residents of Bihar.

howToApply: Step 1 (Registration): Visit the official BCECEB portal at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and click on 'Online Portal of Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd.'.
Step 2: Click on 'Apply Online' -> 'Click here for Registration'. Enter your basic details, active email ID, and mobile number to receive your Registration Number and Password.
Step 3 (Basic Details): Log in using Registration Number and Password, enter personal information, category, domicile, and change your password upon initial login.
Step 4 (Educational Qualification Details): Fill in complete academic details from Matriculation, 10+2, Graduation, Post Graduation / MBA / B.Com / B.Sc / B.Tech / CA details.
Step 5 (Experience Details): Enter relevant work experience details (mandatory for AAO non-CA route, optional for others) and click Save & Next.
Step 6 (Upload Photo & Signature): Upload high-contrast passport-size colored photograph and clear scanned signatures in both Hindi and English.
Step 7 (Preview & Verification): Preview the complete application form, verify all entries, check the declaration box, and click 'Final Submit'.

Step 8 (Fee Payment & Download Receipt): Pay the application fee (₹1,200/- for UR/EWS/BC/EBC or ₹600/- for SC/ST/PwBD) via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking, then download and print the final Application Form (Part-A & Part-B) and Transaction Receipt.

faqs.answer: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) is conducting the recruitment on behalf of Bihar State Food & Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd. (BSFC) under the Food & Consumer Protection Department, Govt of Bihar (Advt No. BCECEB(BSFC)-2026/01).

karnataka-examinations-authori-residenti.title: KEA Karnataka Residential School Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 140 Posts (Social Welfare Dept, RPC & KK Cadres)
overview: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), Bengaluru, on behalf of the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka (ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆ), has officially published two recruitment notifications (No. ED/KEA/38/RECT/2026(RPC) & No. ED/KEA/39/RECT/2026(KK) dated 20.08.2026) for the direct recruitment of 140 Residential School Teachers (ವಸತಿ ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು - Vasathi Shala Shikshakaru) through a competitive examination.

The total 140 vacancies are bifurcated into: Residual Post Cadre / RPC (ಉಳಿಕೆ ಮೂಲ ವೃಂದ - 100 Posts under Advt No. 38) and Kalyana Karnataka Cadre / KK (ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ವೃಂದ - 40 Posts under Advt No. 39 under Article 371-J).

Candidates who have passed PUC (10+2 / Class 12) with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/Cat-1/PwD) and hold a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed), 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed), or 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education), along with a valid qualification in the Teacher Eligibility Test (KARTET / CTET), are eligible to apply.

Selected candidates will be appointed on a 2-year probation period in residential schools across Karnataka, drawing a monthly salary under the 2024 Revised Karnataka State Pay Scale of ₹41,300 - ₹81,800 plus Dearness Allowance, HRA, and NPS pension benefits. Online applications are accepted on the official KEA portal (https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/) from 21 August 2026 to 18 September 2026 (Fee payment till 19 September 2026).

overview: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a listed premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India, has officially released notification CSL/P&A/HRM/HRM GENERAL/PM_INTERNSHIP_SCHEME/2024/45 dated 26 August 2026 for the engagement of 227 interns under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS).

The internship training is offered for a duration of Nine (9) months across multiple educational streams: ITI Trades (92 seats), SSLC Trades (80 seats), HSE/ITI (27 seats), Diploma in Engineering/Allied disciplines (16 seats), General Graduation (11 seats), and Post Graduation (1 seat). Selected interns receive monthly stipends ranging from Rs. 11,000/- to Rs. 13,000/- per month, inclusive of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India.

Eligible candidates aged 18 to 25 years who meet the prescribed educational qualifications and family income eligibility criteria must submit their applications online through the official PMIS Portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in).

faqs.question: What is the official advertisement number for Cochin Shipyard PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification advertisement number is CSL/P&A/HRM/HRM GENERAL/PM_INTERNSHIP_SCHEME/2024/45 dated 26 August 2026.

faqs.question: How many total internship seats are available in Cochin Shipyard under PMIS 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 227 internship seats are available: ITI Trades (92 seats), SSLC (80 seats), HSE/ITI (27 seats), Diploma (16 seats), General Graduation (11 seats), and Post Graduation (1 seat).

faqs.question: What is the duration of the internship training in CSL?
faqs.answer: The internship training is for a fixed period of Nine (9) months under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS).

faqs.question: What is the monthly stipend offered to CSL PMIS interns?
faqs.answer: Interns in SSLC, ITI, and HSE disciplines receive Rs. 11,000/- per month, while Diploma, Graduate, and PG interns receive Rs. 13,000/- per month, inclusive of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Cochin Shipyard PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age to apply under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: There is NO application fee (NIL). Applying through the PMIS portal is completely free for all candidates.

faqs.question: How will candidates be selected for the CSL PMIS internship?
faqs.answer: Selection is strictly based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification. In case of a tie in marks, relative merit is decided based on seniority in age, followed by certificate verification and medical fitness.

faqs.question: Who is NOT eligible (Ineligibility Criteria) to apply for PMIS at CSL?
faqs.answer: Graduates from IITs/IIMs/NLUs/IISER/IIITs/IISc; holders of CA/CMA/CS/MBBS/BDS/MD/MS/MBA/MPhil/PhD; candidates who have already completed NATS/NAPS apprenticeship; candidates currently in govt training; candidates whose family annual income exceeds Rs. 12 Lakhs; or candidates whose family member is a permanent/regular govt employee are NOT eligible.

faqs.question: Can B.Tech / Engineering Degree holders apply for the Graduate Clerical intern posts?
faqs.answer: No, the Graduate Clerical intern seats are open for non-B.Tech and non-performing arts graduates (e.g. BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, BCA).

faqs.question: Are candidates with ITI NTC certificates eligible for ITI trades?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates who have passed 10th standard and possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the relevant ITI trade (Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Draughtsman, Diesel Mech, etc.) are eligible.

faqs.question: Does completion of this internship guarantee employment in Cochin Shipyard?
faqs.answer: No, upon completion of the 9-month internship training, CSL has no obligation to offer regular employment, nor can interns claim any right for appointment on the grounds of internship completion.

faqs.question: Is boarding or lodging provided by Cochin Shipyard during the internship?
faqs.answer: No, boarding and lodging are not provided by CSL during the internship period. Interns must make their own living arrangements in Kochi.

faqs.question: Where and how do I submit the online application for CSL PMIS Internship?
faqs.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official Prime Minister Internship Scheme Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ and select Cochin Shipyard Limited opportunities.

faqs.question: Will offer letters be sent by post?
faqs.answer: No, offers of internship training will NOT be sent by post. Shortlisted candidates will receive notifications and offer letters directly through the PMIS portal.

faqs.question: What is the official contact email for queries related to CSL Apprenticeship / PMIS?
faqs.answer: For queries regarding CSL internship, candidates can email apprenticeship@cochinshipyard.in. For technical issues with the PMIS portal, use the Support section on pminternship.mca.gov.in.

faqs.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from Cochin Shipyard website: https://cochinshipyard.in/uploads/career/cd5346e2da18d06f6905eb292e8ce195.pdf.

selectionProcess: Written Test / Computer Based Test (CBT): Conducted across 37 test cities in India. Total duration: 120 Minutes, Total Marks: 100.
CBT Part A (Discipline Specific): 80 MCQs (80 Marks, 90 Minutes). +1 mark for correct answer, -1/3 negative marking for incorrect answer.
CBT Part B (Aptitude/Ability Tests): Up to 15 MCQs (20 Marks, 30 Minutes) covering Numerical, Logical, Diagrammatic, Abstract & Deductive Reasoning. No negative marking.
CBT Qualifying Cutoff: 50% each in Part A & Part B for Unreserved; 40% each in Part A & Part B for PwBD reserved vacancies.

Interview Shortlisting: Candidates shortlisted in 1:5 ratio (minimum 10 candidates per post). Total Interview Marks: 100 (Technical Knowledge: 40, General Awareness in Specialisation: 20, Presentation/Communication: 20, Comprehension: 10, Academic Achievements: 10).
Interview Qualifying Cutoff: 50% for Unreserved, 40% for PwBD. Aggregate qualifying: 60% for UR, 50% for PwBD.
Final Merit Panel: Prepared with 50% weightage to Written Test marks and 50% weightage to Interview marks. Tie-breakers: Written Test marks > Qualifying degree marks > Older age.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in ISRO ICRB Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 175 vacancies of Scientist/Engineer 'SC' (Group 'A') are notified: 99 in Electronics, 52 in Mechanical, and 21 in Computer Science across ISRO Centres, plus 3 vacancies at Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), Ahmedabad.

faqs.question: What is the official Advertisement Number for this recruitment drive?
faqs.answer: The official notification is issued under Advertisement Number ISRO:ICRB:03(EMC):2026 dated 27-08-2026.

faqs.question: What is the basic pay scale for ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC'?
faqs.answer: Appointees are placed in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100/- per month, plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and comprehensive Central Govt benefits.

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a first-class BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree in Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, or Computer Science Engineering with a minimum of 65% aggregate marks or CGPA 6.84/10.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for ISRO ICRB Scientist/Engineer 2026?
faqs.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 16-09-2026. Age relaxations apply for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and Central Government employees as per Govt norms.

faqs.question: What is the application fee structure and how does the refund work?
faqs.answer: All candidates initially pay ₹750/- online. Upon appearing in the Written Test/CBT, fee-exempted candidates (Women, SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) receive a full ₹750/- refund, while other candidates receive a ₹500/- refund (after ₹250 application fee deduction).

faqs.question: What is the pattern of the ISRO Scientist/Engineer Written Test (CBT)?
faqs.answer: The CBT is 120 minutes long for 100 marks: Part A has 80 discipline-specific MCQs (80 marks, 90 mins, +1 / -1/3 marking), and Part B has up to 15 aptitude MCQs (20 marks, 30 mins, no negative marking).

faqs.question: What are the qualifying marks in the Written Test/CBT?
faqs.answer: Unreserved candidates must score at least 50% in Part A and 50% in Part B. Reserved PwBD candidates must score at least 40% in each part.

faqs.question: How many candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview?
faqs.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:5 based on CBT performance, with an aggregate minimum of 10 candidates per category/post.

faqs.question: What are the attributes assessed in the Interview and their weightages?
faqs.answer: Interview is for 100 marks: Technical Academic Knowledge (40 marks), General Awareness in Specialisation (20 marks), Presentation/Communication (20 marks), Comprehension (10 marks), and Academic Achievements (10 marks).

faqs.question: How is the final selection panel prepared by ISRO ICRB?
faqs.answer: The final merit panel is generated giving 50% weightage to Written Test marks and 50% weightage to Interview marks, subject to securing minimum qualifying aggregate (60% for UR, 50% for PwBD).

faqs.question: In how many cities will the Written Test/CBT be conducted?
faqs.answer: The CBT will be conducted across 37 venues in India including Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Thiruvananthapuram, Pune, Jaipur, Lucknow, Patna, and Guwahati.

faqs.question: What are the photo and signature upload specifications?
faqs.answer: Photo: 100-200 KB in .jpg/.jpeg (200x230 px, light/white background, no caps/dark glasses). Signature: 80-150 KB in .jpg/.jpeg (140x60 px, black ink pen on white paper, not in all caps).

faqs.question: Are final year engineering students eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess the final degree certificate or consolidated marksheet with the prescribed percentage/CGPA on or before the closing date (16-09-2026).

faqs.question: Is Travelling Allowance (TA) provided for attending tests?
faqs.answer: No TA is paid for the Written Test. Candidates shortlisted and appearing for the Interview are reimbursed to-and-fro second-class train fare by the shortest route.

faqs.question: Are candidates currently working in Central/State Government required to submit an NOC?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates serving in Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply with prior intimation and submit an official No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview.

faqs.question: When will the answer key for the CBT be released?
faqs.answer: The provisional answer keys will be published on the ISRO website within 3 working days of the exam, with a 5-day window to submit online objections.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for ISRO Scientist/Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to register online and pay the application fee is 16-09-2026 up to 11:55 PM.

faqs.question: Can candidates apply for more than one post code?
faqs.answer: Yes, eligible candidates can apply for multiple posts, but separate applications and fees must be submitted for each post code.

faqs.answer: All updates, admit cards, and results will be published on the official ISRO portal: www.isro.gov.in.
