Log in with registered username (Email ID) and password.
Click on Apprenticeship Opportunities from the top navigation bar.
In the search box Search by Establishment Name, type: Nuclear Fuel Complex-E11153600013.
The list of all open trade opportunities at NFC Hyderabad will appear.
Click on the Apply button against the specific ITI trade you have passed and wish to apply for.
Ensure all required documents (10th marksheet, ITI certificate, Aadhaar card, photograph) are uploaded to your NAPS profile before 16-09-2026.
Keep a printout of the application form and keep your registered email active for walk-in interview call letters.
documentsRequired: Printout (Hard Copy) of the NAPS Online Application Form.
Class 10th / SSC Board Exam Marksheet and Passing Certificate.
ITI All Semester Marksheets and National Trade Certificate (NTC) issued by NCVT / SCVT.
Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates in prescribed format.
Disability Certificate issued by competent medical authority (if applicable).
Aadhaar Card (with updated address).
Police Verification Certificate from SP / Commissioner of Police of the respective district.
Medical Fitness Certificate from Assistant Civil Surgeon / Civil Surgeon at the time of joining.
Medical / Health Insurance policy copy from a reputed insurance institution.
Saving Bank Account Passbook copy showing Account Number and IFSC Code.
Two recent passport size color photographs.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for NFC Hyderabad ITI Trade Apprentices?
faqs.answer: A total of 432 tentative vacancies are announced across 15 engineering and technical trades under Nuclear Fuel Complex (NFC) Hyderabad for 2026-27.

faqs.question: What is the official Advertisement Number for NFC ITI Apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: The advertisement is issued under Advertisement No. NFC/R-III/1/08/2026 dated August 27, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the NAPS Establishment Name and Code for NFC Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Candidates must search for Nuclear Fuel Complex-E11153600013 on the NAPS portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

faqs.question: What is the monthly stipend offered during the apprenticeship at NFC?
faqs.answer: Apprentices in Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Machinist, AOCP, Instrument Mech, Electronics, Lab Asst, MMV, and Draughtsman Mech receive Rs 11,040/- per month. Apprentices in COPA, Diesel Mech, Carpenter, Plumber, and Welder receive Rs 10,560/- per month.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for NFC ITI Apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th standard (SSC/Matriculation) and hold an ITI Pass certificate in the respective trade from an NCVT/SCVT recognized institute.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for NFC Hyderabad Trade Apprentice recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must not be less than 18 years of age as on 16-09-2026. The maximum age limit is 25 years for General, 28 years for OBC, and 30 years for SC/ST candidates.

faqs.question: Are candidates with post-graduation eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: No, as per official notification terms, candidates with post-graduation qualifications are not eligible to apply.

faqs.question: Can candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training apply?
faqs.answer: No, candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act 1961 in any Govt/PSU/Private firm are not eligible.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for NFC Trade Apprentices 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Candidates who apply on the NAPS portal will be evaluated by Selection Committees and shortlisted candidates will be called for a Walk-in-Interview at NFC Hyderabad.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: The apprenticeship training duration is strictly one (1) year at Nuclear Fuel Complex, Hyderabad.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee to apply for NFC ITI Apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: No, application through the NAPS portal is completely free for all categories of candidates.

faqs.question: How will candidates be informed about the Walk-in-Interview schedule?
faqs.answer: All interview call letters and intimation will be communicated strictly via e-mail to the registered email address.

faqs.question: Is hostel or quarters accommodation provided by NFC during training?
faqs.answer: Accommodation is provided to trade apprentices by NFC subject to the availability of quarters.

faqs.question: Is Police Verification mandatory for selected candidates?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must obtain a Police Verification Certificate from the Superintendent of Police / Commissioner of Police matching their Aadhaar address prior to reporting for joining.

faqs.question: Will NFC guarantee permanent employment after completion of training?
faqs.answer: No, apprenticeship training does not confer any right or guarantee of employment in Nuclear Fuel Complex or Department of Atomic Energy.

faqs.question: What certificate is awarded upon completion of training?
faqs.answer: Upon passing the Trade Test conducted by the Controller of Examination (DGT), apprentices are awarded the prestigious National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).

faqs.question: What is the last date to submit online applications on the NAPS portal?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply on the NAPS portal is 16 September 2026.

faqs.question: Where will the selected apprentices be posted for training?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices will undergo training at Nuclear Fuel Complex, ECIL Post, Hyderabad - 500062, Telangana State.

faqs.question: What documents must be carried for physical verification during the interview/joining?
faqs.answer: Carry printout of NAPS application form, 10th marksheet, ITI marksheet & NTC, caste/disability certificates, Aadhaar card, Police verification, Bank passbook, Medical certificate, and 2 passport photos.

faqs.question: Who can be contacted for queries regarding NFC apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: Candidates can contact Phone: 040-27184236 or Email: apprentice@nfc.gov.in.

overview: Indian Overseas Bank (IOB), a premier public sector commercial bank with headquarters in Chennai, has released official advertisement No. HRDD/RECT/04/2026-27 dated 28th August 2026 for the recruitment of 291 Generalist and Specialist Officers in Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS I), Middle Management Grade Scale II (MMGS II), and Middle Management Grade Scale III (MMGS III).

The 291 vacancies include 100 posts for Manager (Branch Management - Generalist Officer Scale II), 65 posts for Manager (IT Scale II), 50 posts across Senior Manager IT / IS / Network / DBA / Cyber Security (Scale III), 50 posts for Credit Officers (Manager & Senior Manager), 6 posts for Risk Officers, and 25 posts for Assistant Manager Security (Scale I).

Selected officers will be offered regular public sector banking pay scales ranging from ₹48,480 – ₹85,290 (Scale I), ₹64,820 – ₹93,960 (Scale II), and ₹85,920 – ₹1,05,280 (Scale III) along with DA, HRA, leased accommodation, conveyance, and performance perks. Selection will be made through an Online Computer-Based Test (80% weightage) followed by Personal Interview (20% weightage) conducted across major metro centers.

overview: National Informatics Centre (NIC), established in 1976 under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, has released official employment notification Advt. No. NIC/STA/2026/2 for direct recruitment to 376 posts of Scientific/Technical Assistant-A (Group-B S&T Non-Gazetted).

The 376 vacancies are distributed across three key ICT streams: Computer Sciences & Information Technology (300 posts), Electronics and Communication Engineering (26 posts), and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (50 posts), including horizontal reservations for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

Candidates holding a pass in M.Sc / MS / MCA / B.E. / B.Tech in relevant disciplines with a valid GATE score from GATE 2024, GATE 2025, or GATE 2026 (Paper codes CS, EC, or DA) are eligible to apply. Selection will be strictly based on the merit of the valid GATE score followed by Document Verification at Delhi/designated centres. Selected candidates will be placed in Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400) with central government allowances.

selectionProcess: Step 1 - Online Application: Registration on portal https://recruitment.nic.in and submission of GATE score details (2024, 2025, or 2026).
Step 2 - Merit List Formulation: Discipline-wise and category-wise merit list prepared in order of valid GATE score (Best score among eligible years). Equal weightage for GATE 2024, 2025, and 2026.
Step 3 - Tie Resolution: (1) Older year GATE score ranked higher; (2) Candidate older in age ranked higher; (3) Candidate with higher % in essential qualification ranked higher.
Step 4 - Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates called for DV at Delhi / designated centres with original certificates and downloaded Authorization Letter.
Step 5 - Provisional Appointment: Offered upon successful document verification and medical fitness.
howToApplySteps: Visit official NIC recruitment portal at https://recruitment.nic.in between 01/09/2026 (10:00 AM) and 30/09/2026 (05:30 PM).

STEP 2 - Application Form: Enter educational details, select discipline, enter GATE Registration Number, Year (2024/2025/2026), and GATE Score.

Upload scanned images: Photo (50-200 KB), Signature (10-50 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of 10th DOB proof, 10th/12th marksheet, Degree/Provisional certificate, CGPA conversion certificate, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate, and GATE Score Card (10-500 KB).
STEP 3 - Online Fee Payment: Pay ₹800/- online via Debit/Credit Card or Net Banking (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted).
STEP 4 - Download Confirmation Page: Download and print the generated Confirmation Page and application summary for future reference. Do NOT send hard copies by post.

faqs.question: What is the official advertisement number for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The advertisement number is NIC/STA/2026/2 issued by National Informatics Centre (NIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are announced in NIC STA-A Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 376 vacancies are available: Computer Sciences & Information Technology (300 posts), Electronics & Communication Engineering (26 posts), and Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (50 posts).

faqs.question: Is GATE score mandatory for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A recruitment?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must hold a valid GATE score card from GATE 2024, GATE 2025, or GATE 2026 in paper codes CS, EC, or DA. Equal weightage is given to all three years.

faqs.question: Is there any written examination or interview conducted by NIC?
faqs.answer: No. Selection is conducted strictly on direct recruitment merit based on valid GATE scores (2024/2025/2026) followed by Document Verification.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Scientific/Technical Assistant-A in NIC?
faqs.answer: Level 6 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with basic pay of ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400 (Gross monthly salary approx. ₹55,000 – ₹65,000 plus central allowances).

faqs.question: What are the start and end dates for online applications?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 01 September 2026 at 10:00 AM and close on 30 September 2026 at 05:30 PM on https://recruitment.nic.in.

faqs.question: What is the upper age limit for NIC STA-A recruitment?
faqs.answer: Upper age limit is 30 years for UR/EWS as on 30/09/2026. Age relaxations: SC/ST - 5 years (up to 35 yrs), OBC-NCL - 3 years (up to 33 yrs), PwBD - 10 to 15 years, and in-service candidates - 5 years.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for NIC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: ₹800/- per discipline for UR, OBC (NCL), and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and all Women candidates are 100% exempted.

faqs.question: Are candidates with M.Sc or MCA eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates holding M.Sc, MS, MCA, B.E., or B.Tech in relevant disciplines with a valid GATE score in CS, EC, or DA are fully eligible.

faqs.question: Is previous work experience required?
faqs.answer: No, previous work experience is not required. Fresh graduates with the qualifying degree and valid GATE score can apply.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for more than one discipline?
faqs.answer: Yes, eligible candidates can apply for multiple disciplines by submitting separate applications and paying the prescribed fee of ₹800/- for each discipline.

faqs.question: Where will selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: The post carries All India Service Liability, and selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad in the interest of the organization.

faqs.question: Where can I apply online for NIC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can apply online exclusively through the official portal: https://recruitment.nic.in.

Candidates possessing a 3-Year Diploma in Engineering or Bachelor's Degree (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc) in relevant branches (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics & Telecom, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automobile, Agriculture Engineering, Architecture, Textile, etc.) with active and live registration in MP State Employment Exchange (म.प्र. रोजगार कार्यालय) are eligible. Selection will be conducted via a 200-mark Computer-Based Combined Examination commencing from 07 October 2026 across 11 examination cities in Madhya Pradesh.

syllabus.section: Part A: General Aptitude Section (100 Marks)
topics: General Knowledge (GK): Current Affairs, MP History, Geography, Culture, Polity, Economy, Awards, Sports, Scientific Inventions, Important Schemes of MP Government.
General Hindi (सामान्य हिन्दी): संधि, समास, विलोम शब्द, पर्यायवाची, मुहावरे, लोकोक्तियाँ, तत्सम-तद्भव, वर्तनी शुद्धि, वाक्य शुद्धि, रस, छंद, अलंकार, एकार्थी शब्द।
General English: Tenses, Voice (Active/Passive), Direct & Indirect Speech, Prepositions, Articles, Subject-Verb Agreement, Vocabulary, Synonyms/Antonyms, Idioms, Error Detection.

General Mathematics: Number Systems, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Ratio & Proportion, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Simple & Compound Interest, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Mensuration (2D & 3D), Algebra.
General Logical Reasoning: Analogy, Classification, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Series Completion, Syllogism, Venn Diagrams, Non-Verbal Reasoning, Data Sufficiency.

General Science: Physics (Units, Motion, Work, Energy, Electricity, Optics), Chemistry (Matter, Acids & Bases, Metals/Non-metals, Chemical Reactions), Biology (Human Physiology, Cells, Diseases, Ecology).

General Computer Knowledge: Fundamentals of Computers, Operating Systems (Windows/Linux), MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Computer Networking, Internet, Cyber Security, Input/Output Devices, Memory & Storage.

syllabus.section: Part B: Technical Domain Subjects (100 Marks) by Paper Code
topics: Paper Code A – Electrical Engineering: Electrical Circuits, Electromagnetic Fields, Electrical Machines (DC/AC), Power Systems, Transmission & Distribution, Switchgear & Protection, Electrical Measurements, Power Electronics, Control Systems.

Paper Code B – Mechanical Engineering: Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Theory of Machines, Machine Design, Thermodynamics, IC Engines, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery, Manufacturing Science, Industrial Engineering.

Paper Code C – Civil Engineering: Building Materials, Construction Planning & Management, Surveying, Strength of Materials, Structural Analysis, RCC & Steel Design, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulics, Hydrology & Water Resources, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Highway & Transportation Engineering, Environmental Engineering.

Paper Code D – Computer Science & IT: Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems (SQL/RDBMS), Computer Networks, Object-Oriented Programming (C++/Java/Python), Web Technologies, Software Engineering.

Paper Code E – Electronics & Telecommunication: Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Microprocessors & Microcontrollers, Analog & Digital Communication, Signal Processing, VLSI, Embedded Systems.

Paper Code F to N – Other Trades: Fashion Technology, Architecture & Interior Design, Modern Office Management (MOM), Hotel Management & Catering (HMCT), Agricultural Engineering, Textile Design, Automobile Engineering, RAC, and ITI Draftsman Civil.

reservation.title: State Reservation Policy & Special Provisions
detailsList: Vertical Reservation (MP Public Service Act 1994): Scheduled Tribe (ST): 20%, Scheduled Caste (SC): 16%, Other Backward Classes (OBC): 27% (Subject to Hon'ble High Court adjudication), Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): 10%.

87% - 13% Formulation for OBC Reservation: As per MP GAD rules, 87% main selection list (with 14% OBC) will be finalized, while provisional selection for 13% OBC and 13% UR posts will be declared subject to the final outcome of Hon'ble Court matters.
Horizontal Reservation for Women: 35% horizontal reservation (compartment-wise) across all direct recruitment posts for female candidates of Madhya Pradesh (except in the Forest Department).

Divyangjan (PwBD) Quota: 6% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities divided equally as 1.5% VH (Blind/Low Vision), 1.5% EH (Deaf/Hard of Hearing), 1.5% LD (Locomotor Disability/Cerebral Palsy/Dwarfism/Acid Attack), and 1.5% MD (Autism/Mental Illness/Multiple Disabilities).
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) Quota: 10% horizontal reservation for Ex-Servicemen in Class-III technical posts.

Contract Workers Quota (संविदा कर्मी): Up to 50% reservation in direct recruitment posts for contract employees working continuously for at least 5 years in equivalent posts under MP government departments.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official MPESB portal at www.esb.mp.gov.in or MP Online Citizen Services at www.mponline.gov.in.
Step 2: Ensure you have an active Citizen Profile Registration on MP Online. If not registered, create a Profile with Aadhaar E-KYC (OTP or Biometric).
Step 3: Ensure your Madhya Pradesh Employment Exchange (MP Rojgar Portal - rojgar.mp.gov.in) live registration number is active and handy.
Step 4: Locate 'Group-03 Sub-Engineer, Draftsman & Lab Technician Combined Recruitment Test - 2026 (II)' under the Active Applications tab and click Apply.
Step 5: Fill in your personal details, caste category, domicile, educational qualification details, and select your preference order for Post Codes (from 001 to 132).

Step 6: Download the prescribed format sheet, paste your recent colored photograph (white background, date & name imprinted, within last 3 months), sign in the designated box, and write the 2-line self-declaration in your own handwriting.
Step 7: Scan and upload the single-page format template (JPG format) along with class 10th/12th DOB marksheet and caste/EWS/disability certificates as required.
Step 8: Pay the examination fee (₹500 for UR, ₹250 for MP SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD + MP Online portal charges) via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
Step 9: Submit the application before 12 September 2026 (23:59 Hrs) and print the computer-generated Application Form Receipt with Application Number and Transaction ID for future recruitment stages.

importantInstructions: Aadhaar Registration & Biometric Verification: Aadhaar registration is mandatory. Multi-tier biometric verification will be conducted at exam entry and during departmental scrutiny. Ensure your Aadhaar is unlocked.

Only One Online Application: Candidates must submit only a single online application form indicating their complete priority preferences of post codes. Multiple applications by the same candidate are liable to be rejected.

Essential Qualifications on Application Date: Candidates must possess all prescribed educational and technical qualifications on or before the application closing date (12.09.2026). Appearing candidates who have not received final results are not eligible.

B.E. / B.Tech Degree Eligibility: As per departmental service rules, candidates holding higher qualifications like Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) / B.Tech in the relevant discipline are eligible to apply for Sub Engineer diploma positions.

Provisional Status: Candidate eligibility at the Computer-Based Examination stage is purely provisional. Document verification is conducted exclusively by the appointing departments prior to final appointment.
Negative Marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for every wrong response. Candidates should answer questions judiciously.
Preserve Application Details: Safeguard your Application Number, Roll Number, and MP Online Profile credentials until the complete conclusion of the recruitment and joining process.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 1,700 vacancies have been officially announced across 48 government departments, municipal corporations, development authorities, and polytechnic colleges in Madhya Pradesh (UR: 628, EWS: 146, SC: 246, ST: 254, OBC: 426).

faqs.question: What is the examination date for MPESB Group 3 Combined Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The examination is scheduled to commence from 07 October 2026 (Wednesday) onwards in two daily shifts (Morning Shift: 09:00 AM to 12:00 PM; Afternoon Shift: 02:30 PM to 05:30 PM).

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Sub Engineer (उपयंत्री) in MPESB Group 3?
faqs.answer: Regular Sub Engineers are placed in Level-8 of the MP State 7th Pay Matrix (₹32,800 – ₹1,03,600/- per month) plus applicable state allowances. Contract Sub Engineers in MPUDC receive a fixed remuneration of ₹43,000/- per month.

faqs.question: Is registration in MP State Employment Exchange mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. An active and valid live registration in the Madhya Pradesh State Employment Exchange (म.प्र. रोजगार कार्यालय में जीवित पंजीयन) is strictly mandatory for all applicants as on the date of form submission.

faqs.question: Can B.E. / B.Tech degree holders apply for Sub Engineer posts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates holding a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc Engg) in the relevant engineering branch are fully eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern and marking scheme for MPESB Group 3 Exam 2026?
faqs.answer: The test is a single 3-hour Computer-Based Examination of 200 marks: Part A (100 marks) covers General Knowledge, Hindi, English, Maths, Reasoning, Science, and Computers; Part B (100 marks) covers the relevant Engineering discipline. Negative marking of 0.25 marks is deducted for each incorrect answer.

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for online applications?
faqs.answer: Online applications commence on 29 August 2026 and close on 12 September 2026. The online application modification window remains active until 17 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MPESB Group 3 Recruitment?
faqs.answer: ₹500/- for Unreserved category candidates, ₹250/- for MP domicile SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwBD candidates, and Nil for direct backlog posts, plus MP Online portal fee (₹60 via Kiosk or ₹20 via Registered Citizen User).

faqs.question: In which cities will the MPESB Group 3 online exam be held?
faqs.answer: The online examination will be conducted across 11 test cities in MP: Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Khandwa, Neemuch, Ratlam, Rewa, Sagar, Satna, Sidhi, and Ujjain.

faqs.question: Can other state candidates apply for MPESB Group 3?
faqs.answer: Candidates from other states can apply under the Unreserved (Open) category provided they fulfill the basic eligibility criteria and obtain live registration on the MP State Employment Exchange portal.

Step 3: Save your generated unique Registration Number and Password received via SMS.
Step 4: Log in to Part-II (Online Application Form) and select your Postal Circle and Division based on the local language studied in Class 10th.
Step 5: Enter subject-wise 10th marks (or grades) and exercise post preferences across eligible Post IDs in the selected Division.
Step 6: Upload recent passport photograph (30-100 KB, 320x400 px, white background, face 70-80%) and signature (20-100 KB, 300x120 px on white paper).
Step 7: Pay the application fee of ₹100/- online (exempted for Female, SC/ST, PwBD, Transwomen) via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Step 8: Submit the application before 21 September 2026 (05:00 PM) and download/print the complete Application Form with Registration Number.

overview: Central Recruitment Board, Directorate of Civil Defence & Home Guards, Government of Meghalaya, Shillong has issued official notification Memo No. E.1/2026/95-A dated 27th August 2026 for the enrolment of 558 Part-Time Guardsman and Equivalent Ranks (Volunteers) in the Meghalaya Border Wing Home Guards Battalion.

Selected volunteers will be deployed for an initial period of 1 (one) year (extendable based on performance) along the remote border regions of Khasi Hills, Jaintia Hills, and Garo Hills bordering Bangladesh. Deployed volunteers are entitled to monthly honoraria under the 'Highly Skilled Category' wage rates prescribed by the Department of Labour, Employment & Skill Development, Govt. of Meghalaya plus State Government Risk Allowance.

Candidates who are Indian citizens domiciled in Meghalaya, hold a valid Home Guards Basic Training Certificate, and are under 50 years of age as on 01 September 2026 can apply in the Prescribed Standard Form. Applications must be submitted to the respective District Home Guards Commandant / Civil Defence Offices across the state on or before 28 September 2026.

overview: Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has officially published Advertisement No. 741 (Notification No. 8/2026) dated 31st August 2026 inviting online applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to 170 vacancies across 31 prestigious technical cadres through the Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts). The advertised positions span diverse state departments, statutory boards, and public sector undertakings including Animal Husbandry, Industries & Commerce, Economics & Statistics, Town & Country Planning, Public Health, HR&CE, Legislative Assembly, SIPCOT, TIDCO, TANCEM, TIIC, and ELCOT.

The recruitment offers lucrative salary packages ranging from Pay Level 22 (₹56,100 - ₹2,05,700) up to Pay Level 30 (₹56,900 - ₹2,09,200). Candidates holding Bachelor's or Master's degrees in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, ECE, CSE, IT, Chemical, Instrumentation, Textile), Veterinary Science (B.V.Sc / M.V.Sc), Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Library Science, Psychology, Architecture, Nautical Science, Commerce, CA, or ICWA are eligible for respective cadres. Candidates must have completed 21 years of age as on 01 July 2026; no maximum age limit applies to SC, SC(A), ST, MBC/DC, BC, and BCM candidates for most posts.

Online applications must be submitted exclusively via the official portals www.tnpsc.gov.in or www.tnpscexams.in between 07 September 2026 and 06 October 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). The selection process comprises a two-stage evaluation: Computer Based Test (Paper I: Tamil Eligibility + General Studies & Aptitude; Paper II: Post-Specific Subject Paper, Total 450 Marks) followed by an Oral Test / Interview (60 Marks), culminating in a final ranking out of 510 Marks.

reservation.title: Rule of Reservation of Appointments
detailsList: Communal Reservation: Scheduled Caste (SC) 15%, Scheduled Caste Arunthathiyar (SCA) 3%, Scheduled Tribe (ST) 1%, Most Backward Classes / Denotified Communities (MBC/DC) 20%, Backward Classes (BC) 26.5%, and Backward Classes Muslim (BCM) 3.5%.
Women Reservation: 30% horizontal reservation for women candidates across all communal categories.
Persons Studied in Tamil Medium (PSTM): 20% horizontal reservation for candidates who completed entire education up to prescribed qualification in Tamil medium.
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 4% reservation earmarked for eligible categories (LV, HH, LD, CP, AC, DF).
Special Provisions: Religious qualification applies for Regional Sthapathi (Hindus only). Ex-Servicemen and Destitute Widow reservations do not apply to this CTSE recruitment.

overview: Government of Meghalaya, Secretariat Administration Department (Nazarat), Meghalaya Civil Secretariat, Shillong has issued official employment advertisement No. SAN.66/2019/89 dated 17th August 2026 inviting online applications from eligible Indian citizens for 153 Grade IV vacancies. The advertised positions comprise 124 posts of Peon, 17 posts of Cleaner, 6 posts of Sweeper, 3 posts of Chowkidar, and 3 posts of Mali in Level-1 of the Pay Matrix plus usual allowances admissible under the Meghalaya Government Rules.

Candidates who have passed Class VI (6th Standard) and are between 18 and 32 years of age as on 1st January 2026 (relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and as per OM for PWD candidates) are eligible to apply. Selection will be made by the Departmental Selection Committee strictly on the basis of a 100-mark Written Examination covering General English (50 marks) and General Awareness (50 marks) with negative marking for incorrect answers. There will be no interview in accordance with Office Memorandum No. PER(AR)58/2024/36 dated 29th July 2025.

Applications must be submitted strictly through online mode via the official Meghalaya recruitment portal at https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in on or before 18th September 2026 up to 5:00 PM (17:00 hrs). First-time applicants must complete a One-Time Registration (OTR) before filling out the post application. Examination centres will be set up across Shillong, Tura, Jowai, Nongstoin, and Nongpoh. Candidates are advised to read the full notification carefully before submitting the online form.

reservation.title: Reservation Policy & Category Seat Distribution
detailsList: Reservation Policy of the Government of Meghalaya applies across all Grade IV posts.
Khasi & Jaintia (KJ) Quota: Peon (4 Unfilled + 48 Fresh = 52 posts), Cleaner (1 Unfilled + 5 Fresh = 6 posts), Sweeper (3 Fresh), Chowkidar (1 Fresh), Mali (1 Fresh) — Total 63 posts.
Garo Quota: Peon (1 Unfilled + 47 Fresh = 48 posts), Cleaner (3 Unfilled + 4 Fresh = 7 posts), Sweeper (2 Fresh), Chowkidar (1 Fresh), Mali (1 Fresh) — Total 59 posts.
Other Scheduled Tribes & Scheduled Castes (OSTs/SCs) Quota: Peon (1 Unfilled + 6 Fresh = 7 posts), Cleaner (1 Unfilled + 1 Fresh = 2 posts) — Total 9 posts.
Unreserved (UR) Quota: Peon (17 Fresh), Cleaner (2 Fresh), Sweeper (1 Fresh), Chowkidar (1 Fresh), Mali (1 Fresh) — Total 22 posts.

Horizontal Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWDs): Peon includes 3 Partially Deaf (1 UR, 2 KJ) and 3 Locomotor Disability (2 Garo, 1 OST/SC); Cleaner includes 1 Partially Deaf (Garo backlog).
Horizontal Reservation for Meritorious Sports Persons: Peon includes 4 posts (2 KJ, 2 Garo); Cleaner includes 2 posts (1 KJ, 1 Garo).

Unfilled Backlog Vacancies: 6 Peon and 5 Cleaner posts advertised in pursuance of Para 2 of Resolution No. PER.222/71/138 dtd. 12.01.1972 (1st Instance unfilled as advertised vide No. SAN.66/2019/6 dtd. 9/2/2022).

Choose your preferred Examination Centre from Shillong, Tura, Jowai, Nongstoin, or Nongpoh.

Submit the application on or before 18th September 2026 (5:00 PM) and print the final submission confirmation.

The advertised positions include Junior Assistant (कनिष्ठ सहायक - 402 posts across directorates and district magistrate offices), Registration Clerk (निबन्धन लिपिक - 55 posts), Assistant Mining Inspector (सहायक खनिज पर्यवेक्षक - 22 posts), Survey Lekhpal (सर्वे लेखपाल - 16 posts), Junior Assistant cum Computer Operator (14 posts), Computer Assistant (09 posts), Land Acquisition Amin (08 posts), and others across Pay Level-2 (₹19,900 - ₹63,200), Pay Level-3 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100), Pay Level-4 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100), and Pay Level-5 (₹29,200 - ₹92,300).

Candidates who have passed Intermediate (12th Standard) from Uttarakhand Board, UP Board, or equivalent recognized board and possess computer typing proficiency (minimum 4000 KDPH in Hindi on computer for clerical posts) are eligible to apply. The age limit is 18 to 42 years (21 to 42 years for specific posts) as on the crucial cut-off date of 01 July 2026, with 5 years relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and 10 years for Ex-Servicemen and PwD candidates of Uttarakhand. Candidates must be registered with an Employment Exchange in Uttarakhand or hold a valid Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate.

The selection will be conducted through a single-stage 100-mark Offline OMR-based Written Competitive Examination comprising General Hindi (20 Marks), General Studies & General Knowledge (40 Marks), and Uttarakhand General Knowledge (40 Marks) for 2 hours duration, followed by a qualifying Computer Typing Test. Online applications open on 08 September 2026 and close on 07 October 2026 on the official portal at www.sssc.uk.gov.in. An online form correction window will be open from 12 October to 14 October 2026, and the tentative exam date is 15 November 2026.

selectionProcess.description: Single-paper offline objective examination of 100 Marks (100 MCQs) of 2 Hours duration. Divided into General Hindi (20 Marks), General Studies & Knowledge (40 Marks), and Uttarakhand General Knowledge (40 Marks). Negative marking of 0.25 marks for wrong answers.
Qualifying Hindi typing test on computer at minimum 4000 Key Depressions Per Hour (KDPH) for Junior Assistant, Registration Clerk, and other clerical posts. English typing test where specified.

Verification of original Intermediate pass certificate, High School marksheet (DOB proof), Aadhaar Card, Employment Exchange registration card / Uttarakhand Domicile, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), EWS certificate, and horizontal reservation certificates.
Final merit list prepared strictly on marks scored in the 100-mark written competitive examination among candidates who qualify the typing test. No interview stage.

reservation.title: Reservation Policy of Government of Uttarakhand
detailsList: Vertical Reservation: Scheduled Caste (SC) 19%, Scheduled Tribe (ST) 04%, Other Backward Classes (OBC) 14%, and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) 10%.

Horizontal Reservation: Uttarakhand Women (उत्तराखण्ड महिला) 30%, Ex-Servicemen (भूतपूर्व सैनिक) 05%, Dependents of Freedom Fighters (DFF) 02%, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (दिव्यांगजन) 04%, Orphan Children (अनाथ बच्चे) 05%, Skilled Sports Persons (कुशल खिलाड़ी) 04%, and Uttarakhand Statehood Agitators (उत्तराखण्ड राज्य आन्दोलनकारी) 10%.
EWS Certificate Requirement: EWS certificate must be issued between 01 April 2026 and 07 October 2026, based on family income of financial year 2025-26 and valid for FY 2026-27.
OBC Certificate Validity: OBC certificate issued by Uttarakhand authorities is valid for 3 years from the date of issue.
Sports Quota: 4% horizontal reservation for Olympic/National/State medal winners and participants under sports quota.

howToApply: Visit the official website of UKSSSC at https://sssc.uk.gov.in.
Navigate to 'Online Application Portal' and select advertisement No. 80/उ०अ०से०च०आ०/2026.
Complete User Registration using your Aadhaar Number, mobile number, and active email address.
Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (Intermediate 10+2), Employment Exchange registration number, and category/sub-category claims.
Upload scanned documents: Recent Colour Photograph (150×200 px), Signature (150×100 px), Left Thumb Impression (150×100 px), and High School certificate/Aadhaar card.
Pay the application fee (₹300 for UR/OBC, ₹150 for SC/ST/EWS/PwD, ₹0 for Orphans) via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Review all details thoroughly, submit the form before 07 October 2026, and download the application printout.
Correction window will be available from 12 October 2026 to 14 October 2026 if any non-critical edits are needed.

importantInstructions: Applications are accepted strictly in online mode through https://sssc.uk.gov.in. No offline or postal applications will be entertained.
Crucial cut-off date for age calculation is 01 July 2026. Age must be 18 to 42 years (21 to 42 years for specific posts).
The written examination will carry 100 marks with 1/4th (0.25) negative marking for each incorrect response.
Minimum qualifying marks in written examination: 45% for General, OBC, and EWS candidates; 35% for SC and ST candidates.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in UKSSSC Group C Intermediate Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 553 Group C vacancies are advertised under Advt No. 80/UKSSSC/2026, including 402 Junior Assistant, 55 Registration Clerk, 22 Assistant Mining Inspector, 16 Survey Lekhpal, and other posts.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for UKSSSC Intermediate Level posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (12th Standard / 10+2) from Uttarakhand Board, UP Board, or equivalent recognized board. For clerical posts (Junior Assistant, Registration Clerk), minimum 4000 KDPH Hindi computer typing is required.

faqs.question: What is the crucial date for age calculation in UKSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The crucial date for age calculation is 01 July 2026. General candidates must be aged 18 to 42 years (21 to 42 years for select posts). Upper age relaxation of 5 years applies to SC/ST/OBC and 10 years to Ex-Servicemen and PwD candidates of Uttarakhand.

faqs.question: Is Employment Exchange registration mandatory for UKSSSC recruitment?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must be registered in any Employment Exchange in Uttarakhand on or before the closing date (07 October 2026), or possess a valid Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate, or have passed 10th & 12th from institutions within Uttarakhand.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern and syllabus for UKSSSC Group C posts?
faqs.answer: The exam consists of a single-paper 100-mark objective test (2 Hours duration) with General Hindi (20 Marks), General Studies & Reasoning/History/Polity/Computer (40 Marks), and Uttarakhand GK (40 Marks). Negative marking is 0.25 marks per wrong answer.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UKSSSC Group C recruitment?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹300 for Unreserved and OBC candidates; ₹150 for SC, ST, EWS, and Divyang candidates of Uttarakhand; and ₹0 (Free) for Orphan candidates.

faqs.question: What are the important dates for UKSSSC Group C Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online application opens on 08 September 2026 and closes on 07 October 2026. The online form correction window is open from 12 October to 14 October 2026, and the tentative written exam date is 15 November 2026.

overview: The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Itanagar has officially announced Advertisement No. 04/2026 dated 01 September 2026 for the Common Recruitment Examination for Group-A & Group-B, Gazetted, (Technical) Posts-2026 (Part-I) to fill 155 vacancies in various Government Departments.

The recruitment encompasses 42 posts of Agriculture Development Officer (ADO - Group A, Level 10), 45 posts of Horticulture Development Officer (HDO - Group A, Level 10), 66 posts of Veterinary Officer (VO - Group A, Level 10), 1 post of Assistant Director Sericulture (Group A, Level 10), and 1 post of Dairy Development Officer (DDO - Group B, Level 6).

As per Government Notification F.No. AR-33/17/2026-SECT-1-AR dated 26th August 2026, candidates must strictly satisfy the 3-fold eligibility criteria: Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh, indigenous Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) status, and proficiency in an indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh. The online application link will remain active from 10 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 30 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) on appsc.gov.in.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Recruitment Test (Screening - Objective Type 200 Marks)
selectionProcess.description: Conducted in Concerned Subject (200 Marks) if applicants exceed requisite ratio. Serves as a screening test to shortlist candidates in a 1:12 ratio for the Main Written Exam.

Consists of 3 papers: (i) General English & General Studies (Objective - 150 Marks); (ii) Concerned Subject Paper-I (Descriptive - 150 Marks); (iii) Concerned Subject Paper-II (Descriptive - 150 Marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 33% aggregate (min 20% each paper) for general, 20% aggregate for PwBD.
Shortlisted candidates in a 1:3 ratio based on written exam aggregate appear for interview before the Commission at Itanagar.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in APPSC Advertisement 04/2026?

faqs.question: What are the application start and closing dates for APPSC Technical Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 10 September 2026 at 05:00 PM and close on 30 September 2026 at 05:00 PM on appsc.gov.in.

faqs.question: What are the mandatory eligibility criteria under the 26 August 2026 Notification?
faqs.answer: Candidates must satisfy 3 mandatory criteria: (1) Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh; (2) Indigenous APST status; and (3) Proficiency in an Indigenous Tribal Language of Arunachal Pradesh with knowledge of local tribes.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for the advertised posts?
faqs.answer: Group-A posts (ADO, HDO, VO, Assistant Director) carry Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500/-), while Group-B Dairy Development Officer carries Pay Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400/-).

faqs.question: What is the age limit and are there any relaxations?
faqs.answer: The age must be between 21 and 35 years as on 30 September 2026. APST candidates receive 5 years relaxation (up to 40 years). PwBD candidates receive 10-15 years relaxation. One-time age relaxation is also granted for previously cancelled ADO, HDO, VO, and DDO examinations.

faqs.question: Can final semester students apply for APPSC Group-A Technical posts?

faqs.question: What is the selection process and marks distribution?
faqs.answer: The selection comprises: Screening Recruitment Test of 200 Marks (if applicant ratio is high); Main Written Exam of 450 Marks (Paper 1: Gen English & GS - 150, Paper 2: Subject Paper-I - 150, Paper 3: Subject Paper-II - 150); and Viva-voce of 50 Marks. Total selection marks = 500.

faqs.question: What is the minimum qualifying cut-off in the written examination?
faqs.answer: Candidates must score an aggregate of at least 33% in the written examination, with a minimum of 20% in each individual paper. For PwBD candidates, the qualifying mark is 20% aggregate with at least 10% in each paper.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for APPSC Technical Recruitment?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- paid online. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are completely exempted from fee payment.

faqs.question: Where will the examination be held?
faqs.answer: The Recruitment Test and Written Examination will be conducted in the Itanagar Capital Region.

faqs.question: Is registration with the State Veterinary Council mandatory for Veterinary Officers?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates applying for Veterinary Officer must mandatorily possess valid registration in the Arunachal Pradesh State Veterinary Council.

faqs.question: How many candidates will be shortlisted for the viva-voce / interview?
faqs.answer: Candidates will be invited for interview in the ratio of approximately 3 times the number of advertised vacancies based on written examination merit.

overview: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has officially published mega Advertisement Notification No. 09 of 2026 dated 01 September 2026 for the direct recruitment of 2,863 Class-IV (Multi-Tasking Staff - MTS) and Sanitation Worker vacancies in various Government Departments across UT, Divisional, and District Cadres.

The recruitment covers 105 UT Cadre posts, 1,093 Divisional Cadre Jammu posts, 897 Divisional Cadre Kashmir posts, and 768 District Cadre posts spread across all 20 districts of Jammu & Kashmir in major departments including Public Works (R&B), Animal/Sheep Husbandry, Floriculture, Higher Education, Estates, Culture, and Agriculture Production.

Under S.O. 184 of 2020 and SRO 99 of 2008, the educational qualification for Class-IV (MTS) is strictly Minimum Matric (10th) and Maximum 10+2, while for Sanitation Worker it is Minimum 8th Pass and Maximum 10+2. Candidates with higher qualifications beyond 10+2 are not eligible. Selected personnel will be placed in Pay Level SL-1 (Rs. 14,800 - 47,100/-). The online application window is open from 05 October 2026 to 03 November 2026 on www.jkssb.nic.in.

faqs.question: How is the 100-marks selection score calculated?

faqs.question: Is negative marking applicable in the written examination?

overview: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB, Bhopal) on behalf of Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh has officially released the detailed Rulebook and examination notification for the Subedar / Sub-Inspector Cadre Recruitment Test - 2026 (सूबेदार/उप निरीक्षक संवर्ग भर्ती परीक्षा-2026) vide PHQ Letter No. पुमु/2-चयन/स-1/997/26. A total of 507 vacancies have been notified across non-technical and technical branches of Madhya Pradesh Police.

The 507 vacancies comprise 462 Non-Technical Posts across Subedar (81 posts), Sub-Inspector District Police Force / DEF (312 posts), and Sub-Inspector Special Armed Force / SAF (69 posts - strictly male candidates), along with 45 Technical Posts across Sub-Inspector Arms (10 posts - Mechanical Diploma), Sub-Inspector Photo (9 posts - B.Sc PCM), Sub-Inspector Questioned Documents / Q.D. (4 posts - B.Sc PCM), and Sub-Inspector Finger Print (22 posts - B.Sc PCM). 35% horizontal reservation is provided for female candidates in DEF, Subedar, and Technical cadres.

Appointed officers will be placed in Level-9 of the Madhya Pradesh Government Pay Matrix (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800/-) with a starting basic pay of ₹36,200/- per month. Under state service rules, newly recruited officers receive stipend of 70% in the 1st year, 80% in the 2nd year, and 90% in the 3rd year of probation, along with Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and police allowances (approx. gross salary upon full absorption ₹52,000/- to ₹62,000/- per month).

The selection architecture features a three-tier evaluation: Stage-I Preliminary Written Exam (Objective 100 Marks, 2 Hours, No negative marking, qualifying in nature to shortlist 10x candidates for Mains), Stage-II Main Written Exam (Paper 1 General Studies 300 Marks + Paper 2 General Studies 300 Marks + Paper 3 Technical 300 Marks for technical branches, with 1/3rd negative marking), and Stage-III Physical Efficiency Test (PET - 100 Marks across 800m Run, Long Jump, Shot Put) + PMT + Interview (50 Marks). Eligible candidates can apply online at https://esb.mp.gov.in from 09 September 2026 to 23 September 2026.

examCentres.details: Online Computer-Based Examination will be conducted across 14 Centres in Madhya Pradesh: Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Khandwa, Neemuch, Ratlam, Rewa, Sagar, Satna, Sidhi, Ujjain, Barwani, and Anuppur. selectionProcess: Stage 1: Preliminary Written Examination (100 Marks, 2 Hours) – Objective CBT covering 10 subjects: Hindi, English, Analytical Ability, History, Geography, Science, Civics, Basic Computer, Reasoning, and Current Affairs. No negative marking. Qualifying in nature to shortlist candidates at 1:10 ratio for Stage 2.

Stage 2: Main Written Examination (600 Marks for Non-Tech / 900 Marks for Tech) – Paper 1: General Studies (300 Marks, 2 Hours - History/Society & Polity/Governance); Paper 2: General Studies (300 Marks, 2 Hours - Current Affairs/Security & Maths/Stats/Reasoning). Technical posts take additional Paper 3 (300 Marks, 2 Hours - Mechanical or PCM). 1/3rd negative marking per wrong answer. Shortlists candidates at 1:3 ratio for Stage 3.

Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (PET - 100 Marks) – 800m Run (Max 40 marks), Long Jump (Max 30 marks), Shot Put (Max 30 marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 30 marks for Non-Technical, 20 marks for Technical posts.

Stage 4: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Document Verification – Verification of minimum height (167.5 cm Male, 152.4 cm Female), chest expansion (min 5 cm for Male), medical inspection (eye vision, flat foot, knock-knee), and scrutiny of original certificates.
Stage 5: Personality Test / Interview (50 Marks) – Conducted at Police Headquarters level by the Selection Committee.
Stage 6: Final Selection & Merit List – Calculated based on Normalised T-score of Main Exam + PET Score (100) + Interview (50 Marks).

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Paper-I General Studies (300 Marks - 2 Hours)
topics: Part A: History & Indian Society (150 Marks) – Harappan Civilization, Mauryan Empire, Gupta Empire, Harsha, accounts of travelers (11th–14th century), Bhakti-Sufi traditions, Vijayanagara Empire, Mughal Empire, East India Company & colonialism, 1857 Revolt, colonial urbanization & town planning, Mahatma Gandhi & National Movement, making of Constitution; Post-independence consolidation; Salient features of Indian society & diversity; Demographics of India & MP with focus on tribes; Women organizations, population, poverty, urbanization; Globalization impacts.

Part B: Governance, Constitution & Polity, Social Justice (150 Marks) – Indian Constitution: historical base, evolution, features, amendments, basic structure; Functions & responsibilities of Union & States, federal issues, devolution of powers & finance to local levels; Separation of powers, dispute redressal; Parliament & State Legislatures (structure, conduct, privileges); Executive & Judiciary (structure, ministries, pressure groups); Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections; Poverty & hunger issues.

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Paper-II General Studies (300 Marks - 2 Hours)
topics: Part A: Current Affairs, Technology, Economic Development, Environment & Security (150 Marks) – Current affairs; Science & Technology development & applications in daily life; IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nanotech, Biotech, AI, IPR; Conservation, environmental pollution, degradation, EIA; Indian economy & planning, resource mobilization, growth & employment; Modern technologies (GIS, GPS, remote sensing, nanotechnology in policing, traffic, spatial planning); Traditional & renewable energy; Role of police services in democracy; Development & extremism; Internal security challenges (external/non-state actors, social media, cybersecurity basics, money laundering, border management, organized crime & terrorism).

Part B: Reasoning & Data Interpretation / Quantitative Aptitude (150 Marks) – Number systems & statistics, probability; Data management & interpretation (charts, graphs, tables, data sufficiency); Mean, median, mode, standard deviation; Ratio & proportion, unitary method; Profit & loss, percentage, discount, simple & compound interest; Mensuration (area, perimeter, volume); Logical reasoning, analytical ability & problem solving.

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Paper-III Technical Papers (300 Marks - 2 Hours)
topics: Group-1 (Sub-Inspector Arms): Mechanical Engineering syllabus covering Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Theory of Machines, Machine Design, Fluid Mechanics, Thermal Engineering, Workshop Technology, Metallurgy, and Manufacturing Processes.

Group-2 (Sub-Inspector Photo / Q.D. / Finger Print): Graduate-level curriculum in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (B.Sc standard) covering Mechanics, Optics, Electromagnetism, Physical/Organic/Inorganic Chemistry, Calculus, Differential Equations, and Statistics.

howToApply: Step 1: MP Online Profile Registration – Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in or https://mponline.gov.in and ensure your Candidate Profile Registration (उम्मीदवार प्रोफाइल पंजीयन) and Aadhaar e-KYC are active.
Step 2: Access Recruitment Link – Click on 'Online Form - Subedar/Sub-Inspector Cadre Recruitment Test - 2026' under the active notifications section.
Step 3: Enter Profile ID & Date of Birth – Log in using your Profile ID and Password to auto-populate matriculation, personal, and educational records.

Step 4: Select Post Preferences – Choose your priority order for Non-Technical posts (Subedar, SI SAF, SI DEF) and Technical posts (SI Arms or SI Photo/QD/Finger Print as per qualification). Male candidates can apply for SAF; female candidates apply for Subedar, DEF, and Technical.

Step 5: Upload Hand-Written Declaration, Live Photo & Signature – Print the template, write the mandatory declaration in your own handwriting, paste a recent passport photograph (taken within last 3 months with name and date of photo imprinted), sign below, and upload the scanned template.
Step 6: Select Examination Centres – Select 4 preferred exam cities in MP (Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Ujjain, Sagar, Satna, Rewa, etc.) in order of priority.
Step 7: Pay Application Fee – Pay ₹500/- for UR or ₹250/- for SC/ST/OBC/EWS (MP Domicile) + MP Online portal fee (₹60 via Kiosk or ₹20 via Citizen User) using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Step 8: Save Confirmation Page – Download and print the computer-generated application receipt containing your Application Number for future reference.

faqs.question: What is the official letter number and application schedule for MP Police SI 2026?
faqs.answer: The recruitment is governed by PHQ Letter No. पुमु/2-चयन/स-1/997/26 dated 30.07.2026. Online applications open on 09 September 2026 and close on 23 September 2026. The correction window is active from 09 September 2026 to 28 September 2026.

faqs.question: When will the MP Police SI written examination start?

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for MP Police SI?

faqs.question: What is the pay scale and probation stipend for MP Police Sub-Inspector?
faqs.answer: All posts carry Pay Level-9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800/-) with basic pay ₹36,200/- per month. As per MP Govt rules, selected candidates receive a monthly stipend of 70% in 1st year, 80% in 2nd year, and 90% in 3rd year of probation, plus full DA, HRA, and allowances.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for MP Police SI Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Age is calculated as on 23 September 2026 (closing date of online application). Minimum age is 21 years. Maximum age for UR/EWS male and other state candidates is 33 years. Maximum age for female candidates (all categories) and SC/ST/OBC male candidates (MP domicile) is 38 years.

faqs.question: Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates from other states are eligible to apply under the Unreserved (UR) Open category with maximum age limit of 33 years. They are not entitled to reservation benefits or age concessions.

faqs.question: What are the physical standards (PMT) required for MP Police SI?
faqs.answer: Height: Minimum 167.5 cm for Male candidates and 152.4 cm for Female candidates. Chest (Male only): Minimum 81 cm unexpanded with at least 5 cm expansion (86 cm expanded). Eye vision must be at least 6/9 and 6/12 without spectacles, with no color blindness, knock-knee, or flat foot.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme and syllabus for Stage-I Prelims?
faqs.answer: Stage-I Preliminary Exam consists of 100 MCQs carrying 100 marks for 2 hours with NO negative marking. Subjects include Hindi, English, Analytical Ability, History, Geography, Science, Civics, Basic Computer, Reasoning, and Current Affairs. It is qualifying in nature to shortlist 10 times vacancies for Mains.

faqs.question: How does the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) work and what are the qualifying marks?
faqs.answer: The PET carries 100 marks across 3 events: 800-meter run (Max 40 marks), Long Jump (Max 30 marks), and Shot Put (Max 30 marks). Candidates must score at least 30 marks for Non-Technical posts and 20 marks for Technical posts to qualify for the 50-mark Interview.

overview: The Collector and District Magistrate Office, Solapur (District Setu Committee) has officially issued recruitment proclamation notice No. पत्रजाक्र-२०२६/मशा/कार्या-५/सेतू/प्रक्र-३६/आरआर-६७१ dated 31 August 2026 for establishing 592 Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras (ASSK / Maha e-Seva Kendra / Village Level Entrepreneur Centers) across rural Gram Panchayats and urban local bodies in Solapur district.

Under the administrative provisions of Maharashtra Government Electronics & IT Department GR dated 19 January 2018 and Corrigendum dated 09 July 2026, these 592 centers are distributed across 11 talukas: Pandharpur (77), Akkalkot (63), Karmala (62), Barshi (58), Madha (55), Malshiras (52), Sangola (50), Uttar Solapur (46, including 32 Solapur Municipal Corporation centers), Dakshin Solapur & Mandrup (46), Mohol (43), and Mangalwedha (40).

Selection is conducted by the District Level Setu Committee chaired by Shri S. Karthikeyan IAS, District Collector Solapur, based on educational merit, local residence credentials, Mandal Adhikari infrastructure inspection (परिशिष्ट - अ), business plan sustainability (परिशिष्ट - ब), and personal interview. Applications must be downloaded from https://solapur.gov.in and submitted strictly in person (समक्ष) at the Setu Sankalan Branch, Collector Office Solapur before 30 September 2026 (up to 5:00 PM). Applications sent via postal mail or courier will not be entertained.

overview: Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India has officially released the detailed notification for the Junior Engineer Examination, 2026 (Notice No. HQ-C-3019/1/2026-C-3). The commission is conducting an open competitive examination for direct recruitment to 1,748 tentative vacancies for the posts of Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecommunication) across key central government ministries and departments, along with Scientific Assistant in India Meteorological Department (IMD).

Participating departments and organizations in this recruitment drive include Border Roads Organization (BRO), Central Public Works Department (CPWD), Military Engineer Services (MES), Central Water Commission (CWC), Central Water and Power Research Station (CWPRS), DGQA-NAVAL (Ministry of Defence), Farakka Barrage Project (Ministry of Jal Shakti), Brahmaputra Board, National Technical Research Organization (NTRO), Directorate General of Lighthouses & Lightships (DGLL), Department of Telecommunication (DoT), India Meteorological Department (IMD), and Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying.

All notified posts are classified as Group 'B' Non-Gazetted in Pay Level-6 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400/-) of the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix. Appointed candidates will receive a starting basic pay of ₹35,400/- per month along with admissible central government allowances including Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA), and NPS retirement benefits, providing an approximate starting gross salary of ₹56,000/- to ₹68,000/- per month depending on the city of posting.

Selection is conducted through a two-stage Computer Based Examination: Paper-I (Screening/Qualifying in nature, 200 Questions / 200 Marks) and Paper-II (Core Technical Domain, 100 Questions / 300 Marks, which exclusively determines the final merit order), followed by Online Option Preference submission, First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) under sliding mechanism, Document Verification by user departments, and Physical Efficiency Tests (PET) for Border Roads Organization. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications at https://ssc.gov.in between 02 September 2026 and 22 September 2026 (23:00 hours).

education: Degree (B.E. / B.Tech) or Three-Year Diploma in Engineering in the relevant branch (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Telecommunication, Instrumentation, Computer Science, IT) from a recognized University or Institution.

For Scientific Assistant in IMD: Bachelor's Degree in Science with Physics as one of the subjects OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Electronics, ECE, Telecommunication Engineering, or Information Technology.

For Diploma holders applying to DGLL: Minimum 3 years experience in the respective discipline is mandatory.
Degree holders in Engineering require NO prior experience for any of the notified posts.

Cut-off Date: Candidates must possess the requisite educational qualification on or before 22 September 2026. B.Tech/Diploma awarded by IGNOU to students enrolled up to academic year 2009-10 is treated as valid as per Supreme Court orders.
eligibility.ageLimit: The crucial date for age reckoning is fixed as 01 August 2026. For posts with an age limit up to 30 years, candidates must have been born not earlier than 02 August 1996 and not later than 01 August 2008. For posts with an age limit up to 32 years (CPWD & DGLL), candidates must have been born not earlier than 02 August 1994 and not later than 01 August 2008.
ageRelaxation: SC / ST: 5 years upper age relaxation
OBC: 3 years upper age relaxation
PwBD (Unreserved / EWS): 10 years upper age relaxation
PwBD (OBC): 13 years upper age relaxation
PwBD (SC / ST): 15 years upper age relaxation
Ex-Servicemen (ESM): 3 years deduction after subtracting military service from actual age
Defence Personnel Disabled during Hostilities: 3 years (UR/EWS/OBC) / 8 years (SC/ST)
experience: BRO & MES: Degree holders require 0 years experience; Diploma holders require 2 years in Planning, Execution & Maintenance.
DGQA-Naval: Degree holders require 0 years experience; Diploma holders require 2 years experience in the respective field.
DGLL: Degree holders require 0 years experience; Diploma holders require 3 years experience.
CPWD, CWC, CWPRS, Brahmaputra Board, NTRO, Farakka Barrage, DoT, IMD, Fisheries: No experience required for either Degree or Diploma holders.
medicalStandards: General: Candidates must be in sound bodily health, free from any physical or mental defect likely to interfere with efficient discharge of duties.
Border Roads Organization (BRO) Standards: Only MALE candidates are eligible for BRO posts. Must qualify the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 1 Mile Run in 10 minutes at GREF Centre, Pune.

examCentres.details: Examination Centres are spread across all 9 SSC Administrative Regional Jurisdictions: Central Region (CR: Patna, Prayagraj, Agra, Bareilly, Gorakhpur, Kanpur, Lucknow, Meerut, Varanasi, etc.), Eastern Region (ER: Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Ranchi, Dhanbad, Jamshedpur, Cuttack, Siliguri, Gangtok, etc.), KKR (Bengaluru, Mangalore, Mysuru, Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi, Kozhikode, Thrissur, etc.), MPR (Bhopal, Gwalior, Indore, Jabalpur, Raipur, Bilaspur, etc.), NER (Guwahati, Shillong, Agartala, Imphal, Itanagar, Aizawl, Dimapur), Northern Region (NR: Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Bikaner, Udaipur, Dehradun, Roorkee, Haldwani), North Western Region (NWR: Chandigarh, Shimla, Jammu, Srinagar, Amritsar, Jalandhar, Patiala, Ludhiana), Southern Region (SR: Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Hyderabad, Warangal, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, Kurnool), and Western Region (WR: Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Panaji). Candidates must give preference for 3 centres within the same regional jurisdiction.

selectionProcess: Stage 1: Paper-I (Computer Based Examination - CBE) – 200 Questions, 200 Marks (Duration: 2 Hours). Objective multiple-choice screening examination testing Reasoning (50 Qs), General Awareness (50 Qs), and Core General Engineering (100 Qs). Paper-I is qualifying in nature with negative marking of 0.25 marks per incorrect answer. Shortlisting for Paper-II is based on normalized Paper-I marks.

Stage 2: Paper-II (Computer Based Examination - CBE) – 100 Technical Domain Questions, 300 Marks (Duration: 2 Hours). In-depth technical discipline paper carrying 3 marks per question with 1 mark negative marking. On-screen scientific calculator and virtual IS 456:2000 / Steam tables provided on computer console. Normalized score in Paper-II exclusively determines the final merit position!

Stage 3: Online Post & Department Preference Form – Candidates submit their preference order for various posts and departments via the Online Option Form on ssc.gov.in prior to the declaration of First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA).
Stage 4: First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) / Merit List – Published under SSC's sliding mechanism based strictly on Paper-II normalized score and candidate preference.
Stage 5: Document Verification (DV) – Conducted directly by the indented User Ministries / Departments / Organizations before final appointment.

Stage 6: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Medical Examination – Mandatory 1-Mile run in 10 minutes and detailed medical standards evaluation at GREF Centre, Pune for candidates selected in Border Roads Organization (BRO).

topics: Analogies, similarities and differences, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, discrimination, observation

Magnetic Circuits: Reluctance, self and mutual inductance, magnetomotive force (MMF)
A.C. Fundamentals: RMS and average values, resonance, balanced three-phase circuits, star-delta transformation, complex power and power factor
Measurement & Instruments: Ammeter, voltmeter, wattmeter, Wheatstone and Kelvin bridges, energy meter, megger, CT, PT, calibration of electronic energy meter
Electrical Machines: Single-phase and three-phase transformers; DC machines (types, characteristics, losses, efficiency); AC induction motors (starting, braking, speed control, torque-speed curves)
Synchronous Machines: Fractional motors, servomotors, armature reaction, parallel operation, synchronization
Generation, Transmission & Distribution: Power stations, load factor, diversity factor, transmission line parameters, corona and Ferranti effect, circuit breakers, protective relays, coaxial cables
Estimation & Costing: Lighting schemes, electrical installation of machines, earthing practices, Indian Electricity (IE) Rules

Utilization & Power Electronics: Illumination, electric heating, electric welding, electroplating, electric traction; diodes, BJT, FET, thyristor V-I characteristics, firing circuits, DC-DC buck/boost converters, rectifiers

Engineering Mechanics & Strength of Materials: Free-body diagrams, equilibrium, Lami's theorem, friction, centroid; simple stress-strain, shear force and bending moment, beam deflection, torsion, thin cylinders

Theory of Machines & Machine Design: Cams and followers, gears, belts, chains, flywheels, governors, balancing, vibrations, brakes, clutches, bearings; creep and fatigue, failure theories, cotter/knuckle joints, shafts, couplings, springs, fasteners
Materials Science & Engineering: Crystal structures, iron-carbon phase diagram, heat treatment of steel, cast iron, non-ferrous alloys, NDT, corrosion

Thermal Engineering: Laws of thermodynamics, cycles (Otto, Diesel, Dual, Rankine, Brayton), steam generators, boilers, impulse and reaction turbines, cooling towers, IC engines, compressors, refrigeration and air conditioning, heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation)
Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery: Fluid properties, continuity equation, jet impact, hydraulic turbines, centrifugal and reciprocating pumps

howToApply: Step 1: One-Time Registration (OTR) – Visit the official Staff Selection Commission portal at https://ssc.gov.in or download the 'mySSC' mobile application from Google Play Store. If you have not created an OTR on the new website (earlier OTR from ssc.nic.in is invalid), click on 'Register Now' under Login/Register.

Step 2: Complete Personal & Education Details – Enter your name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth strictly as recorded in your Class 10th Matriculation certificate. Provide board name, roll number, year of passing, active mobile number, and email ID (verified via OTP).

Step 3: Choose Aadhaar Authentication – Candidates are advised to authenticate using Aadhaar during OTR to enjoy exemptions from photo/signature technical rejection rules and streamlined entry at exam venues.

Step 4: Login & Access Live Examination – Log into ssc.gov.in using your Registration Number and Password. Navigate to the 'Live Examination' tab and click 'Apply' under 'Junior Engineer Examination, 2026'.

Step 5: Post Selection & Exam Subject – Choose the posts for which you are eligible based on your Degree/Diploma engineering stream. Select the examination subject (Civil Part-A, Electrical Part-B, Mechanical Part-C, CS/IT Part-D, ECE Part-E, Physics Part-F, or Telecom Part-G).

Step 6: Capture Real-Time Live Photo – The application captures your live photograph via webcam or through the 'mySSC' mobile app using a QR code. Ensure plain background, eye-level camera, good lighting, and no spectacles, caps, or masks.
Step 7: Upload Scanned Signature – Upload your signature in JPEG format (10 to 20 KB, dimensions 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
Step 8: Select Examination Centres – Select three preferred examination centres in order of priority within the same SSC Regional Jurisdiction.
Step 9: Preview & Submit Form – Thoroughly review all entered details in the preview window. Accept the declaration by clicking 'I Agree', enter the Captcha code, and click 'Submit'.

Step 10: Fee Payment & Print Application – Pay the application fee of ₹100/- via BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card (Women, SC, ST, PwBD, ESM are exempt). Print the final application confirmation slip for your records.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are announced for SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 1,748 tentative vacancies have been announced across 14 central government organizations including BRO, CPWD, MES, CWC, CWPRS, DGQA-Naval, NTRO, DGLL, DoT, IMD, and Ministry of Fisheries. Post-wise and category-wise details are published on ssc.gov.in.

faqs.question: What is the official advertisement number and online application deadline for SSC JE 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification file number is F. No. HQ-C-3019/1/2026-C-3 published on 02 September 2026. The online application window is open from 02 September 2026 to 22 September 2026 (23:00 hours). The fee payment deadline is 23 September 2026 (23:00 hours).

faqs.question: What is the pay scale and starting salary for SSC Junior Engineer posts?
faqs.answer: All Junior Engineer posts and Scientific Assistant (IMD) are Group 'B' Non-Gazetted posts in Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400/-) with initial basic pay of ₹35,400/- per month. Gross monthly salary ranges from approx. ₹56,000/- to ₹68,000/- per month including DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial reckoning date for SSC JE 2026?
faqs.answer: The crucial date for age reckoning is 01 August 2026. For posts with an age limit up to 30 years, candidates must be born between 02 August 1996 and 01 August 2008. For CPWD and DGLL posts (up to 32 years), candidates must be born between 02 August 1994 and 01 August 2008. Standard age relaxations apply for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), and PwBD (10-15 yrs).

faqs.question: Is work experience mandatory for all SSC JE posts?
faqs.answer: No. Degree holders (B.E. / B.Tech) require NO experience for any post. Experience is only required for Diploma holders applying to Border Roads Organization (BRO - 2 years), Military Engineer Services (MES - 2 years), DGQA-Naval (2 years), and DGLL (3 years). For CPWD, CWC, CWPRS, NTRO, DoT, IMD, and Fisheries, fresh Diploma and Degree holders can apply without experience.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern and marking scheme for SSC JE CBE?
faqs.answer: Paper-I has 200 objective MCQs (Reasoning: 50, GA: 50, Engineering Domain: 100) for 200 marks in 2 hours with 0.25 negative marking. Paper-II has 100 core domain questions for 300 marks in 2 hours with 1.00 negative marking. An on-screen virtual scientific calculator and IS code tables are enabled in Paper-II.

faqs.question: Are Paper-I marks included in the final merit list?
faqs.answer: No. Paper-I is qualifying in nature and is used strictly to shortlist candidates for Paper-II. Final merit ranking and post allocation are prepared exclusively based on normalized marks obtained in Paper-II (300 Marks).

faqs.question: What are the special physical standards and PET for Border Roads Organization (BRO)?
faqs.answer: Only MALE candidates are eligible for BRO. Candidates must qualify the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) consisting of a 1-Mile run in 10 minutes at GREF Centre, Pune. Minimum height criteria range from 152 cm to 162.5 cm depending on the candidate's home region/state.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All Women candidates, SC, ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates are completely exempt from payment of any application fee.

faqs.question: When can candidates make corrections in their submitted application form?
faqs.answer: The 'Window for Online Application Form Correction' will be open from 28 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 (23:00 hours). Candidates can correct their form up to two times with correction charges of ₹200/- for the 1st correction and ₹500/- for the 2nd correction.

overview: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially published Examination Notice No. 01/2027-GEOL (File No. 04/01/2026-E.I(B)) for the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2027 (CGSE 2027). This nationwide prestigious competitive examination is conducted for direct recruitment to 127 Group 'A' and Group 'B' gazetted scientific positions in the Geological Survey of India (GSI), Ministry of Mines, and the Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti.

The 127 notified vacancies are divided into two distinct categories: Category-I features 111 posts in GSI including Geologist Group 'A' (29 posts), Chemist Group 'A' (07 posts), Assistant Geologist Group 'B' (34 posts), Assistant Geophysicist Group 'B' (35 posts), and Assistant Chemist Group 'B' (06 posts). Category-II features 16 posts in CGWB including Scientist 'B' (Hydrogeology) Group 'A' (05 posts), Scientist 'B' (Chemical) Group 'A' (01 post), Scientist 'B' (Geophysics) Group 'A' (01 post), Assistant Hydrogeologist Group 'B' (07 posts), Assistant Chemist Group 'B' (01 post), and Assistant Geophysicist Group 'B' (01 post).

Appointed officers in Group 'A' posts are placed in Level-10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500/-) with starting basic pay of ₹56,100/- per month (gross monthly salary approx ₹90,000 – ₹1,10,000/-), while Group 'B' officers are placed in Level-8 of the Pay Matrix (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100/-) with starting basic pay of ₹47,600/- per month (gross monthly salary approx ₹75,000 – ₹90,000/-), along with central government DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and official perks.

The examination follows a rigorous three-tier selection process: Stage-I Preliminary Examination (Objective type on OMR Sheet, 400 Marks, scheduled for 10 January 2027), Stage-II Main Examination (Conventional/Descriptive type, 600 Marks, scheduled for 19 & 20 June 2027), and Stage-III Personality Test / Interview (200 Marks). Crucially, marks from ALL THREE stages (Stage-I + Stage-II + Stage-III = 1,200 Total Marks) are counted towards the final merit order and service allocation. Eligible postgraduates must submit their online applications via the UPSC portal at https://upsconline.nic.in on or before 22 September 2026 (till 18:00 Hours).

selectionProcess: Stage-I: Combined Geo-Scientist (Preliminary) Examination – Objective type on OMR Sheet comprising two papers (Paper-I: General Studies, 100 Marks; Paper-II: Stream Specific Discipline, 300 Marks; Total 400 Marks, 2 Hours each). Negative marking: 1/3rd (0.33) marks per wrong answer. Marks scored in Stage-I ARE COUNTED towards the final merit order! Candidates shortlisted for Main Exam at 6 to 7 times the number of vacancies.

Stage-II: Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Examination – Conventional / Descriptive type examination consisting of three papers for each stream (3 Hours & 200 Marks each, Total 600 Marks). Answers must be written in English only. Non-programmable pocket calculators permitted. Marks scored in Stage-II ARE COUNTED towards the final merit order!

Stage-III: Personality Test / Interview – Carrying 200 Marks with no minimum qualifying marks. Candidates obtaining qualifying marks in Stage-II will be summoned for Interview in a ratio of approx. twice (2x) the number of vacancies to assess leadership, field life aptitude, intellectual curiosity, and integrity.

Final Merit Order & Service Allocation: Prepared strictly on the basis of aggregate marks secured in all three stages combined: Stage-I (400 Marks) + Stage-II (600 Marks) + Stage-III (200 Marks) = Grand Total 1,200 Marks, subject to verification of eligibility and order of service preferences.
