syllabus.section: Stage-I Preliminary: Paper-I General Studies (Common for All Streams - 100 Marks)
topics: Current events of national and international importance
History of India and Indian National Movement
Indian and World Geography - Physical, Social, Economic Geography of India and the World
Indian Polity and Governance - Constitution, Political System, Panchayati Raj, Public Policy, Rights Issues etc.
Economic and Social Development - Sustainable Development, Poverty, Inclusion, Demographics, Social Sector initiatives etc.
General issues on Environmental Ecology, Bio-diversity and Climate Change - that do not require subject specialisation
General Science

syllabus.section: Stage-I Preliminary: Paper-II Geology / Hydrogeology (300 Marks)
topics: Physical Geology: Principle of uniformitarianism; origin, differentiation and internal structure of Earth; origin of atmosphere; earthquakes and volcanoes; continental drift, sea-floor spreading, isostasy, orogeny and plate tectonics; geological action of rivers, wind, glaciers, waves; landforms; weathering processes

Structural Geology: Stress, strain and rheological properties of rocks; planar and linear structures; folds and faults; Mohr's circle and failure criteria; ductile and brittle shear; toposheets, V-rules, outcrop patterns, stereographic projections

Mineralogy: Symmetry, notations, indices; Bravais lattices; chemical classification; isomorphism, polymorphism, solid solution; silicate structures; physical and optical properties of rock forming minerals (olivine, garnet, pyroxene, amphibole, mica, feldspar, quartz)

Igneous Petrology: Magma types and evolution; IUGS classification; textures and structures; binary and ternary phase diagrams; magmatic differentiation and assimilation; petrogenesis of granites, basalts, komatiites, alkaline rocks
Metamorphic Petrology: Controls of metamorphism; slate, schist, gneiss; metamorphic textures; zones, isograds, facies; geothermal gradients and plate tectonics
Sedimentology: Origin, textures, grain-size scale; primary sedimentary structures; sandstone and carbonate classification; siliciclastic depositional environments and facies; diagenesis

Paleontology: Fossilization; species concept; morphology and classification of invertebrates (Trilobites, Brachiopods, Lamellibranchs, Gastropods, Cephalopods); evolution in Equidae and Hominidae; microfossils (Foraminifera, Ostracoda); Gondwana flora

Stratigraphy: Superposition; litho-, bio-, and chronostratigraphy; Archaean cratons (Dharwar, Singhbhum, Aravalli); Proterozoic mobile belts; Purana basins (Cuddapah, Vindhyan); Phanerozoic stratigraphy of India; Siwaliks; Indo-Gangetic alluvium

Economic Geology: Mineral deposit properties, form, assemblage, texture; magmatic, pegmatitic, hydrothermal, supergene, metamorphic ore formation; coal and petroleum formation; major Indian mineral and hydrocarbon deposits
Hydrogeology: Aquifer characteristics, porosity, permeability, transmissivity; Darcy's Law; Bernoulli equation; groundwater composition; H and O isotopes; artificial recharge

Solid Earth Geophysics: Origin and characteristics of planets; Earth's shape, rotation, gravity and magnetic fields; Geomagnetism, rock magnetism; Elastic waves, internal structure of Earth; Plate tectonics, earthquakes, focal depth, intensity and magnitude scales

Mathematical Methods in Geophysics: Vector analysis, Gauss's and Stoke's theorems; Matrices, eigenvalues and eigenvectors; Newton's law of gravitation; Conservation laws; Rigid body motion; Inverse theory, forward and inverse problems; Numerical methods, differential equations

Electromagnetism: Electrostatic and magneto-static fields; Coulomb's, Ampere's, Biot-Savart's, Gauss's laws; Laplace's and Poisson's equations; Maxwell's equations; Electromagnetic vector and scalar potentials

Geophysical Prospecting: Gravity, magnetic, electrical, electromagnetic, and well-logging methods; Seismic reflection and refraction; Fermat's principle, Snell's law; Signal processing, Fourier transform, sampling theorem, convolution
Remote Sensing & Thermodynamics: EM spectrum, Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien's laws, sensor interactions; Laws of thermodynamics and thermodynamic potentials
Nuclear Physics & Radiometry: Radioactivity, decay laws, radioactive minerals; Radiation detectors (GM counter, scintillation counter, gamma-ray spectrometer); Wave-particle duality

Chemical Periodicity: Schrödinger equation, radial distribution curves; Modern IUPAC Periodic table, trends in radii, ionization enthalpy, electron affinity, electronegativity; Oxidation states and redox chemistry

Chemical Bonding & Structure: Ionic bonding, lattice energy, Born-Haber cycle; Covalent bonding, VBT, MOT, hybridization, resonance; Coordinate bonding, Werner theory, chelate complexes, isomerism in square planar and octahedral complexes
Acids and Bases: Chemical and ionic equilibrium, Ostwald dilution law, pH scale, buffer action, Henderson equation
Quantitative Inorganic Analysis: Volumetric analysis, standard solutions; Acid-base, redox, complexometric, and precipitation titrations; Indicators
Kinetic Theory & Gaseous State: Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, collision diameter, mean free path, effusion rates
Chemical Thermodynamics & Equilibrium: First and second laws, state functions, Joule-Thomson coefficient; Gibbs and Helmholtz functions; Criteria for spontaneity
Solutions of Non-Electrolytes: Raoult's law, colligative properties, osmosis, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point
Electrochemistry: Cell constant, Kohlrausch's law, ionic mobility, Debye-Hückel theory, conductometric titrations, transport numbers
Basic Organic Chemistry: Resonance, hyperconjugation, reactive intermediates (carbocations, carbanions, free radicals)

Stereochemistry & Reaction Mechanisms: Chirality, R/S nomenclature, E/Z naming; Aliphatic substitutions (SN1, SN2); Eliminations (E1, E2, Saytzeff/Hoffman); Additions; Electrophilic aromatic substitutions; Molecular rearrangements

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Geology Papers I, II & III (Descriptive - 600 Marks)
topics: Geology Paper-I: Physical geology and remote sensing (geomorphic landforms, digital image processing, LANDSAT/IRS); Structural geology (stress-strain, ductile/brittle shear, microfabrics); Sedimentology (fluid/sediment flows, sequence stratigraphy); Paleontology (fossil record, mass extinctions); Stratigraphy (Precambrian cratons, Phanerozoic basins)

Geology Paper-II: Mineralogy (crystal classes, optical properties, rock-forming minerals); Geochemistry and isotope geology (radiometric dating, REE patterns, stable isotopes); Igneous petrology (magmatic crystallization, phase diagrams, mantle melting); Metamorphic petrology (P-T-t paths, metamorphic facies, thermodynamics); Geodynamics (seismic discontinuities, paleomagnetism, mantle plumes)

Geology Paper-III: Economic geology (ore-forming processes, hydrothermal/magmatic deposits, fluid inclusions); Indian mineral deposits and mineral economics (National Mineral Policy, strategic minerals); Mineral exploration (geochemical/geophysical surveys, drilling, reserve estimation); Fuel and engineering geology (coalification, petroleum systems, dam/tunnel investigations); Environmental geology and natural hazards

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Geophysics Papers I, II & III (Descriptive - 600 Marks)
topics: Geophysics Paper-I: Solid Earth Geophysics; Earthquake Seismology (seismotectonics, focal mechanisms, seismic tomography); Mathematical Methods in Geophysics; Geophysical Inversion (least squares, singular value decomposition, SVD, genetic algorithms); Mathematical Methods of Physics (Green's function, partial differential equations)

Geophysics Paper-II: Electrodynamics; Electromagnetic Theory (waveguides, transmission lines); Atmospheric & Space Physics (ionosphere, GPS); Potential Field (Gravity & Magnetic) Methods; Electrical and Electromagnetic Methods (ERT, IP, MT, GPR); Seismic Prospecting (2D/3D CDP, migration, VSP); Borehole Geophysics (wireline logging); Classical Mechanics; Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics; Atomic/Molecular Physics; Nuclear Physics

Geophysics Paper-III: Radiometric & Airborne Geophysics; Marine Geophysics; Geophysical Signal Processing (FFT, digital filtering, deconvolution); Remote Sensing & Geohydrology; Solid State Physics & Electronics; Laser Systems; Digital Electronics, Radar & Satellite Communications; Quantum Mechanics (Schrodinger equation, perturbation theory)

syllabus.section: Stage-II Main: Chemistry Papers I, II & III (Descriptive - 600 Marks)
topics: Chemistry Paper-I (Inorganic): Inorganic solids (defects, zeolites, superconductors); Coordination compounds (Crystal Field Theory, ligand field stabilization, spectrochemical series); Acid-base, gravimetric, and redox titrations; Complexometric titrations (EDTA); Organometallic compounds (18-electron rule, catalysts); Nuclear chemistry; Chemistry of d- and f-block elements

Chemistry Paper-II (Physical): Kinetic theory and real gases (van der Waals, virial equation); Solids and band theory; Chemical thermodynamics and equilibrium (chemical potential, fugacity, Debye-Huckel limiting law); Kinetics and catalysis; Electrochemistry (Nernst equation, potentiometric titrations); Quantum chemistry (operators, particle in a 3D box); Spectroscopy (Rotational, Vibrational, Raman); Photochemistry (Jablonski diagram, quantum yield)

Chemistry Paper-III (Analytical & Organic): Quantitative errors, statistics (Q-test, t-test); Separation methods (HPLC, GLC, TLC, solvent extraction); Spectroscopic instrumentation (AAS, ICP, UV-Vis, IR); Thermal and X-ray methods; Analysis of geological materials and petroleum; Organic intermediates (carbenes, nitrenes); Carbonyl reactions (Aldol, Claisen, Wittig); Electrocyclic reactions (Woodward-Hoffman rules); Spectroscopy of organic compounds (FTIR, 1H/13C NMR, Mass spectrometry)

howToApply: Step 1: Account Creation & Universal Registration Number (URN) – Visit the official UPSC application portal at https://upsconline.nic.in. If you do not have an active account, complete Account Creation and generate your lifetime unique Universal Registration Number (URN).

Step 2: Fill Common Application Form (CAF) – Complete the Common Application Form (CAF) with personal details, educational qualifications, address, and photo identity details (Aadhaar Card is strongly recommended for seamless verification).

Step 3: Capture Live Photograph & Upload Recent Photo – Applicants must upload a clear scanned photograph AND capture a real-time live photograph through the portal webcam module adhering to UPSC photo guidelines.
Step 4: Upload Three-Fold Signature – Sign three times (one below the other) on a plain white paper with black ink and upload the scanned signature image as instructed.

Step 5: Fill Examination Specific Module – Select 'Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2027'. Choose your Stream/Discipline (Geology/Hydrogeology, Geophysics, or Chemistry) and indicate service preferences for GSI and CGWB posts.

Step 6: Select Preliminary Examination Centre – Select your preferred Stage-I Preliminary Examination Centre from the list of 21 cities. (Note: Allotted on First-Apply-First-Allot basis; early application is advised).

Step 7: Pay Examination Fee – Pay the fee of ₹200/- online using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI (Female, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempt). Both GSI and CGWB options require only one common application and single fee payment.

Step 8: Final Submission & Application Number Generation – Verify all details in the preview module, submit the form, and note down the generated Application Number alongside your URN for all future references.

faqs.question: What is the official examination notice number and application deadline for UPSC CGSE 2027?
faqs.answer: The official notification is Examination Notice No. 01/2027-GEOL (File No. 04/01/2026-E.I(B)) released on 02 September 2026. Online applications can be submitted up to 22 September 2026 till 18:00 Hours.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are announced in UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination 2027?
faqs.answer: A total of 127 vacancies are notified across two categories: 111 vacancies in Geological Survey of India (GSI, Ministry of Mines) and 16 vacancies in Central Ground Water Board (CGWB, Ministry of Jal Shakti).

faqs.question: What are the pay scales for Group 'A' and Group 'B' posts under UPSC CGSE 2027?
faqs.answer: Group 'A' posts (Geologist, Chemist, Scientist 'B') carry Pay Level-10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500/-) with basic pay ₹56,100/-. Group 'B' posts (Assistant Geologist, Assistant Geophysicist, Assistant Chemist, Assistant Hydrogeologist) carry Pay Level-8 (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100/-) with basic pay ₹47,600/-.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for calculating age in UPSC CGSE 2027?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 32 years of age as on 01 January 2027 (born between 02 January 1995 and 01 January 2006). Standard relaxations apply: SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10 years), Ex-Servicemen (5 years), and Departmental GSI/CGWB employees (up to 5 years).

faqs.question: Are candidates appearing in their final year of Master's Degree eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates who have appeared or are appearing in the qualifying M.Sc / M.Tech examination can apply provisionally. They must submit proof of passing within 10 days of the declaration of Stage-II Main examination results.

faqs.question: Are Stage-I Preliminary examination marks counted towards the final merit ranking?
faqs.answer: YES! Unlike civil services where prelims is purely screening, in UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, marks obtained in Stage-I Prelims (400 Marks) ARE COUNTED along with Stage-II Main (600 Marks) and Stage-III Interview (200 Marks) for a combined total of 1,200 Marks to determine final merit and service allocation.

faqs.question: What are the examination dates for Stage-I Prelims and Stage-II Mains?
faqs.answer: The Combined Geo-Scientist (Preliminary) Examination is scheduled for 10 January 2027 (Sunday). The Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Examination will be conducted on 19 June 2027 & 20 June 2027.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for both GSI and CGWB posts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates eligible for both Category-I (GSI) and Category-II (CGWB) posts within their stream need to fill in only ONE online application form and pay the application fee only once.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and who is exempt?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹200/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All Female candidates, Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are completely exempted from payment of fee.

faqs.question: Are calculators allowed in the examination?
faqs.answer: Calculators are strictly PROHIBITED in Stage-I Preliminary (Objective) Examination. However, battery-operated non-programmable pocket calculators are PERMITTED in Stage-II Main (Conventional Descriptive) Examination.

overview: The Collector and District Magistrate Office, Thane (जिल्हाधिकारी व जिल्हादंडाधिकारी कार्यालय, ठाणे) has officially issued recruitment advertisement notice No. कक्ष-४/सेतू/कावि ०८/२०२६ for the establishment of 381 Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras (ASSK / Maha e-Seva Kendra) across rural Gram Panchayats in Thane district.

Under the administrative guidelines of the General Administration Department (GAD) and Information Technology Department, Government of Maharashtra (GR dated 19 January 2017, 27 March 2025, 02 June 2025, and Corrigendum dated 09 July 2026), eligible Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLE) will be appointed to provide government-to-citizen (G2C) and business-to-consumer (B2C) digital services at the village level.

The selection is conducted by the District Level Selection Committee (जिल्हा सेतू समिती) headed by the District Collector based on a comprehensive 100-Marks Evaluation Matrix covering educational qualification, computer skills, infrastructure capability, financial stability, and personal interview. Applications require a two-step process: online registration via Google Form by 20 September 2026, followed by physical submission of printed forms and documents to the respective Taluka Resident Naib Tehsildar by 22 September 2026 (up to 6:15 PM).

faqs.question: How many Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras are to be established in Thane district under this advertisement?
faqs.answer: A total of 381 Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras (ASSK) are being established across rural Gram Panchayats in 6 talukas of Thane district.

faqs.question: What is the taluka-wise breakdown of 381 ASSK centers in Thane?
faqs.answer: The distribution is: Kalyan - 115 centers, Bhiwandi - 111 centers, Murbad - 76 centers, Shahapur - 48 centers, Ambernath - 27 centers, and Thane - 4 centers.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for Thane ASSK recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The online Google Form must be submitted between 20 August 2026 and 20 September 2026. The physical dossier must be submitted to the respective Taluka Resident Naib Tehsildar by 22 September 2026 (up to 6:15 PM).

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra operator?
faqs.answer: The minimum qualification is 12th Pass (Higher Secondary Certificate - HSC). Candidates with basic computer literacy (MSCIT or equivalent) are preferred. Additional marks are awarded for Degree (+2 marks) and Post Graduation (+5 marks).

faqs.question: Is local residency mandatory for applying to a specific Gram Panchayat center?
faqs.answer: Yes, the applicant must strictly be a local resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat area. Proof of local residence issued by the Gram Panchayat must be attached.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Thane ASSK recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The applicant must have completed a minimum of 18 years of age. There is no upper age limit specified in the official notification.

faqs.question: How will candidates be evaluated and selected for ASSK?
faqs.answer: Selection is strictly based on a 100-Marks Evaluation Matrix defined by Maharashtra Government Corrigendum dated 09 July 2026, comprising Education (10), Computer Literacy (15), Infrastructure (15), Financial Capacity (10), Interview (20), Experience (10), Business Plan (5), Social Inclusivity (5), and Police Verification (10).

faqs.question: What are the minimum infrastructure requirements for setting up an ASSK center?
faqs.answer: The center must have at least 100 sq. ft. of commercial space, 2 computers/laptops, laser printer, scanner, biometric device, webcam, UPS power backup, broadband internet (10 Mbps rural, 20 Mbps urban), CCTV system, and a citizen waiting area.

faqs.question: Where should the physical application form and documents be submitted?
faqs.answer: The printed form and self-attested documents must be submitted in person to the office of the Resident Naib Tehsildar (निवासी नायब तहसीलदार) of the respective Taluka where the applicant is applying.

faqs.question: Can more than one person from the same family apply or get a center?
faqs.answer: No. As per government rules, only one member per family (husband, wife, unmarried children) is eligible to be granted an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for Thane ASSK recruitment?
faqs.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official advertisement issued by the District Collector Office, Thane.

faqs.question: Who receives preference under the social inclusivity criteria?
faqs.answer: Under government guidelines, 5 marks are reserved for social inclusivity, giving preference to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD), Ex-Servicemen, Women, Self-Help Group (SHG) members, and local entrepreneurs.

faqs.question: What is the initial tenure of the VLE contract for ASSK?
faqs.answer: The selected Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) is initially awarded a contract for 1 year. Renewal for subsequent years depends on performance indicators like transaction volume, citizen satisfaction, and system uptime.

faqs.question: Where can candidates view updates and the final merit list for Thane ASSK?
faqs.answer: All updates, scrutiny notices, interview schedules, and final merit lists will be published on the official district portal https://thane.nic.in.

faqs.question: How many Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras are being recruited in Latur district?
faqs.answer: A total of 640 centers are officially advertised across Latur district, comprising 599 rural Gram Panchayat centers, 10 Municipal Council/Nagar Panchayat centers, and 31 Latur Municipal Corporation (LMC) ward centers.

faqs.question: What are the application start and closing dates for Latur ASSK Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online application opens on 25 August 2026 at 11:00 AM and closes on 15 September 2026 at 05:00 PM through setusamitilatur.in.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and how should it be paid?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-. As per Clause 30 of the notification, the fee must be paid exclusively via QR Code from the applicant OWN bank account, and the payment receipt must be uploaded with the application.

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faqs.answer: The minimum qualification is 12th Pass (HSC). Candidates must also possess an MSCIT or CCC computer certificate. Extra marks are given for Degree (+2 marks) and Post-Graduation (+3 marks).

faqs.question: Is local residency mandatory to apply for a center in Latur?
faqs.answer: Yes. The applicant must be a local resident of the specific Gram Panchayat, Municipal Council, or Latur Municipal Corporation Ward applied for, evidenced by a certificate from Gram Sevak, Chief Officer, or Domicile Certificate.

faqs.question: What is the selection process and evaluation matrix?
faqs.answer: Selection is strictly determined by a 100-Marks Evaluation Matrix defined by Maharashtra Govt Corrigendum dated 09 July 2026: Education (10), Computer & Cyber Skills (15), Infrastructure (15), Financial Capacity (10), Interview (20), Experience (10), Business Plan (5), Social Inclusivity (5), and Police Verification (10).

faqs.question: What hardware and office infrastructure is required?
faqs.answer: An independent commercial office of min 100 sq. ft., 2 computers/laptops, laser printer, scanner, biometric scanner, webcam, power backup (UPS), 10-20 Mbps broadband internet, CCTV system, citizen waiting area, and official fee display board.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for multiple centers or multiple family members get a center?
faqs.answer: No. An applicant can apply for only one center within the district. Furthermore, only one person per family (husband, wife, unmarried children) is eligible to be granted an ASSK center.

faqs.question: What is the taluka-wise rural center distribution in Latur?
faqs.answer: Ahmadpur: 60, Ausa: 79, Chakur: 52, Deoni: 35, Jalkot: 19, Latur (Rural): 61, Nilanga: 82, Renapur: 42, Shirur Anantpal: 17, and Udgir: 58 (Total 599 Rural Centers).

faqs.question: What urban centers are available under this notification?
faqs.answer: 10 centers in Municipal Councils (Udgir: 5, Ahmadpur: 2, Nilanga: 1, Renapur: 1, Deoni: 1) and 31 centers across 18 Wards of the Latur City Municipal Corporation.

faqs.question: What happens if no transaction is conducted after being awarded the center?
faqs.answer: As per Clause 15, if a selected center does not conduct a single transaction within 3 consecutive months of approval, the center authorization will be cancelled without prior notice.

faqs.question: Where will updates, scrutiny lists, and merit lists be published?
faqs.answer: All official notices, scrutiny lists, interview schedules, and final selection orders will be published on the official district portal https://latur.gov.in/.

howToApply: Visit the official MECL website at https://www.mecl.co.in and navigate to the 'Careers' section under 'Advertisement Notices & Results' tab.
Click on the application link for 'Advertisement No. 03/Rectt./2026 - Recruitment for Non-Executive Posts in MECL' (active from 12.09.2026 to 11.10.2026).
Register by providing a valid email address and mobile phone number (which must remain active for at least one year).
Select the desired post (note: one candidate is allowed to apply for ONLY ONE post).
Fill in personal information, category, essential educational qualifications, CGPA to percentage conversion, and relevant work experience details.
Upload clearly scanned self-attested documents in PDF format (maximum 500 KB per group) along with passport-size photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG format.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹500/- online (if applicable; exempted for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-SM/Departmental).
Submit the application before the closing deadline of 11 October 2026 and download the system-generated application printout (no physical copy needs to be mailed to MECL).
documentsRequired: Group 1 (PDF max 500 KB): Aadhaar Card ID proof (mandatory), Driving License (LMV & HMV mandatory for Jr. Driver), Caste/Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL issued on/after 01.04.2026/EWS in DoPT format), PwBD Certificate (40%+ disability), Ex-SM Armed Forces discharge book/tenure certificate.
Group 2 (PDF max 500 KB): Essential Qualification Marks Statement (all terms/semesters or consolidated) and Passing/Degree Certificate issued by recognized University/Institute/ITI.
Group 3 (PDF max 500 KB): 10th Standard Marks Statement & Passing Certificate (DOB proof) and 12th Standard Marks Statement & Passing Certificate.
Group 4 (PDF max 500 KB): Copy of University/Institute CGPA/OGPA percentage conversion norms and Experience Certificates from previous employers with date of joining, relieving, and nature of duties.
Group 5 (PDF max 500 KB): Proof of roles & responsibilities in relevant trade/field, Salary Slips of last 3 months, and NOC from present employer (if currently in Govt/PSU/Autonomous body).
Scanned recent color passport-size photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG format.
importantInstructions: Candidates are strictly allowed to apply for ONLY ONE post from the advertisement.
The cut-off date for reckoning age, educational qualification, and experience is 01 September 2026.
Minimum qualifying marks in essential educational qualification is 45% for direct recruitment to all Non-Executive positions (pass is sufficient for CA/ICWA Inter).
Absence of Colour Blindness and Night Blindness is mandatory for Junior Driver, Mechanic, Mechanic-cum-Operator Drilling, Machinist, Technician Drilling, and Electrician.
Medical examination fee incurred by candidates will be reimbursed by MECL upon submission of original receipt.
As per MoSDE OM dated 19.02.2024, 1-year Apprenticeship training with NAC certificate under Schedule-1 is counted as 1 year work experience for ITI qualification holders.
All Written Examinations, Document Verification, and Skill Tests will be conducted solely in Nagpur City (Maharashtra). No TA will be paid.
Any technical grievance regarding the online portal can be registered on https://cgrs.ibps.in/ between 09:30 AM and 06:00 PM on working days.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in MECL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 122 vacancies have been officially announced under Advertisement No. 03/Rectt./2026 across 16 different posts in Grades W-7, W-4, and W-3 (77 Fresh vacancies and 45 Backlog vacancies).

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for online applications in MECL?
faqs.answer: The online application portal opens on 12 September 2026 and closes on 11 October 2026 at www.mecl.co.in.

faqs.question: What is the crucial cut-off date for reckoning eligibility (age, qualification, and experience)?
faqs.answer: The crucial cut-off date is 01 September 2026 for all posts under Advertisement No. 03/Rectt./2026.

faqs.question: What is the maximum age limit and are there any category relaxations?
faqs.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years for UR/EWS candidates as on 01.09.2026. Age relaxations apply: 5 years for SC/ST (up to 35 years), 3 years for OBC-NCL (up to 33 years), 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates, as per GoI rules for Ex-SM, and up to 20 years for retrenched ex-contingent MECL workmen.

faqs.question: Where will the MECL Written Examination and Skill Tests be held?
faqs.answer: All Written Competitive Examinations, Document Verification, and Skill/Trade Tests will be conducted exclusively in Nagpur City (Maharashtra).

faqs.question: What is the selection process for MECL Non-Executive posts?
faqs.answer: The selection is based on 100% weightage of marks scored in the Written Competitive Examination conducted by an independent public examination authority. Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification in a 1:7 ratio and a qualifying Skill/Trade Test.

faqs.question: What are the minimum qualifying cut-off marks in the Written Examination?
faqs.answer: The cut-off percentage is 50% for UR, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates, and 45% for SC and ST candidates. Relaxed standards apply to PwD candidates as per GoI guidelines.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MECL Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹500/- for General, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and internal MECL employees are completely exempted from payment of fee.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one post in this recruitment drive?
faqs.answer: No. Under Clause 8(xxxvii), candidates are allowed to apply for only one post according to their eligibility and preference.

faqs.question: Is absence of colour blindness mandatory for all posts?
faqs.answer: Absence of colour blindness and night blindness is mandatory under Clause 7(ii) for Junior Driver (W-3), Mechanic (W-4), Mechanic-cum-Operator Drilling (W-4), Machinist (W-4), Technician Drilling (W-4), and Electrician (W-4).

faqs.question: Will MECL reimburse the medical examination fee?
faqs.answer: Yes. The fee incurred for the medical fitness examination by a Govt. Medical Officer or CMO will be reimbursed by MECL upon submission of the original receipt.

faqs.question: Does Apprenticeship training count towards the required work experience?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under Clause 8(xxvii) and MoSDE OM dated 19.02.2024, 1-year Apprenticeship Training with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) under Schedule-1 is counted as 1 year of post-qualification experience for ITI trade posts.

faqs.question: What are the IDA pay scales and starting salaries for MECL Non-Executive posts?
faqs.answer: Accountant is in Grade W-7 (₹22,900 - 55,900/-); Technicians, Assistants, Electrician, Machinist, Mechanic are in Grade W-4 (₹20,200 - 49,300/-); Junior Driver is in Grade W-3 (₹19,600 - 47,900/-), plus IDA, HRA, cafeteria perks, PF, PRP incentives, and medical benefits.

faqs.question: What is the probation period upon appointment in MECL?
faqs.answer: Appointees will be on probation for a minimum period of 1 year from the date of joining, which may be extended by up to 1 additional year based on performance.

faqs.question: What document formats and file sizes are required during online application?
faqs.answer: Certificates and documents must be uploaded in PDF format with a maximum size of 500 KB per category. Photograph and signature must be in JPG/JPEG format.

faqs.question: Where can candidates lodge technical grievances regarding the application portal?
faqs.answer: Candidates may register grievances on the IBPS helpdesk portal at https://cgrs.ibps.in/ from 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM on all working days.

faqs.question: Do applicants need to send physical copies of the application form to MECL?
faqs.answer: No. Applications are accepted solely online through the portal. Applicants should not send physical copies, but must retain a printout of the submitted application form.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: Appointees may be posted at MECL Corporate Office in Nagpur, or at any of MECL's project sites, exploration camps, and offices situated across India or overseas.

overview: Government Medical College & General Hospital, Mahabubnagar, under the administrative control of the Director of Medical Education (DME), Government of Telangana, has officially released Notification No. 02/GMC-MBNR/2026 dated 03 September 2026 for walk-in interviews to recruit 149 positions on a contractual basis.

The recruitment covers 89 Senior Teaching Faculty posts across 22 broad medical specialties (8 Professors, 19 Associate Professors, and 62 Assistant Professors), along with 10 Tutors and 50 Junior Residents (JR) to serve in Govt. Medical College and Government General Hospital, Mahabubnagar up to 31 March 2027 or till regular appointments are made.

The Walk-in-Interview is scheduled on 15 September 2026 from 09:00 AM to 03:00 PM at the Director Office, Edira Campus, Mahabubnagar.

overview: Medical and Health Recruitment Board (MHRB), Assam, operating under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam, has published official recruitment advertisement No. MHRB/73/M&HO-I/2026/5051 dated 3rd September 2026 inviting online applications from eligible Indian citizens for filling up 560 vacancies of Medical & Health Officer–I (M&HO-I) or its equivalent ranks. Selected candidates will be placed in the scale of pay of Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,10,000/- with Grade Pay of Rs. 12,700/- plus admissible allowances under the Government of Assam Rules.

Candidates possessing an MBBS Degree from any recognized University under MCI (Medical Council of India / National Medical Commission) and valid registration under the Assam Medical Council (AMC) are eligible to apply. The age limit is 21 to 38 years as on 01 January 2026, with relaxation applicable for SC, STP, STH, OBC/MOBC, and PwBD candidates. Notably, serving doctors under DME, DHS, NHM Assam, and other state government agencies are eligible to apply without requiring a separate No Objection Certificate (NOC).

Online applications must be submitted via the official portal at https://nhm.assam.gov.in from 07 September 2026 until 20 September 2026. The application fee is Rs. 250/- for General candidates and Rs. 150/- for OBC/MOBC/SC/ST candidates, payable online through GRAS (https://assamegras.gov.in) or offline via Treasury Challan. PwBD candidates are fully exempted from application fees. The selection procedure (written test / viva-voce) will be notified by the Board based on the volume of applications received.

overview: High Court of Delhi has officially published the employment Vacancy Notice dated 02 September 2026 for the Senior Personal Assistant and Personal Assistant Examination 2026 to fill 150 existing Group 'B' Gazetted/Non-Gazetted vacancies and prepare a select panel thereof. The recruitment drive encompasses 117 vacancies for Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) in Pay Level 8 and 33 vacancies for Personal Assistant (PA) in Pay Level 7 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

Candidates possessing a Graduate Degree from a recognized University along with the prescribed English Shorthand and Typing benchmarks (SPA: 110 w.p.m. Shorthand & 40 w.p.m. Typing; PA: 100 w.p.m. Shorthand & 40 w.p.m. Typing on computer) and aged between 18 and 32 years as on 01 January 2026 are eligible to apply. Note that for the post of Personal Assistant (PA), vacancies are exclusively available for reserved categories (EWS: 7, OBC-NCL: 16, SC: 5, ST: 5), with NIL vacancies under the General category. Selected candidates will be posted in the High Court of Delhi, New Delhi, drawing competitive starting salaries of approx. ₹85,000 - ₹95,000/- for SPA and ₹80,000 - ₹90,000/- for PA.

The selection procedure involves a multi-tier assessment: Stage-I English Typing Test (40 w.p.m., Qualifying), Stage-II English Shorthand Test (110/100 w.p.m. transcription, 120/110 Marks), Stage-III Main Descriptive English Examination (Essay, Letter, Grammar, Translation - 100 Marks), and Stage-IV Interview (15 Marks). Online applications can be submitted on the official Delhi High Court portal (www.delhihighcourt.nic.in) from 15 September 2026 (11:00 AM) to 05 October 2026 (11:00 PM), with an application correction window available from 12 to 14 October 2026.

selectionProcess.description: 10 minutes duration on computers to assess minimum speed of 40 words per minute (w.p.m.) in English typing based on 'characters with space'. Maximum mistakes permissible: 3% of total words typed. Qualifying in nature; only qualifying candidates proceed to Stage-II.

For SPA: 110 w.p.m. dictation of 550 words in 5 minutes; 45 minutes computer transcription (120 Marks, max 5% / 27.5 mistakes permissible; 4 marks deducted per full mistake, 2 per half mistake). For PA: 100 w.p.m. dictation of 500 words in 5 minutes; 45 minutes transcription (110 Marks, max 5% / 25 mistakes permissible). Two shorthand tests given; best of two considered.

Descriptive English Test of 100 Marks (120 Minutes duration): Essay of 250 words (40 Marks), Letter Writing (15 Marks), Grammar & Comprehension Passage (25 Marks), and Translation (Hindi to English: 10 Marks & English to Hindi: 10 Marks). Minimum qualifying marks: General 50% (50/100), Reserved/PwBD 45% (45/100).

Interview of 15 Marks (no minimum qualifying cutoff). Final select merit list is prepared by aggregating marks from Stage-II (Shorthand Test), Stage-III (Descriptive Exam), and Stage-IV (Interview). Total Merit: 235 Marks for SPA, 225 Marks for PA.

reservation.title: Reservation & Quota Guidelines of Delhi High Court
detailsList: Vertical Reservations: 15% for SC, 7.5% for ST, 27% for OBC-NCL, and 10% for EWS.

OBC Reservation Condition: Available ONLY to candidates in possession of an OBC Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi for castes recognized as OBC by GNCTD. OBC certificates from other states or Central OBC list alone are NOT recognized. Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate must be issued in the current financial year 2026-2027 (between 01.04.2026 and 31.03.2027).
EWS Reservation: Must possess Income and Asset Certificate issued in accordance with DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt(Res) dated 19.01.2019 and 31.01.2019 valid on the closing date (05.10.2026).

Horizontal Reservation for PwBD: 4% horizontal reservation (7 posts for SPA and 3 posts for PA) for candidates with 40%+ benchmark disability in categories (a) OL, BL, LC, Dw, AAV; (b) ASD (Mild/Moderate), SLD, MI; and (c) Multiple Disabilities.
Ex-Servicemen: No reservation of vacancies for Group 'A' & Group 'B' posts for Ex-Servicemen as per rules, though age relaxation is admissible.
Personal Assistant General Category: NIL vacancies for General (UR) category in PA recruitment; only reserved category candidates (EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST) are eligible to apply.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of High Court of Delhi at https://delhihighcourt.nic.in/.
Step 2: Go to 'Public Notice' -> 'Recruitment - Job Openings' and click on 'Senior Personal Assistant and Personal Assistant Examination 2026'.
Step 3: Read the complete official Vacancy Notice carefully before proceeding with registration.
Step 4: Register online using an active Email ID and Mobile Number to receive system-generated Application Number and Password.
Step 5: Fill in the detailed online application form: personal details, category, educational qualifications, shorthand and typing speed declarations.
Step 6: Live Photograph Capture: Capture and upload a live photograph using your webcam/mobile camera in good lighting. Ensure face covers at least 75% of the photo area without cap/mask/spectacles.
Step 7: Upload scanned passport-size color photograph (100 KB to 200 KB, JPEG, not older than 3 months) which will be verified against the live photo.
Step 8: Upload scanned Left Hand Thumb Impression (50 KB to 200 KB) and Signature in running hand (50 KB to 150 KB, full name in capital letters is rejected).
Step 9: Pay the non-refundable examination fee online (₹1,500/- for Gen/OBC/EWS; ₹1,300/- for SC/ST/PwBD) through UPI, Net Banking, or Credit/Debit Card on or before 05 October 2026 (11:00 PM).
Step 10: Submit the form and download/print the Confirmation Page. (Correction window will be open from 12 to 14 October 2026 with applicable charges).

Proof / Certificate of English Shorthand and Typewriting qualifications (if applicable)
Valid Caste Certificate (SC/ST) issued by Competent Authority on or before 05.10.2026
Valid OBC Certificate and Current Financial Year (2026-2027) Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate issued by Competent Authority of Govt of NCT of Delhi
Valid EWS Income and Asset Certificate for FY 2026-2027 issued on or before 05.10.2026
Disability Certificate (40%+ disability in prescribed category) issued under RPwD Act 2016 for PwBD reservation
Discharge Book / Defense Service Certificate for Ex-Servicemen claiming age relaxation
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer for candidates currently employed in Government / PSUs
Scanned recent color passport photograph (100 KB to 200 KB, 3.5cm x 4.5cm)
Scanned Left Hand Thumb Impression (50 KB to 200 KB)
Scanned Signature in black ink (50 KB to 150 KB, JPEG format)
Valid Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving License, Passport)
importantInstructions: Candidates can apply for both SPA and PA but must submit separate online application forms and pay separate examination fees for each post.
For the post of Personal Assistant (PA), there are NIL vacancies under General (UR) category; all 33 posts are allocated among EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, and ST categories.
OBC reservation is strictly limited to castes included in the Delhi state list having OBC certificate issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi along with a valid NCL certificate for FY 2026-2027.
Live photograph capture is mandatory during the online application process and will be matched with the uploaded passport photo.

All candidates, including PwBD candidates, must participate in and qualify all stages (Typing, Shorthand, Descriptive Exam, and Interview). No scribe or compensatory time is permissible due to court duty requirements.
The application correction window will be open from 12 October 2026 (11:00 AM) to 14 October 2026 (11:00 PM). A charge of ₹200/- is levied for 1st correction and ₹500/- for 2nd correction.
The last date for submission of online applications and fee payment is 05 October 2026 (11:00 PM).

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Senior Personal Assistant and Personal Assistant in Delhi High Court?

overview: Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA), Bengaluru, in coordination with the Department of School Education (Pre-University), Government of Karnataka, has officially released employment advertisement notifications No. ED/KEA/28/Recruitment/2026 (RPC) and ED/KEA/29/Recruitment/2026 (KK) dated 03 September 2026 for the recruitment of 247 Group 'A' Principal (ಪ್ರಾಂಶುಪಾಲರು) vacancies under the Direct Recruitment Quota in Government Pre-University Colleges across the state.

The recruitment encompasses 216 vacancies in the Residual Parent Cadre (RPC) and 31 vacancies in the Kalyana-Karnataka (KK / Article 371-J) Local Cadre. In accordance with state recruitment rules, 100% of these Group 'A' Principal direct recruitment posts are to be filled from eligible in-service Lecturers working across various disciplines in Government Pre-University Colleges who have completed at least 10 years of service and satisfactorily completed their probationary period. Since the posts are filled exclusively from serving government lecturers, there is NO upper age limit (ವಯೋಮಿತಿಯ ಮಿತಿ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ). Selected candidates will be appointed in the 2024 Revised Karnataka State Pay Scale of ₹90,200 - ₹1,59,200/-.

Candidates will be selected through a state-level Competitive Examination comprising three objective MCQ papers (Paper 1: Kannada Language [Qualifying, min 50 marks required], Paper 2: General Studies [150 Marks], and Paper 3: Service Rules, Administration & Education [150 Marks]). Merit ranking will be determined strictly on the combined aggregate score of Paper 2 and Paper 3 (Total 300 Marks), followed by Document Verification in a 1:2 ratio. The online application portal opens on 07 September 2026 and closes on 04 October 2026 at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.

up-anganwadi-anganwadi-karyakartri-angan.applicationStatus: Online Applications Open 04 September 2026 to 24 September 2026
overview: Office of the District Programme Officer, Amroha, Uttar Pradesh (कार्यालय : जिला कार्यक्रम अधिकारी, अमरोहा) has officially released employment advertisement notification No. C-671 / जि०का०अधि० / बा०वि०परि० / विज्ञप्ति / 2026-27 dated 03 September 2026 in accordance with UP Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (197687) dated 17 September 2025. Online applications are invited on http://upanganwadibharti.in for the direct recruitment of 105 vacancies for the honorarium-based post of Anganwadi Karyakatri (आंगनबाड़ी कार्यकत्री / Worker) across seven child development projects in Amroha district.

The 105 vacancies are distributed across Amroha Shahar (Urban - 10), Amroha Dehat (Rural - 9), Dhanaura (Rural - 26), Gajraula (Rural - 17), Gangeshwari (Rural - 6), Hasanpur (Rural - 12), and Joya (Rural - 25). Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned Gram Sabha / Ward (or Nyaya Panchayat if no eligible candidate is available in the Gram Sabha) and aged between 18 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026 are eligible. Applicants must have passed at least Intermediate (10+2 / 12th Pass) or equivalent from a recognized board; higher educational qualifications up to Post Graduation will be credited during academic merit preparation.

Selection is conducted purely on a 100% Merit Basis calculated from academic percentages (Class 10th to Post Graduation) and statutory residency/category priorities. There is NO written examination and NO interview. Priority is accorded to Below Poverty Line (BPL) Widows, legally divorced, and deserted women of the same village/ward. Online applications must be submitted on http://upanganwadibharti.in starting from 04 September 2026 until 24 September 2026 (up to 12:00 Midnight). Offline applications are strictly barred.

reservation.title: Reservation & Priority Guidelines for UP Anganwadi Recruitment
detailsList: Gender Exclusivity: 100% of posts are reserved exclusively for female candidates (केवल महिला अभ्यर्थी ही पात्र होंगी).
First Priority: Widow (विधवा), legally divorced (तलाकशुदा), or deserted (परित्यक्ता) women living below the poverty line (BPL) belonging to the same Gram Sabha / Ward.
Second Priority: Above Poverty Line (APL) widow, legally divorced, or deserted women belonging to the same village/ward in case BPL applicants are unavailable.
Third Priority: General eligible female candidates residing in the same village/ward selected in order of academic merit points.
BPL Income Threshold: Annual household income must not exceed ₹46,080/- for rural candidates and ₹56,460/- for urban candidates (as per GO No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14.09.2015).
Income Certificate: Must be issued by the Competent Tehsildar with online digital verification capability (as per Revenue Dept GO No. 3959/1-9-11-रा०-9 dated 30.09.2021).
Single-Family Restriction: Two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper at the same Anganwadi Center.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official UP Anganwadi recruitment portal at http://upanganwadibharti.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, choose District as 'Amroha', select your Child Development Project (Amroha Shahar, Amroha Dehat, Dhanaura, Gajraula, Gangeshwari, Hasanpur, or Joya), and select your Gram Sabha or Ward.
Step 3: Read the official advertisement (पत्रांक: C-671/जि०का०अधि०/बा०वि०परि०/विज्ञप्ति/2026-27 dated 03.09.2026) and eligibility instructions thoroughly.
Step 4: Click on 'Register' and enter your active Mobile Number and Aadhaar details to generate your registration number and password.
Step 5: Fill in your personal details, guardian/husband name, date of birth, category, and marital status (Widow/Divorced/General).
Step 6: Enter your educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, Post Graduation) with exact roll numbers, marks obtained, and maximum marks.
Step 7: Upload self-attested scanned copies of educational marksheets, digital domicile certificate with ward/village details, income certificate, and caste certificate.
Step 8: Upload recent passport size photograph and signature in clear readable format.
Step 9: Thoroughly review all entered details in the application preview window; offline or post-submission changes will not be permitted.
Step 10: Submit the application online before the deadline of 24 September 2026 (12:00 Midnight) and download/print the final application confirmation slip.

overview: The Office of the District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal District, Government of Andhra Pradesh has officially issued notification WDC02-ESTOAS(AWS)/1/2025-SA(1)-WDCWNDL (dated 02 September 2026) for filling 70 vacancies across 6 ICDS Projects. The recruitment drive covers 3 posts of Main Anganwadi Worker (మేయిన్ అంగన్వాడీ కార్యకర్త) and 67 posts of Anganwadi Helper / Ayah (అంగన్వాడీ ఆయా) across Anganwadi Centres located in Atmakur, Nandyal, Dhone, Allagadda, Banaganapalli, and Nandikotkur Projects.

Candidates must be married women and local permanent residents of the respective village/ward/habitation where the Anganwadi Centre is situated. Applicants must have passed 10th Class (SSC / Matriculation) and be aged between 21 to 35 years as on 01 July 2026. In designated SC/ST agency/habitation areas, if candidates aged 21 years are not available, the lower age limit is relaxed to 18 years.

Eligible candidates must submit their application forms along with self-attested photocopies of certificates in person at the respective Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) offices. The application window is open from 05 September 2026 (10:30 AM) to 18 September 2026 (05:00 PM) on all working days. Candidates can view official updates on the Nandyal District official portal at nandyal.ap.gov.in.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are announced in Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 70 vacancies are officially announced: 3 Main Anganwadi Worker (AWW) posts and 67 Anganwadi Helper (AWH) posts across 6 ICDS projects in Nandyal District.

faqs.question: What is the official Notification Number for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment?
faqs.answer: The official notification number is WDC02-ESTOAS(AWS)/1/2025-SA(1)-WDCWNDL, dated 02 September 2026, issued by the Office of the District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal.

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification required for Anganwadi Worker and Helper?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th Class (SSC / Matriculation). For Anganwadi Helper, if 10th pass candidates are not available in the local village, candidates with lower qualification will be considered.

faqs.question: Can unmarried women apply for Nandyal Anganwadi posts?
faqs.answer: No. As per Andhra Pradesh Women & Child Development Department regulations, only married women candidates residing locally in the respective Anganwadi Centre habitation are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Nandyal Anganwadi recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years of age as on 01 July 2026 (01.07.2026). In SC/ST agency/habitation areas, if 21-year-old candidates are not available, the lower age limit is relaxed to 18 years.

faqs.question: What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faqs.answer: The deadline for submitting the application in person at the respective CDPO office is 18 September 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where should the application forms be submitted?
faqs.answer: Filled-in application forms with self-attested document photocopies must be submitted directly in person at the concerned Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office in the mandal/project.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for Nandyal Anganwadi posts?
faqs.answer: No. Application is completely free of cost for all categories of women applicants.

faqs.question: Which ICDS projects in Nandyal District have vacancies?
faqs.answer: Vacancies are available across 6 ICDS Projects: Atmakur (16 posts), Nandyal (8 posts), Dhone (8 posts), Allagadda (13 posts), Banaganapalli (6 posts), and Nandikotkur (19 posts).

faqs.question: What is the monthly honorarium for Anganwadi Workers and Helpers in Andhra Pradesh?
faqs.answer: Selected Main Anganwadi Workers receive a monthly honorarium of ₹11,500/-, while Anganwadi Helpers receive ₹7,000/- per month, plus admissible scheme incentives.

faqs.question: What documents must be attached with the application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates must attach SSC marks list, TC, Date of Birth proof, Tahsildar Nativity/Residence certificate, Caste certificate, Aadhaar card, Ration card, and Widow/PH certificates (if applicable).

faqs.question: Who is the Chairman of the Nandyal District Selection Committee?
faqs.answer: The District Selection Committee is chaired by Smt. G. Rajakumari, I.A.S., District Collector & District Magistrate, Nandyal District.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the official notification PDF?
faqs.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the official Nandyal District portal at nandyal.ap.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is there a written exam for Nandyal Anganwadi selection?
faqs.answer: No written examination is conducted. Selection is made based on SSC academic merit, document verification, local residency validation, and social category guidelines approved by the District Selection Committee.

faqs.question: Are widow and disabled candidates given any preference?
faqs.answer: Yes, as per AP ICDS rules, preference is given to local eligible widows, orphans, and differently-abled (PwBD) female applicants provided requisite valid certificates are submitted.

overview: Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC), Patna has officially published employment notification Advt. No. 11/2026 for the recruitment of 65 vacancies for the post of Gulma Samadesta / Company Commander (गुल्म समादेशक) under the Home Department (Special Branch), Government of Bihar in the Bihar Home Guard Service Cadre (बिहार गृह रक्षा वाहिनी सेवा संवर्ग). The recruitment is specifically conducted for eligible enrolled and trained Home Guards (including daily duty allowance sports personnel) possessing a graduate degree and minimum 5 years of duty experience.

Selected candidates will be appointed in Pay Level-6 with attractive state allowances, medical benefits, and structured career progression as gazetted supervisory officers in Bihar Home Guard. The selection process consists of two-stage objective written competitive examination (Preliminary Examination of 200 marks and Main Examination comprising General Hindi and General Studies of 200 marks each, with 0.2 negative marking), followed by Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standard Test (PST), medical examination, and character verification. Final merit list is framed strictly on the basis of marks scored in Main Written Examination Paper-2.

Online applications must be submitted via the official BPSSC portal at bpssc.bihar.gov.in under the 'Home Guard' tab. The online application window commences on 10 September 2026 and closes on 10 October 2026. All categories of applicants (Male, Female, and Third Gender) are required to pay a uniform application fee of Rs. 100/- online.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standards Test (PST)
selectionProcess.description: Mandatory qualifying assessment comprising 1.6 km run in 6m 30s (male) / 1.0 km in 6m (female), High Jump, Long Jump, Shot Put, Height, and Chest measurement.
Prepared strictly in order of merit based on marks obtained in Main Examination Paper-2 among candidates who qualify PET/PST.
Pre-appointment medical fitness test and antecedent verification by Deputy Commandant General, Bihar Home Guard, Patna.

howToApply: Visit the official website of Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission at https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in.
Navigate to the 'Home Guard' tab and click on the link for 'Advt. No. 11/2026 - Apply Online for Gulma Samadesta (Company Commander)'.

Step 1 (Registration & Fee Payment): Fill in candidate name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, Bihar domicile, reservation category, gender, and date of birth. Pay the online application fee of Rs. 100/-.
Receive Registration Number and Password on registered mobile SMS and email.

Step 2 (Application Form): Log in using credentials and enter father/husband name, mother name, permanent & correspondence address, educational qualifications (Graduation details), and Bihar Home Guard service/training certificate details.

Upload scanned color photograph (white background, taken within 2 months, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format) and scanned signatures in Hindi and English (black or blue ink, 15-25 KB, white background).
Review all entries using the 'Edit Details' button before final submission. Click 'Submit' to finalize the application.
Download and print the Confirmation Page / Acknowledgement Slip on A4 size paper for document verification and future reference.
documentsRequired: Matriculation / 10th Board Certificate as Date of Birth proof.
Graduation Degree Certificate and Mark Sheets (completed on or before 01 August 2026).
Certificate of 5 Years Training and Completed Duty as an enrolled Bihar Home Guard issued by Bihar Home Guard Headquarters / Commandant.
Certificate verifying at least 10 years of remaining service as on 01 August 2026.
Bihar State Domicile / Residential Certificate issued by competent revenue authority.
Caste Certificate (SC/ST) / Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate (BC/EBC) issued based on father's name & residence.
Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates for FY 2025-2026.
Grandchildren of Freedom Fighter Certificate issued by DM (if claiming 2% horizontal quota).
Transgender Identity Certificate issued by District Magistrate under Form-3 (if applicable).
Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card).
Scanned copies of recent passport-size color photograph and signatures in Hindi and English.
importantInstructions: Only enrolled and trained personnel of Bihar Home Guard (बिहार गृह रक्षा वाहिनी) with minimum 5 years duty experience and minimum 10 years remaining service are eligible.
Married female candidates claiming reservation must submit Caste/NCL certificates issued in the name and address of their father, not husband.
A uniform non-refundable fee of Rs. 100/- applies to all categories. Chargeback claims after submission will lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action.
A candidate can submit only ONE application form using a single mobile number and email ID. Multiple applications will lead to rejection of all submissions.
No physical copies of the application form need to be sent to BPSSC, but candidates must retain the printed acknowledgement slip for document verification.
Negative marking of 0.2 marks applies for each wrong answer in both Preliminary and Main Written Examinations.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are released under BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 65 vacancies are officially released for the post of Gulma Samadesta / Company Commander (गुल्म समादेशक) under the Bihar Home Guard Service Cadre, including 22 horizontal quota posts for domicile women.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for Company Commander under Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: Enrolled and trained Home Guards of Bihar Home Guard Organization who have completed at least 5 years of duty as of 01.08.2026, possess a Bachelor's Degree (Graduation), and have at least 10 years of remaining service are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for BPSSC Company Commander?
faqs.answer: The post carries Pay Level-6 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with starting basic pay of Rs. 35,400/- per month plus admissible state DA, HRA, and medical allowances.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for BPSSC Company Commander recruitment?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 24 to 50 years as on the cut-off date of 01 August 2026 for all categories of candidates based on Matriculation certificate.

faqs.question: What is the online application start and last date?
faqs.answer: Online application registration starts on 10 September 2026 and closes on 10 October 2026 on the BPSSC official website.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for all categories of candidates (Male, Female, Transgender / General, EWS, BC, EBC, SC, ST).

faqs.question: What is the selection process for Company Commander in Bihar Home Guard?
faqs.answer: Selection includes: (1) Preliminary Written Exam (200 marks, GK & Current Affairs), (2) Main Written Exam (Paper 1 Hindi 200 marks qualifying + Paper 2 General Studies 200 marks), (3) Physical Efficiency Test (PET), (4) Physical Standard Test (PST), and (5) Medical & Antecedent Verification.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in BPSSC Company Commander exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, 0.2 marks will be deducted for each incorrect answer in both Preliminary and Main Written Examinations.

faqs.question: How is the final merit list prepared for Company Commander?
faqs.answer: The final merit list is prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper-2 (General Studies - 200 marks) of the Main Examination among candidates qualifying the PET and PST.

faqs.question: What are the physical standards (Height & Chest) required for male candidates?
faqs.answer: Height: Minimum 165 cm for General/BC males; Minimum 160 cm for EBC/SC/ST males. Chest: 81-86 cm for General/BC/EBC males; 79-84 cm for SC/ST males (min 5 cm expansion).

faqs.question: What are the physical standards for female candidates?
faqs.answer: Female candidates of all categories must have a minimum height of 155 cm and a minimum weight of 48 kg. There is no chest measurement for women.

faqs.question: What are the PET running criteria for male and female applicants?
faqs.answer: Male candidates must complete a 1.6 km (1 mile) run within 6 minutes 30 seconds. Female candidates must complete a 1.0 km run within 6 minutes.

faqs.question: Can direct civilian graduates apply for this vacancy?
faqs.answer: No. As per Advt. No. 11/2026, the post of Gulma Samadesta is reserved specifically for enrolled and trained members of the Bihar Home Guard Organization who have completed at least 5 years of duty.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for caste and reservation claims for married women?
faqs.answer: Married female candidates must submit Caste and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificates issued on the basis of their father's name and permanent residence, not their husband's.

faqs.question: Where can I apply online for BPSSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates can apply online directly through the official BPSSC portal at https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in under the 'Home Guard' tab starting 10 September 2026.

faqs.answer: Candidates must possess the requisite degree and final mark sheet on or before the crucial closing date specified in the notification.

The recruitment is open for candidates possessing ITI trade certifications in designated mechanical, automotive, and electrical trades. Selected candidates will be appointed on a 5-year contractual basis with a fixed monthly remuneration of ₹21,100/-, after which they will be absorbed into regular pay scales upon satisfactory service.

The 2,510 vacancies are distributed across Unreserved/General (1,003 posts), SEBC/OBC (659 posts), ST (417 posts), EWS (261 posts), and SC (170 posts), with substantial horizontal reservations of 502 posts for Ex-Servicemen and 52 posts for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD/Divyang). Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on the closing date, with statutory upper age relaxations up to 45 years applicable for reserved categories, women, and PwD candidates.

The selection will be finalized through a comprehensive merit scheme consisting of a 100-mark OMR/CBRT Objective Examination (carrying 90% weightage) and NCVT Trade Apprenticeship Certificate (carrying 10% weightage), followed by document verification of 1.5 times the shortlisted candidates. Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the OJAS Gujarat portal (https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in) between 07 September 2026 and 06 October 2026, with the process fee payable up to 08 October 2026.

education: Minimum Educational Qualification: Must have passed at least a 1-year course from a Government-recognized Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in any of the following 13 trades:
1. Mechanic Motor Vehicle (MMV)
2. Mechanic Diesel
3. General Mechanic
4. Fitter
5. Turner
6. Electrician
7. Sheet Metal Worker
8. Auto Mobile Body Repairer
9. Welder or Welder cum Fabricator
10. Machinist
11. Carpenter
12. Painter General
13. Auto Mobile Paint Repairer

Preferential / Additional Qualification: Candidates who have completed Apprenticeship in the same trade from a Government / Semi-Government / Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) / Limited or Private Limited Company and possess the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) certificate and marksheet will receive 10 marks weightage in final merit.

Computer Literacy: Must possess basic computer knowledge certificate in accordance with Gujarat Government GAD Resolution No. CRR-10-2007-120320-G.5 dated 13/08/2008 (CCC certificate from recognized training institute, or Diploma/Degree with computer subject, or Class 10th/12th passed with computer subject).
Medical & Physical Standards: Clear vision is mandatory (ચોખ્ખું વિઝન હોવું જોઈએ) with sound physical and mental health suitable for heavy automotive repair, maintenance, and workshop helper duties.

Reserved Female Candidates (SEBC, EWS, SC, ST): 10 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
General PwD (Divyang) Male Candidates: 10 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
General PwD (Divyang) Female Candidates: 15 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
Reserved PwD (Divyang) Male Candidates: 15 Years relaxation (Up to 45 Years)
Reserved PwD (Divyang) Female Candidates: 20 Years relaxation (Capped at 45 Years)
Ex-Servicemen: Total military service rendered plus 3 years (Up to 45 Years)
Maximum Age Cap: Under no circumstances shall the maximum age with all relaxations exceed 45 years as on the closing date.
eligibility.medicalStandards: Must possess clear eyesight (ચોખ્ખું વિઝન) and sound physical health suitable for workshop/depot operations. PwD candidates with benchmark disabilities (minimum 40%) must produce valid medical certificates issued by Civil Surgeon/Medical Board.

selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) exam consisting of 100 questions for 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). Carries 90% weightage (maximum 90 marks) towards the final merit.

Candidates who completed an NCVT Trade Apprenticeship in the same trade from Govt/Semi-Govt/PSU/Reputed Company receive 10% weightage (maximum 10 marks). Candidates without apprenticeship receive 0 marks in this component.

Candidates shortlisted at a ratio of 1:1.5 times the category-wise vacancies based on combined merit (Written Exam 90% + Apprenticeship 10%) will be called for scrutiny of original certificates, ITI marksheets, NCVT certificate, caste certificates, and identity proof.

Provisional merit list and a 20% waiting list (valid for 2 years or until next recruitment) will be published. Selected candidates will be allotted divisions/depots across Gujarat according to Corporation requirements.

howToApply: Visit the official OJAS Gujarat recruitment portal at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Click on 'Apply Online' on the homepage and select the Helper Cadre ('હેલ્પર કક્ષા') under GSRTC recruitment.
Click on 'Apply Now' to open the online application form and fill in Personal Details accurately (fields marked with red asterisk are mandatory).
Under 'Educational Qualification', select Minimum Qualification and enter your ITI Trade details, Institute, Year of Passing, and percentage.
Under 'Additional Educational Qualification', enter your NCVT Trade Apprenticeship details (if completed in the same trade).
Under 'Computer Knowledge', enter your basic computer qualification details in accordance with Government guidelines.
Read the self-declaration carefully, check 'Yes' to accept terms, and click 'Save' to generate your unique Application Number.
Click 'Upload Photograph' and 'Upload Signature' to upload scanned JPG images (under 10 KB each; Photo: 5 cm x 3.6 cm; Signature: 2.5 cm x 7.5 cm).
Click 'Confirm Application', enter your Application Number and Date of Birth, verify preview details, and click 'Confirm' to generate your permanent 'Confirmation Number'.

Click on 'Online Payment of Fees', enter your Confirmation Number and Date of Birth, and pay the examination process fee (₹300+GST for General; ₹200+GST for Reserved/Women/PwD/Ex-SM) via the payment gateway.
After successful payment, print and retain a copy of the confirmed Application Form and Fee Receipt for document verification.
documentsRequired: Printed copy of Confirmed Online Application Form with Confirmation Number
Original ITI Marksheets and National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the applied trade
NCVT Trade Apprenticeship Certificate and Marksheet (for 10 marks weightage, if applicable)
SSC / Class 10th Marksheet and School Leaving Certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
Basic Computer Knowledge Certificate (CCC / Diploma / Degree / 10th or 12th with computer subject)
Caste / Category Certificate for SC / ST / SEBC / EWS candidates issued by competent authority
Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate (Parishisht-4 / Annexure-A) for SEBC candidates (for married women, based on parents' income)
Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates (Annexure-KH / Parishisht-G)
Valid Disability Certificate issued by Civil Surgeon / Medical Board (for PwD candidates, min 40%)
Discharge Book, Identity Card, and Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
Sports Representation Certificate in prescribed format from competent sports authority (if claiming sports weightage)
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for Govt / Semi-Govt / Board employees
Valid Photo Identity Card (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or PAN Card) and 2 passport-size photographs
importantInstructions: Application Mode: Only online applications submitted via https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in will be accepted. Offline or physical applications will be rejected.

Multiple Applications: If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last confirmed application with deposited fees will be considered valid; earlier forms will be automatically cancelled.
Mobile & Email: The registered mobile number and email ID must be kept active until the recruitment process concludes, as all updates and SMS alerts will be sent there.

Apprenticeship Trade Alignment: The NCVT Apprenticeship certificate will only yield 10 marks weightage if completed strictly in the same ITI trade as the applicant's basic qualification (e.g. Electrician ITI with Electrician Apprenticeship).
Posting: Appointed candidates can be deployed to any division, depot, or central workshop of GSRTC across Gujarat depending on administrative requirements.

faqs.question: What is the total number of Helper vacancies advertised by GSRTC?
faqs.answer: GSRTC has released 2,510 vacancies for the post of Helper under Advertisement No. GSRTC/202627/47.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary for GSRTC Helper during the contract period?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of ₹21,100/- for 5 years on a contractual basis, after which they will be eligible for regular appointment in the Helper cadre.

faqs.question: What is the required educational qualification for GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed at least a 1-year course from a Government-recognized ITI in Motor Mechanic, Mechanic Diesel, Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Carpenter, Painter, Sheet Metal Worker, or Auto Mobile Paint/Body Repairer.

faqs.question: How is the 10 marks weightage for Apprenticeship awarded?
faqs.answer: Candidates who completed an NCVT Trade Apprenticeship in the same ITI trade from a Government, Semi-Government, PSU, or registered Limited/Pvt Ltd company receive 10 marks weightage. Those without apprenticeship receive 0 out of 10.

faqs.question: What is the selection process and marks distribution for GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: The selection scheme has a total weightage of 100 marks: 90 marks (90% weightage) from a 100-mark MCQ written exam (OMR or CBRT) and 10 marks (10% weightage) from the NCVT Apprenticeship certificate. Merit candidates at a 1:1.5 ratio are called for document verification.

faqs.question: What is the exam syllabus and pattern for the written test?
faqs.answer: The 2-hour written test has 100 MCQs (100 Marks): Gujarat GK, History, Geography & Current Affairs (30 Marks), Gujarati Grammar (5 Marks), English Grammar (5 Marks), Trade/Technical Subject Questions (50 Marks), and Basic Computer Knowledge (10 Marks).

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for online applications?
faqs.answer: Online applications on OJAS Gujarat opened on 07 September 2026 and will close on 06 October 2026 (23:59 hrs). The examination process fee can be paid until 08 October 2026 (23:59 hrs).

faqs.question: What is the application fee for GSRTC Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: General (Unreserved) candidates must pay ₹300/- + GST. Reserved category candidates (All Female applicants, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen) must pay ₹200/- + GST.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for calculating age?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be aged between 18 and 35 years as on 06 October 2026 (Born between 06/10/1991 and 06/10/2008). Upper age relaxation of 5 to 20 years applies to reserved categories, women, and PwD candidates, subject to a maximum age cap of 45 years.

faqs.question: Is computer knowledge compulsory for applying to GSRTC Helper?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess basic computer knowledge certification (CCC or equivalent) as per Gujarat Government General Administration Department resolution dated 13/08/2008.

faqs.question: What are the specifications for uploading photograph and signature on OJAS?
faqs.answer: Photograph and signature must be in JPG format and not exceed 10 KB each. Photograph size should be 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width, and Signature size should be 2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width.

faqs.question: What are the rules for SEBC Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate?
faqs.answer: SEBC candidates must produce a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (Parishisht-4 in Gujarati or Annexure-A in English) for financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26, issued between 01/04/2024 and 06/10/2026. For married female candidates, it must be based on parents' income.

faqs.question: What are the rules for EWS Income and Asset Certificate?
faqs.answer: EWS candidates must possess a certificate (Annexure-KH or Parishisht-G) issued between 07/10/2023 and 06/10/2026, or an Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26 issued between 01/04/2026 and 06/10/2026.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates can be posted to any division, depot, or central workshop across Gujarat according to operational requirements of the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the official notification and apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates can download the official notification and apply online on the OJAS Gujarat portal at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in and check regular updates on https://gsrtc.in.

examPattern.subject: General Knowledge, Gujarat History, Geography & Current Affairs of Gujarat (Class 10 Level)

syllabus.General Knowledge & Gujarat Affairs: Gujarat History, Geography, Culture, Heritage, Administrative Setup, Important Monuments, Rivers, Dams, State Government Welfare Schemes, and Current Affairs of Gujarat and India (Class 10 Standard).
syllabus.Gujarati Grammar: Class 10 Standard Gujarati Vyakaran covering Sandhi, Samas, Alankar, Chhand, Jodni (Spelling rules), Samanarthi (Synonyms), Viruddharthi (Antonyms), Shabda Samuh mate Ek Shabda, and Ruhiprayogo.
syllabus.English Grammar: Class 10 Standard English Grammar including Tenses, Articles (A, An, The), Prepositions, Active and Passive Voice, Direct and Indirect Speech, Spotting Errors, Spelling Correction, and Basic Vocabulary.
syllabus.Trade & Technical Subject: Trade-specific technical questions based on ITI curriculum for Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Diesel Mechanic, Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Carpenter, Sheet Metal Worker, and Painter (Engines, Cooling/Lubrication, Fuel Systems, Electrical Circuits, Workshop Tools, Safety Practices, Measuring Instruments, Maintenance).
syllabus.Basic Computer Knowledge: Fundamental computer concepts, Windows OS, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Web Browsing, Email, Internet Banking, File Management, and Keyboard Shortcuts.

overview: The Directorate of Tourism, Government of Kerala, in coordination with the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, has issued official recruitment notification No. CMD/DoT/01/2026 (dated 05 September 2026) for the engagement of 162 Green Marshals on a daily wage basis for a period of one year. Green Marshals will be deployed across designated tourist destinations and eco-tourism sites throughout all 14 districts of Kerala to enforce sustainable tourism practices and the state's Green Protocol in coordination with District Tourism Promotion Councils (DTPCs).

Candidates possessing a minimum educational qualification of SSLC (Class 10th Pass) and aged between 20 and 45 years as on 01 September 2026 are eligible to apply. Selected personnel will receive remuneration of ₹810/- per day based on actual attendance and engagement days. Applicants must select one district of preference, and local residents of the respective district will receive tie-breaking preference in the selection merit list.

Shortlisting will be conducted district-wise strictly on the basis of percentage of marks secured in the SSLC qualifying examination, followed by an interview and proficiency assessment conducted by the Directorate of Tourism. Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the official CMD Kerala portal (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in) from 05 September 2026 (10:00 AM) to 11 September 2026 (05:00 PM). There is no application fee.
