maharashtra-metro-rail-corporation-mts-j.applicationStatus: Active - Apply Offline before 25 September 2026 (18:00 hrs)
overview: Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MAHA-Metro), a premier 50:50 Joint Venture Company of the Government of India and the Government of Maharashtra implementing prestigious metro projects including Nagpur Metro, Pune Metro, Thane Integral Ring Metro, and O&M of Navi Mumbai Metro Line-1, has officially released recruitment advertisement MAHA-Metro/N/HR/05/2026 (dated 10 August 2026). The notification invites offline applications from experienced personnel of Indian nationality holding Maharashtra domicile for 56 supervisory and non-supervisory positions on a 3-year contract basis.

The recruitment drive comprises 40 vacancies for the Nagpur Metro Rail Project and 16 vacancies for the Pune Metro Rail Project. Positions include Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Rolling Stock, S&T) in IDA Pay Scale Rs. 33,000-1,00,000/-, Senior Office Assistant (PR/Library) in Rs. 33,000-1,00,000/-, Office Assistant in Rs. 25,000-80,000/-, Technicians (Civil, Electrical, Diesel Mechanic, Electronic Mechanic) in Rs. 20,000-60,000/-, Multi Tasking Staff cum Motor Driver in Rs. 16,000-50,000/-, and Attendant in Rs. 14,000-40,000/-. Applicants must possess required engineering degrees, diplomas, ITI certificates, or graduate/school credentials along with 3 to 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Metro Rail, Railways, PSUs, or allied infrastructure industries.

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria must submit their physical application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) along with supporting documents, experience proforma (Annexure-II), and application fee (Demand Draft or UPI/BHIM receipt) via Speed Post to the General Manager (HR), Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Nagpur - 440010. Applications must reach on or before 25 September 2026 by 18:00 hrs. The selection process involves a 70-mark Written Test (Online/Offline), a 30-mark Personal Interview (or Oral Aptitude Test for MTS/Attendants), and Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

overview: Central University of Punjab (CUPB), Bathinda (a premier Central University established by an Act of Parliament) has officially issued employment notification Advt. No. CUPB/26-27/012 (dated 02 September 2026) for filling 15 Teaching and Non-Teaching positions purely on temporary and contractual basis. The positions include 1 Contractual Faculty (Self-Finance) in B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, 8 Part-Time Faculty positions on lecture basis across Music, Law, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, and Economics for ITEP B.Sc.-B.Ed. / B.A.-B.Ed., and 6 Contractual Non-Teaching positions (Senior Analyst, Laboratory Assistant, and Laboratory Attendant).

Selected candidates for teaching posts will receive attractive consolidated emoluments up to Rs. 64,000/- per month (or Rs. 1,000/- per lecture up to Rs. 50,000/- per month for part-time faculty). Non-teaching personnel will receive fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 65,000/- (Senior Analyst), Rs. 40,800/- (Laboratory Assistant), and Rs. 28,800/- (Laboratory Attendant). Candidates must possess requisite Master's/Ph.D./NET or B.Tech/Diploma/Degree/10+2 Science qualifications with relevant laboratory or teaching experience.

Candidates must register online on the respective Samarth portals (https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in for Faculty and https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in for Non-Teaching) before the deadline mentioned for each post (09 to 15 September 2026, 10:00 AM). Applicants must attend the Walk-in Interview at the Main Campus, VPO Ghudda, Bathinda with printed online application forms, original documents, experience certificates, and a 10-minute presentation (for faculty positions).

uiic-ao-administrative-officer-scale-i-g.title: UIIC AO Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 225 Administrative Officer (Scale-I) Posts (Generalists & Hindi Officers)
overview: United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a premier wholly-owned Government of India Public Sector General Insurance Company headquartered in Chennai, has officially announced employment notification Ref: HO:HRM:REC:AO:1:2026 (dated 07 September 2026) for open market recruitment of 225 Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in Generalists and Hindi Officer disciplines.

The total 225 vacancies comprise 200 Administrative Officer (Generalists) posts and 25 Administrative Officer (Hindi Officer) posts, with category-wise reservations across UR (79), OBC (69), SC (34), EWS (24), and ST (19), along with 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Selected officers will be placed on the revised pay scale of ₹82,485 - ₹1,56,745 with approximate gross monthly emoluments of ₹1,10,000/- at metropolitan centers, in addition to benefits including leased accommodation, National Pension System (NPS), Gratuity, Medical, and Group Insurance.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) and aged between 21 and 30 years as on 30.06.2026 are eligible to apply. Selection will be finalized through a competitive multi-tier process comprising a Preliminary Examination (Tier-I), Main Examination with Descriptive Test (Tier-II), and Personal Interview. Online registration is open on the official website (https://uiic.co.in) from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 225 vacancies are announced: 200 posts for Administrative Officer (Generalists) and 25 posts for Administrative Officer (Hindi Officers).

faqs.question: What is the starting salary and gross emoluments for UIIC AO Scale-I?
faqs.answer: The basic pay starts at ₹82,485/- on the scale of ₹82,485 - ₹1,56,745. Total gross monthly emoluments are approximately ₹1,10,000/- per month at metropolitan centers, plus leased accommodation, medical, NPS, and other allowances.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for UIIC AO Generalists?
faqs.answer: A Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline (Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized university, along with computer working knowledge.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for UIIC AO Hindi Officers?
faqs.answer: Master's Degree in Hindi with English at bachelor's degree level (min 60% marks, 55% for SC/ST/PwBD) or Master's in English with Hindi at degree level, or Master's in any discipline with Hindi medium and English as a subject.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for UIIC AO 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years old as on 30.06.2026 (born between 30.06.1996 and 30.06.2005). Upper age relaxations: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10 years for PwBD, and up to 45 years cumulative cap.

faqs.question: What are the important dates for online registration and examinations?
faqs.answer: Online registration runs from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026. Tentative exam dates: Tier-I Preliminary Exam on 22 October 2026 and Tier-II Main Exam on 30 November 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates pay ₹1,000/- + applicable GST. SC, ST, PwBD, and UIIC permanent employees pay service charges of ₹250/- + applicable GST (application fee is Nil).

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for Tier-I Preliminary Examination?
faqs.answer: Tier-I is an objective test of 100 marks (60 minutes, 20 mins per section): English Language (30 Qs / 30 Marks), Reasoning Ability (35 Qs / 35 Marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (35 Qs / 35 Marks). Qualifying in nature.

faqs.question: What is the structure of the Tier-II Main Examination?
faqs.answer: For Generalists: 200 objective questions for 250 marks (150 mins) covering English, Reasoning, Quant, Financial General Awareness, and Computers, plus an online descriptive test of 30 marks (Letter & Essay, 30 mins). For Hindi Officers: 150 objective questions for 200 marks plus 50 marks descriptive test.

faqs.question: How is the final merit list calculated for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: Final selection merit is prepared based on marks obtained in Tier-II Main Examination and Personal Interview in the ratio of 75:25. Preliminary marks are not added.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in the UIIC AO online tests?
faqs.answer: Yes. One-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty for every wrong answer in both Preliminary and Main objective examinations.

faqs.question: What are the service bond and probation conditions?
faqs.answer: Appointed officers undergo 1-year probation (must pass Licentiate Exam of III) and sign a 5-year Guarantee Bond. Resigning before 5 years incurs liquidated damages up to 1-year gross salary plus ₹35,000/- onboarding cost.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faqs.answer: Vacancies are substantially in Western and Southern Zones. Candidates selected will likely be posted in Southern/Western offices for a minimum initial period of 5 years without transfer.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for both Generalist and Hindi Officer streams?
faqs.answer: No. A candidate can apply for either Generalists OR Hindi Officers, not both. Registering for both will result in automatic cancellation of all applications.

faqs.question: Where can candidates apply online for UIIC AO?
faqs.answer: Eligible candidates can register online through the recruitment section of the official website at https://uiic.co.in from 08 September 2026 to 28 September 2026.

overview: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have officially released the Detailed Centralised Employment Notification (CEN No. 05/2026) for open-market recruitment to 590 vacancies across Various Categories of Para-Medical staff. These vacancies are distributed across 20 participating RRBs and indenting Zonal Railways/Production Units, categorized under Pay Level 3 to Pay Level 7 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix with initial basic pay scales ranging from ₹21,700 up to ₹44,900 per month plus admissible Central Government allowances.

The notification covers 9 distinct healthcare professions: Nursing Superintendent (365 posts, Level 7), Pharmacist Entry Grade (118 posts, Level 5), Health & Malaria Inspector Grade II (43 posts, Level 6), Laboratory Assistant Grade II (31 posts, Level 3), Radiographer X-Ray Technician (25 posts, Level 5), ECG Technician (4 posts, Level 4), Optometrist (2 posts, Level 4), Dialysis Technician (1 post, Level 6), and Audiologist & Speech Therapist (1 post, Level 6). The selection will be conducted through a Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT) featuring 100 objective questions (70 domain-specific Professional Ability questions and 30 general questions), followed by Document Verification (called in a 1:1 ratio based on CBT merit) and a rigorous Medical Fitness Examination adhering to Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) standards.

Eligible candidates who possess the prescribed educational and technical qualifications from recognized universities/councils as on the closing date must submit their online application through the official centralized portal https://www.rrbapply.gov.in between 15 September 2026 and 14 October 2026 (23:59 hours). Candidates can apply to ONLY ONE RRB; multiple applications will result in summary rejection and lifetime debarment. A 10-day application modification window will be available from 17 October 2026 to 26 October 2026 upon payment of a ₹250 modification fee.

medicalStandards: Medical Standard B-1: Physically fit in all respects. Distant Vision: 6/9, 6/12 with or without glasses (power of lenses not to exceed 4D). Near Vision: Sn 0.6, 0.6 with or without glasses when reading or close work is required. Must pass mandatory tests for Colour Vision, Binocular Vision, Night Vision, and Mesopic Vision. (Prescribed for: Dialysis Tech, Audiologist, Radiographer X-Ray, Optometrist, Lab Assistant Gr II).

Medical Standard C-1: Physically fit in all respects. Distant Vision: 6/12, 6/18 with or without glasses. Near Vision: Sn 0.6, 0.6 with or without glasses when reading or close work is required. (Prescribed for: Nursing Superintendent, Health & Malaria Inspector Gr II, ECG Technician).

Medical Standard C-2: Physically fit in all respects. Distant Vision: 6/12, Nil with or without glasses. Near Vision: Sn 0.6 combined with or without glasses where reading or close work is required. (Prescribed for: Pharmacist Entry Grade).

LASIK Surgery Guidelines: Candidates with LASIK Surgery may be eligible for Medical Standard B-1 subject to strict conditions: (1) No complications related to LASIK surgery observed; (2) LASIK performed at least 1 year prior, supported by certificate from the operating specialist; (3) Residual Corneal Thickness not less than 425 microns on Pachymetry; (4) Visual acuity conforming to Para 512(1)(A) of IRMM Vol. I; (5) Normal fundus; (6) No evidence of progressive eye disease.

Medical Appeal: Candidates failing in initial medical examination may be offered one final opportunity to prefer a Medical Appeal on payment of prescribed charges with laid-down conditions. The result of the Medical Appeal is final and binding.

examCentres.details: Computer Based Test (CBT) will be conducted at multiple designated examination test centres across major cities nationwide under the jurisdiction of the 20 participating RRBs (Ahmedabad, Ajmer, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Bilaspur, Chandigarh, Chennai, Gorakhpur, Guwahati, Jammu-Srinagar, Kolkata, Malda, Mumbai, Muzaffarpur, Patna, Prayagraj, Ranchi, Secunderabad, Siliguri).

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT)
selectionProcess.description: A 90-minute online examination (120 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates using a scribe) consisting of 100 objective multiple-choice questions (MCQs). Marks distribution: 70 questions on Professional Ability (discipline syllabus), 10 questions on General Awareness, 10 questions on General Arithmetic & Reasoning, and 10 questions on General Science. Negative marking of 1/3rd (0.33) mark per wrong answer. Normalization of marks will be applied for CBTs held in multiple shifts.

Candidates are shortlisted for Document Verification strictly in order of merit in CBT (subject to securing minimum qualifying cutoff marks) at a 1:1 ratio against notified vacancies. Candidates must upload true-color scanned copies of photograph and signature prior to DV date via https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv and produce all original documents along with 2 sets of self-attested photocopies.

Shortlisted candidates who successfully clear Document Verification are sent for a comprehensive Medical Fitness Examination conducted by Railway Medical Authorities to ascertain physical fitness and visual acuity under Medical Standards B-1, C-1, or C-2 as prescribed for their allotted post.

reservation.title: Reservation & Age Relaxation Policies (CEN 05/2026)
detailsList: Vertical Reservation: Clear vertical reservation quotas are allocated for SC (106 posts), ST (69 posts), OBC-NCL (113 posts), and EWS (46 posts) across participating Railway Zones and Production Units as specified in Annexure-B.

OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate Validity: Candidates claiming OBC reservation must produce an OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure II) issued on or after 01 April 2026, but not later than 14 October 2026 (closing date of online application), along with a signed Non-Creamy Layer Self-Declaration (Annexure IIA) during DV.

EWS Reservation (Gross Annual Family Income < ₹8 Lakh): Candidates belonging to Economically Weaker Sections must hold an Income and Asset Certificate (Annexure III) issued for the financial year 2025-26 on or before 14 October 2026 by an authorized Revenue Officer (not below Tehsildar).
Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (49 Posts): ExSM candidates are eligible for reservation in earmarked posts and eligible for upper age relaxation and fee exemption across all posts.

Horizontal Reservation for PwBD (40 Posts): 40 vacancies (including 1 backlog vacancy) are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. In terms of Para 11.6, if a full panel for PwBDs cannot be formed with minimum qualifying marks, a relaxation of up to 2 marks in the minimum qualifying marks is permitted.

Economically Backward Class (EBC): EBC candidates whose annual family income is below ₹50,000 are eligible for fee concession (₹250 examination fee). Note: EBC is strictly a fee concession category and does NOT entitle candidates to job reservation.

howToApply: Step 1 - Access Official Centralized Portal: Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in or navigate via the unified website https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.

Step 2 - Account Creation: Click on 'Apply' -> 'Create an Account'. Enter candidate Full Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, and Date of Birth exactly as recorded in the Matriculation / SSLC / 10th Certificate. Active personal Mobile Number and Email ID are mandatory for OTP verification. (Note: Account details and Mobile/Email CANNOT be modified once created). Candidates who previously created accounts for RRB CENs 2024/2025/2026 must log in with their existing credentials.

Step 3 - DigiLocker / Aadhaar Authentication: Candidates are strongly advised to authenticate identity via DigiLocker or Aadhaar during registration to facilitate seamless, expedited verification at examination, DV, and medical stages.

Step 4 - Selection of RRB and Post/Zone Preferences: Choose ONLY ONE RRB from the 20 participating RRBs. Indicate preference for Railway Zones and post categories for which you are eligible and interested. Selection of RRB cannot be changed at any stage. Submitting multiple applications across RRBs will result in summary rejection and lifetime debarment.

Step 5 - Fill Online Application Form: Enter personal details, category data, complete educational and technical qualifications (degree/diploma details, passing year, university, council registration numbers), and communication address.

Step 6 - Live Photo Capture: Follow the live camera module instructions. Sit or stand in front of the webcam or front camera of the smartphone at eye level. Ensure neutral expression, centered face, non-white / dark clothing for backdrop contrast. Do NOT wear caps, masks, or glasses/spectacles. (Uploading pre-existing photos is strictly prohibited and causes rejection).

Step 7 - Upload Scanned Signature & Certificates: Upload scanned signature in running cursive handwriting using black ink on white paper (JPG/JPEG, 30 KB to 49 KB, min 140x60 pixels, scan box 35x20 mm). SC/ST candidates requesting free sleeper class train travel pass must upload their valid caste certificate in PDF format (less than 400 KB).

Step 8 - Pay Examination Fee: Make online fee payment (₹500 for Unreserved/OBC/EWS Male, or ₹250 for SC/ST/ExSM/Female/EBC/Minorities) via Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI before 16 October 2026 (23:59 hours).

Step 9 - Final Verification & Submission: Preview the complete application form thoroughly. Submit the online application on or before 14 October 2026 (23:59 hours). Download and print the confirmation page for record.

Step 10 - Modification Window: If corrections are required after final submission, candidates may utilize the official Modification Window from 17 October 2026 to 26 October 2026 on payment of ₹250 per occasion. (Note: Details filled in 'Create an Account' form and 'Chosen RRB' cannot be modified).
documentsRequired: Live Photograph (captured in real-time via camera module during application filling in dark clothing without spectacles/caps).
Scanned Candidate Signature (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 49 KB, minimum 140x60 pixels, black ink on white paper in cursive running handwriting; block/capital letters strictly rejected).
Matriculation / SSLC / Class 10th Certificate & Marksheet (conclusive proof of Candidate Name and Date of Birth).

Essential Educational & Technical Marksheets & Certificates (GNM, B.Sc Nursing, B.Pharm, D.Pharm, DMLT, B.Sc MLT, Radiography Diploma/Degree, BASLP, ECG Technician Diploma, etc. issued on or before 14 October 2026).
Statutory Council Registration Certificates (Valid registration with Indian/State Nursing Council, Pharmacy Council of India, Rehabilitation Council of India, or relevant Paramedical Council).
SC / ST Caste Certificate (Annexure I format issued by authorized Revenue Officer / Magistrate; PDF < 400 KB required during online application for free rail travel pass).
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate (Annexure II format issued on or after 01 April 2026 but on or before 14 October 2026) along with Self-Declaration (Annexure IIA).
EWS Income and Asset Certificate (Annexure III format issued for FY 2025-26 on or before 14 October 2026 by Tehsildar or higher authority).
EBC Income Certificate (Annexure IIIA format) / BPL Card / Izzat MST for claiming fee concession.
Disability Certificate (Form V / Form VI as per Annexure V(A) and V(B)) with Unique Disability Identity (UDID) for PwBD applicants (minimum 40% benchmark disability).
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for candidates serving in Central/State Government departments, Railways, or PSUs (required at time of DV).
Discharge Certificate, Serving Certificate (Annexure VI-A), and Ex-Servicemen Undertaking (Annexure VI) for Armed Forces personnel.
importantInstructions: Single RRB & Single Application: A candidate can apply to ONLY ONE RRB and submit only ONE online application. Submitting multiple applications to different RRBs or to the same RRB with minor alterations will lead to summary cancellation of all applications and permanent lifetime debarment from all RRB and RRC examinations.

Account Details and Chosen RRB are Immutable: Details entered in 'Create an Account' form (Candidate Full Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, Email ID) and the 'Chosen RRB' CANNOT be modified under any circumstances, even during the application modification window.

Live Photo Capture Mandatory: Uploading a scanned or digital pre-existing photograph is prohibited. Candidates must capture a live photo through webcam or smartphone front camera wearing dark clothing with a neutral expression.

Signature Protocol: Signature must be made by the candidate in running cursive handwriting using black ink on white paper. Signatures written in BLOCK or CAPITAL letters, disjointed letters, or thumb impressions will result in immediate rejection of the application.
Negative Marking: CBT has negative marking @ 1/3rd (0.33) mark for every wrong answer. Unattempted questions incur no penalty.

Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account for Fee Refund: Examination fee refund (₹400 for General/OBC, ₹250 for reserved/exempted categories) will only be credited to the candidate Aadhaar-linked bank account validated during the registration process upon appearing in the CBT.

Crucial Date for Qualifications: The prescribed educational/technical qualifications must be fully completed and acquired on or before the closing date (14 October 2026). Candidates awaiting results of final exams are NOT eligible to apply.

Scribe Facility Registration: Scribes must register on rrbapply.gov.in to obtain an OTR number. Candidates opting for a scribe must submit their scribe OTR details during the designated 5-day window (27 October to 31 October 2026) and verify via OTP.

Pre-DV True Color Scan Upload: Shortlisted candidates called for Document Verification must upload scanned true-color copies of Photo and Signature before their DV date via the portal https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv.
Beware of Touts & Job Racketeers: RRB recruitment is 100% computerized, merit-based, and transparent. Do not fall prey to fraudulent job racketeers or touts promising illegal appointments.

faqs.question: What is RRB CEN No. 05/2026 and how many total vacancies are announced?
faqs.answer: CEN No. 05/2026 is the official Detailed Centralised Employment Notification published by the Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, for direct recruitment to 590 vacancies across Various Categories of Para-Medical posts in Pay Level 3 to Pay Level 7 across 20 participating RRB zones.

faqs.question: What are the opening and closing dates for RRB Paramedical 2026 online applications?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 15 September 2026 and close on 14 October 2026 at 23:59 hours on the centralized portal https://www.rrbapply.gov.in. The deadline for online application fee payment is 16 October 2026 (23:59 hours).

faqs.question: What are the post-wise vacancies notified under RRB CEN 05/2026?
faqs.answer: The 590 vacancies are distributed as follows: Nursing Superintendent (365 posts), Pharmacist Entry Grade (118 posts), Health & Malaria Inspector Grade II (43 posts), Laboratory Assistant Grade II (31 posts), Radiographer X-Ray Technician (25 posts), ECG Technician (4 posts), Optometrist (2 posts), Dialysis Technician (1 post), and Audiologist & Speech Therapist (1 post).

faqs.question: What is the application fee and fee refund policy for RRB Paramedical recruitment?
faqs.answer: The examination fee is ₹500 for General/OBC/EWS Male candidates (out of which ₹400 is refunded upon appearing in CBT), and ₹250 for SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities, and EBC candidates (out of which the entire ₹250 is refunded upon appearing in CBT). All refunds are credited directly to the candidate's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.question: What is the selection process and exam pattern for RRB Paramedical posts?
faqs.answer: The recruitment process comprises a Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Document Verification (1:1 ratio) and Medical Fitness Examination. The CBT consists of 100 objective MCQs to be answered in 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwBD with scribe): 70 questions on Professional Ability (domain syllabus), 10 questions on General Awareness, 10 questions on General Arithmetic & Reasoning, and 10 questions on General Science. Negative marking of 1/3rd mark applies for wrong answers.

faqs.question: What is the crucial date for age calculation and what are the age limits?
faqs.answer: The crucial reference date for age calculation is 01 January 2027. Age limits: Nursing Superintendent: 20–40 years; Pharmacist: 20–35 years; Dialysis Tech, Malaria Inspector, Radiographer, ECG Tech, Optometrist, Lab Assistant: 18/19/20–33 years; Audiologist: 21–30 years. Standard age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and 10–15 years for PwBD are applicable.

faqs.question: How is the candidate photograph submitted during the online application?
faqs.answer: Pre-existing printed or digital photos are NOT permitted. The online application module captures a live photograph of the candidate in real-time using a computer webcam or smartphone front camera. Candidates must wear dark/non-white clothing for background contrast, look straight into the camera, and not wear caps, masks, or spectacles.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply to more than one Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)?
faqs.answer: NO. Candidates can choose ONLY ONE RRB and submit only ONE application. Submitting multiple applications to different RRBs or to the same RRB will lead to summary cancellation of all applications and permanent lifetime debarment from all future RRB and RRC examinations.

faqs.question: When is the application modification window open and what details can be edited?
faqs.answer: The application modification window is open from 17 October 2026 to 26 October 2026 upon payment of a non-refundable modification fee of ₹250 per occasion. Please note: Details filled in the 'Create an Account' form (Name, DOB, Mobile Number, Email ID) and the 'Chosen RRB' CANNOT be modified.

faqs.question: What are the medical fitness standards required for RRB Paramedical posts?
faqs.answer: Medical standards are: B-1 (Distant vision 6/9, 6/12; near vision Sn 0.6, 0.6; must pass color, binocular, night, and mesopic tests) for Lab Assistant, Radiographer, Optometrist, Dialysis Tech, and Audiologist; C-1 (Distant 6/12, 6/18) for Nursing Superintendent, Health Inspector, and ECG Tech; and C-2 (Distant 6/12, nil) for Pharmacist Entry Grade.

overview: The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Itanagar has officially issued Advertisement No. 5/2026 (Ref No. PSC-R/13/2026 dated 07 September 2026) inviting online applications from eligible citizens of India who are Permanent Residents of Arunachal Pradesh holding APST status for the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Combined Competitive Examination-2026 (APPSCCE-2026). A total of 135 premier Group 'A' and Group 'B' vacancies have been announced across key administrative, police, developmental, and secretariat cadres of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.

The advertised services comprise 60 posts of Arunachal Pradesh Civil Service (Entry Grade) APCS (EG) Group-A, 10 posts of Arunachal Pradesh Police Service (Entry Grade) APPS (EG) Group-A, 05 posts of Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), 04 posts of District Information & Public Relation Officer (DIPRO), 03 posts of District Food & Civil Supply Officer (DF&CSO), 01 post of District Transport Officer (DTO), 02 posts of Labour Officer, 05 posts of Station Superintendent / Assistant Station Superintendent, 06 posts of Tax/Excise/Commerce Inspectors, and 38 posts of Assistant Section Officer (ASO) in the Secretariat Administration Department. Selected officers will be placed under 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) for Group-A, Level-8/9 for Group-B Gazetted, and Level-7 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) for Group-B Non-Gazetted.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's Degree from a UGC-recognized University and aged between 21 and 35 years as on 20 October 2026 (with up to 40 years for APST) can submit their online applications via the APPSC portal (https://appsc.gov.in). Selection involves a 2-stage competitive examination: Preliminary Examination (Objective Type) scheduled for 06 December 2026 (Sunday), followed by Main Examination (Descriptive 8 Papers of 1750 Marks + Physical standards/PET for Police Service) and Viva-Voce / Personality Test (275 Marks).

education: Applicants must hold a Graduate Degree (Bachelor's Degree in any discipline) from any University incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India, or an educational institution established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be deemed as a University under section 3 of UGC Act, 1956, or possess such qualification as declared equivalent by the Government.

Final Year / Appearing Candidates: Candidates who have appeared or intend to appear at the qualifying degree examination are eligible to apply provisionally. However, they must produce the original degree / marksheet issued by competent authority on the day of Interview/Viva-Voce test.
mandatoryCriteria: Permanent Residence Criterion: The candidate must be a citizen of India and an inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) issued by designated Competent Authority under the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.

Indigenous Status and APST Criterion: The candidate must be an original inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh and hold an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) certificate issued by Competent Authority as per Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950.

Indigenous Tribal Language Proficiency Criterion: The candidate must be able to speak any of the Indigenous Tribal Languages of Arunachal Pradesh and possess working knowledge of the local indigenous tribes.
eligibility.ageLimit: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 Years of age as on the closing date of application receipt, i.e., 20 October 2026. Accepted proof of Date of Birth is Matriculation / High School Leaving Certificate or Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate.

selectionProcess.description: Two objective papers (200 marks each, 2 hours duration): Paper-I (General Studies - 200 marks, counted for shortlisting to Mains) and Paper-II (CSAT Aptitude - 200 marks, qualifying with minimum 33%). Penalty of 1/3rd mark for wrong answers. Approx. 12 times the number of vacancies shortlisted for Mains.

8 subjective papers: Compulsory English (300 marks, qualifying at 33%), Essay (250 marks), GS-I (250 marks), GS-II (250 marks), GS-III (250 marks), GS-IV (250 marks), Optional Subject Paper-I (250 marks), and Optional Subject Paper-II (250 marks). Total written merit marks: 1750. Minimum aggregate qualifying: 33% overall and 20% in each merit paper (20% & 10% for PwBD).

Interview of 275 Marks conducted in 1:3 ratio against vacancies based on Mains written merit. Final combined merit list prepared out of 2025 Marks (1750 Mains + 275 Interview).

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official APPSC recruitment portal at https://appsc.gov.in.
Step 2: Complete the One Time Registration (OTR) profile if not registered previously, or log in using your existing User ID and Password.
Step 3: Access the active link for 'APPSCCE-2026 (Advertisement No. 5/2026)' from 16 September 2026 (17:00 Hours).
Step 4: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, permanent residence credentials, APST certificate information, and tribal language details.

Step 5: Upload clear scanned copies of signature (black ink, 40-50 kb, jpg), recent passport color photograph (white background, 40-100 kb, jpg), self-attested Class 10 certificate (DOB proof), APST certificate, and PRC certificate.
Step 6: Pay the online examination fee of ₹200/- (PwBD exempted). Note: If multiple applications are submitted, only the application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted.
Step 7: Submit the application before 20 October 2026 (17:00 Hours) and download/print the final confirmation sheet for records.

Highest RID Accepted: If a candidate submits multiple applications, only the application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted by the Commission.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 135 vacancies have been officially announced under APPSCCE-2026 across 13 services including APCS Entry Grade (60 posts), APPS Entry Grade (10 posts), CDPO (05 posts), DIPRO (04 posts), DF&CSO (03 posts), DTO (01 post), Labour Officer (02 posts), Station Superintendent / ASS (05 posts), Tax/Commerce Inspectors (06 posts), and Assistant Section Officer (38 posts).

faqs.question: What are the start and last dates to apply for APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: Online application registration opens on 16 September 2026 (17:00 Hours / 05:00 PM) and closes on 20 October 2026 (17:00 Hours / 05:00 PM) on the official website https://appsc.gov.in.

faqs.question: When will the APPSCCE-2026 Preliminary Examination be conducted?
faqs.answer: The APPSCCE-2026 Preliminary Examination is scheduled to be conducted on 06 December 2026 (Sunday) across 19 district centres in Arunachal Pradesh.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification and age limit for APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a UGC-recognized University. Final year students are also eligible to apply provisionally. Age must be between 21 and 35 years as on 20 October 2026 (relaxable up to 40 years for APST and up to 50 years for APST PwBD).

faqs.question: Are candidates from outside Arunachal Pradesh eligible for APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: No. Under the mandatory eligibility criteria, applicants must be citizens of India who are Permanent Residents of Arunachal Pradesh (holding valid PRC), hold indigenous APST status, and be proficient in speaking an indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: The selection process comprises: (1) Preliminary Exam (Paper-I General Studies 200 marks + Paper-II CSAT 200 marks, with 1/3rd negative marking; CSAT qualifying at 33%); (2) Main Exam (8 written subjective papers of 1750 merit marks + qualifying English 300 marks); (3) Physical Standards & PET for Police Service; and (4) Personality Test / Interview of 275 marks. Grand total merit is calculated out of 2025 marks.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for APPSCCE-2026?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹200/- payable online. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are fully exempted from the fee.

vacanciesDetails.qualification: EIL Eligibility for this recruitment is assessed as on the cut-off date of 31.08.2026 and varies by position and grade. Only full-time regular courses are considered (except CA/CMA/CS qualifications), and the specified qualification must have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. A minimum of 65% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying examination is required for all positions. The detailed qualification and post-qualification relevant experience for each position - as modified vide Addendum No. 01 dated 30.04.2026 - is given below, grouped by grade. Additional Eligibility Notes: Post-graduates in engineering (relevant to the post) get 1 year's relaxation in experience where the minimum qualification is BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.). Ph.D in Engineering (relevant to the post) gets 4 years' relaxation in experience where the minimum qualification is BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.). Candidates applying from a PSU/Govt. Sector must have completed a minimum of one year of service in the immediate lower pay scale (IDA) or equivalent (CDA) as on the date of application. Candidates applying against the OBC-NCL category must have a valid caste certificate, valid as on the closing date of applying (25.09.2026), uploaded at the time of application; applications without this will be rejected.

overview: The Government of Telangana, through the District Welfare Officer (DWO), Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), Nagarkurnool District, has officially issued Employment Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026 (DIPR R.O. No. 9373-PP/CL/ADVT/2026-27 dated 03 September 2026) for the direct recruitment of 255 Anganwadi staff vacancies. The positions encompass 148 posts of Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) and 107 posts of Anganwadi Helper / Aayah (AWH) under ITDA & ST Sub-Plan areas across 5 key ICDS project jurisdictions in Nagarkurnool District.

The 255 vacancies are distributed across 5 ICDS project sectors: Achampet Project (77 vacancies: 36 AWT, 41 AWH), Balmoor Project (64 vacancies: 36 AWT, 28 AWH), Kalwakurthy Project (38 vacancies: 21 AWT, 17 AWH), Kollapur Project (34 vacancies: 22 AWT, 12 AWH), and Nagarkurnool Project (42 vacancies: 33 AWT, 9 AWH). Appointees receive monthly honorarium fixed by the Government of Telangana: ₹13,650/- per month for Anganwadi Teachers and ₹7,800/- per month for Anganwadi Helpers.

Applications are invited strictly from eligible local resident female candidates who have passed SSC (Class 10th) and are aged between 21 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026 (18 to 35 years for ST candidates in scheduled/ITDA agency areas). Online applications can be submitted through the official departmental recruitment portal (http://wdcw.tg.nic.in / https://mis.tgwdcw.in). The registration window opened on 07 September 2026 and will close on 21 September 2026 at 05:00 PM.

selectionProcess.description: Scrutiny of online applications submitted on the official portal http://wdcw.tg.nic.in / https://mis.tgwdcw.in to verify candidate age, SSC marks, local residence, and community category.

Merit list prepared strictly based on marks scored in SSC (10th Class) examination, with additional weightage for age/seniority, disability concessions (where applicable), and widow/destitute status as per Telangana ICDS guidelines.

Verification of original certificates (SSC marks memo, residence certificate, caste certificate, marriage certificate/Aadhaar) conducted by the Selection Committee headed by the District Collector and District Welfare Officer (DWO), Nagarkurnool.
Issuance of appointment orders to the selected candidates by the District Collector / Chairperson, Nagarkurnool.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official Women Development and Child Welfare Department, Telangana portal at http://wdcw.tg.nic.in or direct MIS portal https://mis.tgwdcw.in.
Step 2: Click on 'Nagarkurnool District Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 (Notification No. 185/A/DWO-NGKL/2026)'.
Step 3: Select the appropriate ICDS Project (Achampet, Balmoor, Kalwakurthy, Kollapur, or Nagarkurnool) and the specific Gram Panchayat / Anganwadi Center.
Step 4: Enter applicant details including Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, SSC marks memo details, and Residential Address.
Step 5: Upload clear scanned copies of passport photograph, signature, SSC (10th) marks memo, Residence Certificate (Nativity/Panchayat Certificate), Caste Certificate, and Aadhaar card.
Step 6: Review the filled application form, verify all details, and click 'Submit'.
Step 7: Download and print the submitted application acknowledgement slip for future verification stages.

faqs.question: What is the total number of Anganwadi vacancies in Nagarkurnool District Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 255 vacancies have been officially notified: 148 Anganwadi Teachers (AWT) and 107 Anganwadi Helpers (AWH) across 5 ICDS projects in Nagarkurnool District.

faqs.question: What are the 5 ICDS projects covered under this notification?
faqs.answer: The 5 ICDS projects are: Achampet (77 posts), Balmoor (64 posts), Kalwakurthy (38 posts), Kollapur (34 posts), and Nagarkurnool (42 posts).

faqs.question: What are the start and closing dates for online application?
faqs.answer: Online application registration starts on 07 September 2026 and closes on 21 September 2026 at 05:00 PM on http://wdcw.tg.nic.in.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Teacher and Helper?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC (Class 10th) from a recognized Board. Only local resident female candidates belonging to the respective village/habitation are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Nagarkurnool Anganwadi posts?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 Years as on 01 July 2026. For ST candidates in ITDA agency areas, the minimum age limit is 18 Years (18 to 35 Years).

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary/honorarium for Anganwadi staff in Telangana?
faqs.answer: Selected Anganwadi Teachers receive an honorarium of ₹13,650/- per month, while Anganwadi Helpers receive ₹7,800/- per month, as revised by the Government of Telangana.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for applying to Nagarkurnool Anganwadi posts?
faqs.answer: No. The application process is completely free (₹0/- fee) for all candidates.

overview: The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC - उत्तराखण्ड अधीनस्थ सेवा चयन आयोग), Dehradun has officially released Advertisement No. 81/उ०अ०से०च०आ०/2026 (dated 08 September 2026) inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 101 Group 'C' (समूह 'ग') vacancies. The recruitment drive covers posts of Personal Assistant (वैयक्तिक सहायक), Stenographer (आशुलिपिक), Stenographer Grade-3 (आशुलिपिक ग्रेड-तृतीय), and Stenographer Grade-2 (आशुलिपिक ग्रेड-2 / ब्रिडकुल) across 19 departments and regional development authorities in Uttarakhand.

Pay scales for these prestigious positions span from Pay Level-04 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100) up to Pay Level-07 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400) under the revised 7th CPC matrix. Selection will be conducted through a 2-stage competitive process: a 100-mark OMR-based written objective exam followed by qualifying Hindi/English shorthand and typing tests in a 1:4 ratio against vacancies. Crucial date for age calculation is 01 July 2026.

Interested and eligible candidates possessing Intermediate (10+2) or Graduation along with the required Hindi/English shorthand speed (80 wpm) and computer typing speed (4000 KDPH / 25-40 wpm) can apply online via the official UKSSSC portal (https://sssc.uk.gov.in). The online registration link opens on 14 September 2026 and closes on 14 October 2026. Correction in application form will be available from 17 October 2026 to 19 October 2026, and the written test is tentatively scheduled for 20 December 2026.

education: Common Essential Qualification (for most PA posts): Passed Intermediate (Class 12th) examination from Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad or Uttarakhand Vidhyalayi Shiksha Parishad, or equivalent examination recognized by the Government.
Shorthand & Typing Standards (Standard PA): Minimum speed of 80 words per minute (w.p.m.) in Hindi Shorthand and minimum speed of 4,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (KDPH) in Hindi typing on computer.
UJALA Bhowali (Post Code 816): Intermediate passed + 1-year certificate/diploma in Shorthand & Typing + Hindi Shorthand 80 w.p.m. & English Shorthand 100 w.p.m. + Hindi computer typing 4000 KDPH.

PTCUL Steno Grade-3 (Post Code 504): Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) with sound knowledge of Devanagari script + English Shorthand 80 wpm & Hindi Shorthand 60 wpm + Hindi Typing 6000 KDPH & English Typing 7000 KDPH + Minimum 3 months certificate course in MS-Office.
BRIDCUL Steno Grade-2 (Post Code 508): Intermediate + Proficiency in Stenography in English & Hindi (80/25 WPM Hindi & 80/30 WPM English) + MS Office knowledge + Minimum 3 years relevant experience.
Uttarakhand Public Services Tribunal (Post Code 758): Intermediate + English & Hindi Shorthand 80 wpm + English & Hindi Typing 40 wpm.

State Domicile / Sewayojan Condition: Candidates applying for Group 'C' posts must have valid registration in an Employment Exchange (Sewayojan) in Uttarakhand as on the closing date OR hold Uttarakhand Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate OR have completed both 10th and 12th schooling from Uttarakhand.
eligibility.ageLimit: Age is calculated as on 01 July 2026. For UJALA PA (Post Code 816) and PTCUL Steno Grade-3 (Post Code 504), age limit is 21 to 42 Years (born between 02 July 1984 and 01 July 2005). For all other posts, age limit is 18 to 42 Years (born between 02 July 1984 and 01 July 2008).

selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Offline OMR-based written test of 100 Marks (100 Questions, 2 Hours duration). Questions cover post-relevant subjects, General Hindi, General Knowledge, Uttarakhand GK, Reasoning, and Computer Fundamentals. Marking scheme: +1 mark for correct response, negative deduction of 0.25 (1/4th) mark for each incorrect answer. Qualifying marks: 45% for UR/OBC/EWS and 35% for SC/ST.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Shorthand & Computer Typing Skill Test (आशुलिपि एवं टंकण परीक्षा)
selectionProcess.description: Qualifying skill test conducted for candidates shortlisted in 1:4 ratio against vacancies based on written exam merit. Requires 80 wpm shorthand in Hindi (or English where applicable) and 4000 KDPH typing on computer. (For PTCUL/BRIDCUL, respective speeds as prescribed).

Verification of original certificates (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, Shorthand/Typing diplomas, Uttarakhand Domicile, Employment Exchange Sewayojan registration, Caste/EWS certificate, and Aadhaar card).

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official UKSSSC recruitment portal at https://sssc.uk.gov.in.
Step 2: Click on the online application link for Advertisement No. 81/उ०अ०से०च०आ०/2026 (Personal Assistant & Stenographer).
Step 3: Register by providing your Aadhaar number, valid mobile number, and active personal email ID.
Step 4: Fill in personal bio-data, academic qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Degree), Sewayojan registration number, and domicile details.

Step 5: Upload clear scanned copies of recent colored passport photo (150x200 px), signature (150x100 px), left thumb impression (150x100 px), Aadhaar card (both sides), and 10th marksheet in JPG/JPEG format.
Step 6: Pay the prescribed examination fee online via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Step 7: Verify all entered particulars in the preview, submit the final application, and print the confirmation page for record.

Sewayojan Registration: Registration in an Employment Exchange located in Uttarakhand prior to the application closing date (14 October 2026) is mandatory unless holding Uttarakhand domicile or having passed 10th & 12th in Uttarakhand.
Negative Marking: There is 1/4th (0.25 mark) negative marking for every incorrect answer in the written test.
Shorthand & Typing Qualifying Ratio: Candidates equal to 4 times the total vacancies (04 गुना) based on written exam merit will be called for the skill test.
Correction Window: Candidates can modify and correct their submitted application form between 17 October 2026 and 19 October 2026.

Single Application Submission: Do not submit multiple applications for the same recruitment. If an error is noticed before the closing date, cancel the previous application and submit fresh (fees not refunded).

overview: Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Department of Personnel and Training (DoP&T), Government of India has officially announced the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2026 (Advt No: F. No. HQ-C1102/5/2026-C-1) on 07 September 2026, inviting online applications for approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies across Ministries, Departments, Constitutional Bodies, and Tribunals.

The recruitment drive fills prestigious Central Government Group 'C' positions including Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Data Entry Operator (DEO), and Data Entry Operator Grade 'A'. Candidates who have passed or appeared in Class 12 (with results declared on or before 07 October 2026) within the age bracket of 18 to 27 years (as on 01 August 2026) are eligible to participate.

The selection architecture features a revised two-tier Computer Based Examination (Tier-I and Tier-II) followed by qualifying Skill / Typing Tests and Departmental Document Verification. The online application window is open from 07 September 2026 to 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM) exclusively via the Commission's new portal at ssc.gov.in.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Tier-I Examination (Computer Based Examination - CBE)
selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Test comprising 100 questions (200 marks) across English Language (25 Q), General Intelligence (25 Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Q), and General Awareness (25 Q) in 60 minutes with 15-minute sectional timers. Negative marking of 0.50 marks per wrong answer. Normalized scores determine shortlisting for Tier-II.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Tier-II Examination (CBE - Objective & Descriptive / Knowledge)
selectionProcess.description: Session-I (2 hr 15 min): Section-I [Maths (30 Q) + Reasoning (30 Q) = 180 Marks], Section-II [English (40 Q) + GA (20 Q) = 180 Marks], Section-III [Computer Knowledge (15 Q = 45 Marks, Qualifying)]. Negative marking of 1 mark per wrong question in Sections I, II, and III.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 3: Tier-II Session-II (Skill Test / Typing Test)
selectionProcess.description: Qualifying nature conducted on the same day as Tier-II. Part A: DEO in specified Ministries (15,000 KDPH in 15 min); Part B: DEO in other Depts (8,000 KDPH in 15 min); Part C: Typing Test for LDC/JSA (35 wpm English or 30 wpm Hindi in Mangal Font, 10 min duration).
Conducted directly by Indenting Ministries, Departments, and User Organizations after declaration of final merit list based on aggregate marks in Tier-II Sections I & II.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 5: Physical Standards, PET & Medical (Only for BRO Posts)
selectionProcess.description: Applicable exclusively for male candidates opting for Lower Division Clerk vacancies in the Border Roads Organization (BRO). Involves 1 Mile Run in 10 minutes and region-specific physical benchmarks.

howToApplySteps: Navigate to the official Staff Selection Commission website at https://ssc.gov.in (or download the 'my SSC' Android App from Google Play Store).

Complete One-Time Registration (OTR): Candidates must register afresh on the new portal (old ssc.nic.in credentials will not work). Aadhaar-Based Authentication is strongly advised to avoid live photo and signature rejections.
Log in using your newly generated OTR Registration Number and Password.
Under the 'Latest Notifications' dashboard tab, locate 'Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2026' and click 'Apply'.
Fill in the application details, select 3 preferred examination centres within the chosen SSC Region, select exam language, and declare 12th standard stream.

Capture Live Photograph & Upload Signature: Use a webcam or mobile phone camera to capture a clear live photograph against a plain background (without cap, mask, or spectacles). Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10 KB to 20 KB, 4.0 cm × 2.0 cm).

Preview the entire form carefully, accept the declaration, and proceed to pay the application fee of ₹100/- online (exempted for Women, SC, ST, PwBD, ESM). Submit the application before 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM) and print the confirmation page.

Computer Knowledge Test & Typing Test are mandatory and qualifying in nature for final selection.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies have been announced across Central Government Ministries, Departments, and Offices under the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination 2026.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for SSC CHSL 2026 posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th Standard (Intermediate) from a recognized Board. For Data Entry Operator (DEO) in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, SSC, and Ministry of Culture, passing Class 12 in the Science stream with Mathematics is mandatory. Candidates appearing in 12th standard exams can also apply provided their results are declared by 07 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the crucial date for age calculation in SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: The crucial date for age reckoning is 01 August 2026. Applicants must be between 18 and 27 years of age (born between 02-08-1999 and 01-08-2008). Permissible age relaxations apply for SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), PwBD (10-15 yrs), and Ex-Servicemen.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application submission window is open until 07 October 2026 (11:00 PM). The fee payment deadline is 08 October 2026 (11:00 PM), and the application correction window is scheduled from 14 October 2026 to 16 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for SSC CHSL 2026 and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All female applicants, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) eligible for reservation are 100% exempted from paying any fee.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for LDC, JSA, and DEO posts under SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) are placed in Pay Level-2 (₹19,900–₹63,200). Data Entry Operators (DEO) and DEO Grade 'A' are placed in Pay Level-4 (₹25,500–₹81,100) and Pay Level-5 (₹29,200–₹92,300) with DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and public service benefits.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for SSC CHSL 2026 Tier-I?
faqs.answer: Tier-I is an objective Computer Based Examination comprising 100 questions (200 marks) across 4 subjects: English (25 Q), Reasoning (25 Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Q), and General Awareness (25 Q). Total time is 60 minutes with 15-minute sectional timers per subject. There is a negative marking of 0.50 marks per incorrect response.

faqs.question: What typing speed is required for LDC/JSA and DEO in Tier-II?
faqs.answer: For LDC/JSA, candidates must achieve 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi (Mangal font) in a 10-minute test. For DEO in specific Ministries, data entry speed is 15,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (15 min test); for DEO in other departments, the speed is 8,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (15 min test).

overview: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India (GDS Section) has officially published employment notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026 for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026. The national recruitment drive invites online applications to fill 23,757 tentative vacancies across Postal Circles for the posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak.

Candidates who have passed 10th Standard (Secondary School Examination) with Mathematics and English from any recognized School Education Board and have studied the local language up to Class 10th are eligible to apply. Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as on the closing date (21 September 2026). Selection is 100% merit-based, generated automatically by the portal on the basis of Class 10th marks/grades. There is NO written examination and NO interview.

Selected Gramin Dak Sevaks receive monthly Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA) slabs of ₹12,000 - ₹29,380 for BPM and ₹10,000 - ₹24,470 for ABPM/Dak Sevak, along with annual increments, Dearness Allowance (DA), GDS Gratuity, and Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (SDBS) benefits. Applications must be submitted through the official portal https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement before 21 September 2026 (17:00 Hrs).

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Online One-Time Registration (OTR) & Application Submission
selectionProcess.description: Candidates must register with a verified mobile number and email ID, select their Circle and Division, and submit post preferences online at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Automated System-Generated Merit List (NO Exam / NO Interview)
selectionProcess.description: Merit list is prepared automatically based on marks obtained in Class 10th (Secondary School Examination) aggregated to 4 decimal places. For grade/CGPA systems, marks are derived using the 9.5 multiplication factor. Absolutely NO written exam or interview is conducted.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 3: Physical Document Verification (15-Day Reporting Window)
selectionProcess.description: Shortlisted candidates receive SMS/Email intimations and must appear before the designated Divisional Head within 15 days with original 10th marksheet, identity proof, caste certificate, PwBD certificate, medical fitness certificate, and two sets of self-attested photocopies.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 4: Offer of Provisional Engagement & Pre-Engagement Formalities
selectionProcess.description: Upon successful verification, an Offer of Provisional Engagement is issued. Candidates must complete 3-day basic training and arrange B.O. accommodation within 30 days.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 5: Police Verification & Final Engagement Order
selectionProcess.description: Following background verification and certificate confirmation from issuing authorities, the final engagement order is issued.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official India Post GDS Engagement portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
Step 2: Complete Stage 1 One-Time Registration (OTR) by validating your mobile number and email ID via OTP, and entering your Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, and 10th Passing details.
Step 3: Note down your generated Registration Number and password received via SMS.
Step 4: Log in under 'Apply Online' and select your designated Postal Circle and Division.
Step 5: Fill in your subject-wise Class 10th marks/grades and select your Post Preferences in order of priority.
Step 6: Upload your recent photograph (JPG, 30-100 KB, 320x400 px) and scanned signature in black/blue ink (JPG, 20-100 KB, 300x120 px).
Step 7: Pay the application fee of ₹100/- online (exempted for Women, SC, ST, PwBD, and Transwomen applicants).
Step 8: Preview the completed application form, submit before 21 September 2026 (17:00 Hrs), and take a printout of the confirmation page.
Step 9: If needed, utilize the 2-day edit/correction window available from 23 September 2026 to 24 September 2026.
documentsRequired: Secondary School Examination (Class 10th) Marksheet and Passing Certificate (mandatory DOB & marks proof).
Consent and declaration for mark sheet verification through DigiLocker / API Setu (Annexure-X).
Recent Passport Size Color Photograph (30 KB to 100 KB, JPG format).
Scanned Signature on white paper with black or blue pen (20 KB to 100 KB, JPG format).
Caste / Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in prescribed central format (Annexure-V).
EWS Income & Asset Certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format.
PwBD Disability Certificate (UDID) issued by Medical Authority.
Medical Fitness Certificate issued by Government Medical Officer / Primary Health Centre.
Certificate of proficiency in tribal/local dialects (for Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Goa, or Nagaland).
Mandatory undertakings: Non-dismissal (Annexure-IV), Computer literacy (Annexure-VI), Cycling ability (Annexure-VII), and Adequate Means of Livelihood (Annexure-VIII).
importantInstructions: Candidates can apply for multiple posts within ONLY ONE selected Postal Division.
Only one registration is permitted per candidate; duplicate registrations are strictly prohibited and will lead to disqualification.
Marks in Class 10th are the sole criteria for merit; no weightage is given to higher qualifications or past experience.
Selected BPMs must arrange branch post office accommodation in the post village at their own expense.
Applicants must possess a functional Digilocker account with 10th marksheet and caste certificate fetched for API Setu online verification.
The engagement process will be officially closed on 31 December 2026; no supplementary lists will be released thereafter.

faqs.question: What is the total vacancy count in India Post GDS Schedule-II July 2026?

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Gramin Dak Sevak posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 10th (Secondary School Examination) with Mathematics and English from a recognized Board, and must have studied the local language of the applied Circle up to Class 10th. Basic computer and cycling skills are also mandatory.

faqs.question: Is there any written exam or interview for India Post GDS selection?
faqs.answer: No. Selection is 100% direct merit-based, generated automatically on the portal based on Class 10th marks/percentage. There is no written examination or interview.

faqs.question: What are the TRCA salary slabs for BPM and ABPM/Dak Sevak?
faqs.answer: The minimum basic TRCA slab is ₹12,000/- to ₹29,380/- per month for Branch Postmaster (BPM) and ₹10,000/- to ₹24,470/- per month for Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM) and Dak Sevak, plus annual increments, DA, and gratuity.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and who is exempted from payment?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All female applicants, SC, ST, PwBD, and Transwomen candidates are completely exempt from fee payment.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for India Post GDS 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit online applications and pay the fee is 21 September 2026, up to 17:00 Hrs. An edit/correction window will be open on 23 and 24 September 2026.

bank-of-baroda-so-wealth-executive-credi.jobLocation: All India (Liable to be posted anywhere in India)
overview: Bank of Baroda (BOB), one of India's premier public sector commercial banks, has officially released recruitment notification Advt No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/17 for regular human resource appointments across specialized departments. The drive invites online applications for a total of 1100 Specialist Officer vacancies, comprising 1000 posts of Wealth Executive (JMG/S-I) under Wealth Management Services and 100 posts of Credit Analyst – C&IC (MMG/S-II) under Corporate & Institutional Credit.

Candidates possessing a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with mandatory professional certifications (IC 38 / NISM Series V-A, XXI-A, or V-D) and 2 years relevant sales experience can apply for Wealth Executive. For Credit Analyst, applicants must hold a Graduation degree along with Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification and at least 1 year banking experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. The crucial eligibility cut-off date for age, education, and experience is 01 September 2026.

Selected officers will receive competitive industry-standard scales of pay (Basic Pay ₹48,480 - ₹85,920 for Scale-I and ₹64,820 - ₹93,960 for Scale-II) plus DA, HRA, CCA, perquisites, and bank-specific allowances. The selection framework comprises Application Scrutiny, Online Computer-Based Test (120 Questions/120 Marks), Psychometric Assessment, and Personal Interview. The online application portal is open from 04 September 2026 to 24 September 2026.

overview: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, an Institute of National Importance (INI) under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, has officially released detailed recruitment notification Advt No. PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 dated 09 September 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 243 posts of Nursing Officer (Group 'B', Post Code: NUR/001) for the newly created Advanced Mother & Child (MCH) Centre at PGIMER, Chandigarh.

Candidates possessing B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing, B.Sc. Nursing, or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with State Nursing Council registration (no experience required), OR Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with 1 year experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital and aged between 18 and 35 years as on the crucial closing date of 03 October 2026 are eligible to apply.

Selection is conducted purely on the basis of merit in an all-India Computer Based Test (CBT) comprising 100 multiple choice questions (100 marks, 100 minutes duration, 0.25 negative marking) in English medium. In line with Government of India directives, interview has been dispensed with for Group 'B' non-gazetted posts. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications via pgimer.edu.in from 10 September 2026 until 03 October 2026.

selectionProcess.description: CBT in English language only comprising 100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) for 100 minutes duration. Each correct response carries 1 mark. Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying cutoff is 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories.
Candidates qualifying the CBT will be shortlisted in order of merit category-wise at a ratio of 3 times the number of advertised posts (plus ties) for document scrutiny.
In accordance with Government of India orders, holding of personal interview has been dispensed with for Group 'B' non-gazetted posts. Final selection is 100% determined on CBT merit.

Shortlisted candidates must present all original educational degree/diploma certificates, nursing council registration cards, 50-bed hospital experience certificates, caste/NCL/EWS proofs, NOC (for govt employees), and photo identity proof.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official PGIMER website at https://pgimer.edu.in and click on the Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 application link, or navigate directly to the application portal.
Step 2 - Online Registration: Complete the registration form with your Name, DOB (as per 10th certificate), Mobile Number, and Email ID. User ID and Password will be sent via SMS and Email.
Step 3 - Fill Application Form: Log in with credentials and fill Personal Details, Educational Qualifications (B.Sc/GNM), Nursing Council Registration details, and Experience records.

Step 4 - Upload Photographs & Signature: Upload passport-size color photograph (50-80 KB, JPEG) snapped on or after 01 July 2026 clearly indicating candidate's name and date of photo printed at the bottom. Upload scanned signature (50-200 KB).

Step 5 - Upload Mandatory Documents: Upload scanned copies of 10th certificate, 12th marksheet, degree/diploma, nursing registration certificate, category certificate, and 50-bed hospital experience certificate.
Step 6 - Exam City Choice: Select your preferred examination city from the 29 available cities.

Step 7 - Fee Payment & Printout: Pay application fee (₹1,500 for UR/OBC/EWS, ₹800 for SC/ST, free for PwBD) via Net Banking or Debit/Credit card. Download and preserve the payment slip and final submitted application form.

overview: Directorate of Urban Local Bodies (DULB), Haryana, Panchkula has officially invited online applications for the engagement of 195 professional posts on a contract basis across 87 urban local bodies (11 Municipal Corporations, 25 Municipal Councils, and 51 Municipal Committees) in the State of Haryana. The recruitment drive includes 62 Taxation Experts, 76 Taxation Associates, and 57 Sanitation Experts/Associates to enhance municipal financial management, revenue collection, and solid waste sanitation infrastructure.

Candidates possessing Chartered Accountancy (CA) are eligible for Taxation Experts with a monthly remuneration of ₹1,00,000/-. Candidates with MBA (Finance) or PGDM (Finance) from institutions ranked among the Top 50 in the latest NIRF Rankings are eligible for Taxation Associates (₹50,000/- per month). Candidates holding a Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science or Environmental Science & Engineering from Top 50 NIRF institutions (with valid GATE score preferred) are eligible for Sanitation Experts/Associates (₹50,000/- per month).

The engagement is purely on a contract basis initially for a period of one (1) year, extendable up to three (3) years based on annual satisfactory performance review. Selection is strictly merit-based according to a structured 100-mark evaluation grid covering qualifying degree percentages, institutional standing (ICAI rank / NIRF ranking / GATE score), relevant professional experience, and government/PSU experience. There is no written examination. Eligible candidates must submit their applications online at https://recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in up to 30 September 2026.

education: For Taxation Experts (62 Posts): Must be a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI. Additional weightage for candidates in the ICAI merit list (Top 50 rank holder) or clearing the Final exam in the first attempt.

For Taxation Associates (76 Posts): MBA (Finance as Major) or Post-Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM with Finance as Major) or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute appearing in the Top 50 of the latest NIRF Ranking published by the Ministry of Education, GoI.

For Sanitation Experts/Associates (57 Posts): Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science OR Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science & Engineering from a recognized University or Technical Institution among the Top 50 NIRF Ranked colleges/institutions.
Preference: Given to candidates possessing Ph.D., Master's Degree, or Toppers of Bachelor's Degree in the prescribed streams.
experience: Taxation Experts: 2 marks per completed year (max 10 marks) for experience in Accounting/Taxation/Financial Management for candidates having more than 2 years experience. Plus up to 10 marks for Government/PSU/Board/Authority experience.

Taxation Associates: 2 marks per completed year (max 10 marks) for experience in Accounting/Taxation/Financial Management for candidates having more than 5 years experience. Plus up to 10 marks for Government/PSU/Board/Authority experience.

Sanitation Experts/Associates: 4 marks per completed year (max 20 marks) for experience in Solid Waste Management, Environmental Science & Engineering for candidates having more than 5 years experience. Plus up to 10 marks for Government/PSU/Board/Authority experience.
eligibility.ageLimit: Candidate should generally be between 18 to 42 years of age as per Haryana Government contractual engagement rules. Category relaxations apply as per Haryana state policies.

allowances: No separate DA, HRA, or transport allowance (all-inclusive consolidated monthly remuneration)
Reimbursement of official travel expenses as admissible under municipal rules on tour
30 days mandatory notice period by either party for termination of engagement

examCentres.details: No written examination will be held. Scrutiny and selection will be conducted at the Directorate of Urban Local Bodies, Haryana, Panchkula. Appointed experts/associates will be posted across 87 municipalities in Haryana based on merit and 3 choices of posting indicated in the application form.

selectionProcess.description: Candidates submit online credentials, degree marks, ICAI/NIRF/GATE proofs, and experience certificates at https://recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in.

Application scrutiny at Directorate level by a selection committee based on the objective 100-mark evaluation matrix (60 marks for academic %, 20 marks for institutional ranking/GATE/ICAI merit, and up to 20 marks for professional & Govt/PSU experience).
Preference is accorded to candidates possessing Ph.D., Master's Degree, or Toppers of Bachelor's Degree in the relevant discipline.
Verification of original marksheets, degree certificates, NIRF standing proofs, ICAI membership/GATE scorecards, and verified experience letters at Panchkula.
Issuance of contractual engagement orders and posting to one of the 87 municipal corporations, councils, or committees in Haryana taking into account the candidate's 3 preferred locations.

sections.questions: 10 Marks (1 to 2 yrs: 5 marks | Above 2/3 yrs: 10 marks)

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official Haryana DULB recruitment portal at https://recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in.
Step 2: Register as a new applicant by entering your name, valid email address, and mobile number. Confirm your registration credentials.
Step 3: Sign in to your account and select the post you wish to apply for: Taxation Expert, Taxation Associate, or Sanitation Expert/Associate.
Step 4: Fill in your educational details, degree percentages, CGPA/GPA conversion formula, ICAI rank / NIRF rank / GATE score details, and detailed work experience.
Step 5: Provide your choice of three (3) preferred municipal locations for posting in Haryana.

Step 6: Upload required scanned documents: recent colored passport photo (light background, 80% face coverage), clear signature in black ink on white paper, self-certified degree and marksheets (both sides), and self-certified experience certificates.
Step 7: Submit the application form before 30 September 2026. A Unique Application Number will be generated. Download and save the final application PDF for future reference.
documentsRequired: Recent colored passport size photograph with light background covering 80% of candidate's face.
Scanned copy of applicant's signature signed in Black Ink pen on white paper.
Self-certified copies of detailed marksheet certificates and degree qualifications (both sides showing GPA/CGPA grading system where applicable).
Proof of College/Institute NIRF Top 50 Ranking on date of advertisement (for MBA/PGDM and Environmental Science degree).
Chartered Accountant (CA) Membership / Passing Certificate / ICAI Merit List certificate (for Taxation Experts).
Valid GATE Scorecard (for Sanitation Experts/Associates, where available).
Self-certified experience certificates from relevant accounting/taxation/environmental firms, PSUs, or Government departments.
Haryana Domicile Certificate & Category Certificate (if claiming state reservations).
importantInstructions: Zero Application Fee: There is no application fee for any category.

Top 50 NIRF Mandatory: For Taxation Associates and Sanitation Experts/Associates, the qualifying degree/diploma must be strictly from an institution appearing in the Top 50 of the latest NIRF Ranking (Ministry of Education, GoI).
Choice of Postings: Candidates must indicate their top 3 municipal location preferences in Haryana during online submission.
Tenure & Extension: Engagement is initially for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years based on annual satisfactory performance.
Termination Clause: Either party may terminate the contract with a mandatory 30 days prior written notice.
No Physical Applications: Applications must be submitted strictly online via https://recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in up to 30 September 2026. Physical forms will be rejected.

overview: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB, Bhopal) and Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh have officially released the comprehensive examination rulebook for the Direct Recruitment of Police Constable (General Duty) Examination 2026 (आरक्षक (जी.डी.) की सीधी भर्ती हेतु चयन परीक्षा 2026, Notice No: पुमु/2/चयन/स-3/583/2026). A total of 7,500 Constable (GD) vacancies are announced across Special Armed Force (SAF - 700 male posts) and District Executive Force (DEF - 6,800 posts for male and female candidates).

Candidates who have passed Class 10th (High School) or Higher Secondary (Class 8th for ST candidates) and are within the age group of 18 to 33 years (up to 38 years for women, MP SC/ST/OBC, and other relaxed categories as on 06 October 2026) are eligible. All candidates must have an active live registration with the Madhya Pradesh State Employment Exchange (रोजगार कार्यालय). Non-MP domicile candidates are eligible to compete under the Unreserved (Open) category.

The selection features a 200-mark evaluation system comprising Phase-1 Computer Based Written Exam (100 Marks, 2 Hours, no negative marking, Class 8th syllabus) and Phase-2 Physical Proficiency Test (PPT / PET, 100 Marks with 800m run, long jump, and shot put), followed by Physical Measurement (PMT), Document Verification, and Medical Examination. Eligible candidates can apply online at https://esb.mp.gov.in or https://esb.mponline.gov.in from 22 September 2026 until 06 October 2026.
