education: For General (UR), Other Backward Classes (OBC), and Scheduled Castes (SC): Must have passed Class 10 (High School) under the 10+2 system OR Higher Secondary or equivalent examination from a recognized Board / Institution.
For Scheduled Tribes (ST): Must have passed Class 8 or equivalent examination from a recognized School / Institution.
MP Employment Registration: Must possess a valid, active live registration in the Employment Exchange (रोजगार कार्यालय) of Madhya Pradesh on the application closing date.
All required certificates (Education, Age relaxation, Domicile, Caste/EWS, Home Guard, Ex-Servicemen) must be valid and acquired on or before 06 October 2026.

Children Criteria: Any candidate having more than 2 living children, where one child was born on or after 26 January 2001, is ineligible for appointment (exception applies if one child is living and twins/multiple children are born in subsequent single delivery).
eligibility.ageLimit: Candidate must have completed minimum 18 years and not exceeded the prescribed upper age limit as on 06 October 2026. For MP Domicile UR/EWS Male and All Non-MP candidates, upper age is 33 years. For Female candidates (all categories) and MP Domicile Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC), upper age is 38 years.
ageRelaxation: MP Domicile Female Candidates (All Categories - UR, SC, ST, OBC, EWS): Up to 38 Years (33 + 5 years)
MP Domicile SC / ST / OBC Male Candidates: Up to 38 Years (33 + 5 years)
MP Govt / Corporation / Board / Autonomous Body Employees & Nagar Sainik: Up to 38 Years (33 + 5 years)
Inter-caste Marriage Incentive Awardees (MP Domicile): Additional 5 years relaxation (up to 43 years for female)
Vikram Puraskar Awardees (MP Domicile): Additional 5 years relaxation (UR Male: 38 years; Female & Reserved: 43 years)
Ex-Servicemen (ESM): Actual service rendered in Defence forces deducted from actual age, resultant age must not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years.
Home Guard Volunteers: Must have completed at least 3 years of active service as on 06 October 2026.
Candidates Outside Madhya Pradesh: Strictly 33 Years maximum; NO age relaxation or reservation benefit is admissible.
physicalStandards: Special Armed Force (SAF) Cadre (Male Candidates Only): Height 168 cm, Chest 79 cm (unexpanded) and 84 cm (expanded with min 5 cm expansion). For Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni: Height 157 cm, Chest 79/84 cm. For Maratha/SC/ST: Height 165 cm, Chest 79/84 cm.

DEF Cadre (Except SAF - Male Candidates): UR / SC / OBC Male: Height 168 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) and 86 cm (expanded with min 5 cm expansion). ST Male: Height 160 cm, Chest 76 cm (unexpanded) and 81 cm (expanded with min 5 cm expansion).
DEF Cadre (Female Candidates): UR / SC / OBC / ST Female: Height 155 cm (Chest measurement not applicable).
No relaxation in physical measurement standards is granted at any stage under any circumstances.
medicalStandards: Medical examination conducted by District Medical Board. Candidates must have sound bodily and mental health.
Vision: Eye sight acuity must not be less than 6/9 in one eye and 6/12 in the other eye without spectacles / glasses.
Color Vision: Must have normal color perception tested via Ishihara plates; no color blindness.
Physical Defects: Must be free from knock-knees (नॉक-नी), flat foot (फ्लैट फुट), squint, stammering, or any physical disability/handicap.
Police department is completely exempt from recruiting Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

selectionProcess.description: Computer-Based Test conducted by MPESB (100 Questions, 100 Marks, 2 Hours). 100 MCQs on GK, Reasoning, Science, and Simple Arithmetic at MP Board 8th standard level. No negative marking. Candidates equal to 7 times the vacancies (7x) are shortlisted based on cut-off percentile.

Physical efficiency assessment conducted by Police Department for 100 Marks (800m Run - max 40 marks, Long Jump - max 30 marks, Shot Put - max 30 marks). Minimum 30% marks (30/100) is mandatory. Marks are added to written exam marks for final merit (Total 200 Marks).
Measurement of height and chest (for male candidates) as per prescribed standards. Min 5 cm chest expansion required. Qualifying in nature with no relaxation.
Scrutiny of original Class 10th/8th certificates, Domicile, Caste/EWS certificates, MP Employment Exchange live registration, Home Guard/ESM service certificates, and Identity proofs.
Comprehensive medical fitness check by District Medical Board (vision 6/9 and 6/12, no color blindness, knock knee, flat foot) and police character/antecedents verification.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official MPOnline portal at https://esb.mponline.gov.in or the MPESB website https://esb.mp.gov.in.
Step 2: Ensure you have an active Citizen Profile Registration / Profile ID on MPOnline with updated Aadhaar e-KYC. If not registered, create a new profile.
Step 3: Confirm active live registration with the Madhya Pradesh Employment Exchange (रोजगार कार्यालय) at http://rojgar.mp.gov.in.
Step 4: Under the 'Citizen Services' -> 'Application' -> 'ESB' section, click on 'Police Constable Recruitment Test - 2026' and read all instructions.
Step 5: Fill in personal, educational (Class 10th/8th roll number, board, marks), domicile, category, and preference of 58 districts/police units and 4 exam cities.

Step 6: Upload the combined template image containing recent color passport photograph (with name and date of photo printed, taken within last 3 months, white background, both ears visible), signature, and handwritten self-declaration in JPG format.

Step 7: Verify all preview details, submit the application, and pay the fee online via Net Banking, Card, or UPI (or cash at MPOnline Kiosk). Save and print the final Application Form and Payment Receipt.
documentsRequired: Recent Color Passport Size Photograph with applicant name and date of photograph printed (taken within 3 months, white background, no cap/spectacles).
Applicant's clear signature and two-line handwritten declaration in prescribed template.
Class 10th (High School) or Class 8th (for ST) Mark Sheet and Certificate showing Date of Birth.
Madhya Pradesh Domicile / Residence Certificate (मूल निवासी प्रमाण पत्र).
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer) or EWS Certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed MP format.
Active Live MP Employment Exchange Registration Card (रोजगार पंजीयन प्रमाण पत्र).
Aadhaar Card / VID with biometric unlocked for exam center verification.
Home Guard / Ex-Servicemen discharge book or experience certificate (where applicable).
Certificate of Identity issued by District Magistrate for Transgender applicants.
importantInstructions: Mandatory Aadhaar Biometric: Multi-level biometric verification will be conducted at the exam center. Ensure your Aadhaar biometric is UNLOCKED before the exam date.
One Application Only: Candidates must submit only one online application. Multiple applications with deceptive details will lead to immediate cancellation.

Live Employment Registration: Live registration in the MP Employment Exchange is strictly mandatory. Candidates failing to produce valid registration on the closing date (06 October 2026) will be disqualified.

Physical Test Weightage: Physical Proficiency Test carries 100 marks and directly contributes to final merit ranking (Total 200 marks). Candidates must score at least 30% (30 marks) in PET to be eligible for appointment.
No Correction After Window: Any correction in application data must be completed within the correction window (22 September to 11 October 2026). No requests will be entertained after 11 October 2026.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are notified for MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 7,500 vacancies for Constable (General Duty) are announced: 700 posts in the Special Armed Force (SAF - Male only) and 6,800 posts in the District Executive Force (DEF - Male & Female).

faqs.question: What are the online application starting and closing dates for MP Police Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 22 September 2026 and close on 06 October 2026. The application correction window remains open from 22 September 2026 to 11 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification required for MP Police Constable?
faqs.answer: For UR, OBC, and SC categories: 10th Class Pass under the 10+2 system or Higher Secondary (10+2). For Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates: 8th Class Pass or equivalent from a recognized institution.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for MP Police Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: The crucial cut-off date for age calculation is 06 October 2026. Minimum age is 18 years. Maximum age is 33 years for Male (UR/EWS/Other States) and 38 years for Female candidates (all categories) and MP Domicile SC/ST/OBC males.

faqs.question: How is the final merit list calculated for MP Police Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: The final merit list is prepared out of a total of 200 Marks: 100 Marks from Phase-1 Written Examination (CBT) + 100 Marks from Phase-2 Physical Proficiency Test (PPT/PET). Scoring at least 30% marks (30/100) in PET is mandatory.

faqs.question: Are candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates from other states are eligible to apply, but strictly under the Unreserved (Open) category. They cannot claim reservation or age relaxation benefits, and their maximum age limit is 33 years as on 06 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MP Police Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: Unreserved (UR) candidates and other state applicants pay ₹700 (₹500 Board fee + ₹200 Police Dept fee) plus portal charges (₹60 Kiosk / ₹20 Citizen). MP Domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates pay ₹350 (₹250 Board fee + ₹100 Police Dept fee) plus portal charges.

faqs.question: When will the MP Police Constable 2026 written examination be conducted?
faqs.answer: The Computer-Based Examination (CBT) is scheduled to commence from 19 November 2026 in two daily shifts (10:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 03:00 PM to 05:00 PM) across 13 cities in Madhya Pradesh.

overview: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow (A Central University) has officially announced employment advertisement notification BBAU/T/01/2026 inviting applications for 30 vacancies for Teaching Positions and Non Teaching Positions posts.

Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility conditions (Coordinator Grade-I: Master's degree with at least 55% marks; nine years' experience as Assistant Professor in Academic ...) and age requirements can submit their candidature via Apply Online. The closing deadline / scheduled date is 19 October 2026 (23:59:59 hrs).

Selected appointees will be stationed in Lucknow (Main Campus) and Amethi (Satellite Centre), Uttar Pradesh, receiving official compensation (As per official institutional pay scale rules), statutory allowances, and established public service benefits as per organizational regulations.

vacanciesDetails.qualification: Coordinator Grade-I: Master's degree with at least 55% marks; nine years' experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 10 and above with educational administration experience, or comparable research/higher education institution experience, or five years' administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or equivalent. Desirable: experience in Establishment/Examinations/Finance. Assistant Librarian: Master's degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent with at least 55% marks; consistently good academic record with knowledge of library computerization; must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. as per UGC (M.Phil./Ph.D.) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, subject to specified exemption conditions. System Analyst: First class M.E./M.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology)/MCA/M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology) or equivalent; OR First class B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) or equivalent with two years' relevant experience. Desirable: CCNA/CCNP or equivalent certification. Library Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent; typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; knowledge of computer applications. Professor (Economics, Human Rights, Public Administration, Demographic Studies): Ph.D. with 10 research publications and a total research score of 120 as per UGC 2018 norms, and 10 years' teaching/research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates; OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and 10 years' relevant experience. Professor - Law: LL.M. and Ph.D. in Law, plus other UGC 2018 conditions for Professor. Professor - Civil/Electronics & Communication Engineering: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; minimum 10 years' teaching/research/industry experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor); at least 6 SCI/UGC/AICTE-listed publications at Associate Professor level with 2 successful Ph.D. supervisions, OR 10 such publications. Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies, Hindi): Ph.D. in the relevant discipline; Master's with at least 55% marks; 8 years' teaching/research experience with 7 peer-reviewed publications and a research score of 75 as per UGC 2018 norms. Assistant Professor - English: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. as per UGC exemption conditions), OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 globally (QS/THE/ARWU). Assistant Professor - Education (as per NCTE Regulations): Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences (55%) + M.Ed. (55%), OR PG in Education (55%) + B.Ed./B.El.Ed. (55%); plus UGC-NET/JRF/Ph.D. in Education. For Curriculum & Pedagogic subjects, a relevant PG subject + M.Ed. (55% each) is required; for Music/Fine Arts, only a PG degree in the subject with 55% marks is required. Professor-cum-Resident Director: Same eligibility as Professor (Category A or B above) plus three years of administrative experience for direct recruitment; for deputation, holding an analogous Academic Level-14 post, or at least 3 years in Academic Level-13A and above as Associate Professor or equivalent. Associate Professor-cum-Deputy Director (CSSI): Ph.D. in any Social Science subject; Master's with 55% marks; 8 years' relevant experience with 7 publications and a research score of 75. Assistant Professor-cum-Assistant Director (CSSI): Master's degree in Social Science with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms), OR a foreign-university Ph.D. ranked in the top 500 globally. Detailed, post-wise UGC 2018 eligibility clauses (including NET/SLET/SET exemption conditions for Ph.D. holders) are given in full in the official notification and should be read carefully before applying.

overview: Office of the District Programme Officer, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar, Government of Uttar Pradesh) has officially released employment advertisement notification (Letter No. सी/530/जि0का0अ0/आ0वा0का0/सहा0चयन भर्ती/2026-27, dated 07 September 2026) for direct recruitment of 267 contractual vacancies of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker - 84 Posts) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper - 183 Posts) across urban and rural project blocks in Gautam Buddha Nagar district.

Eligible female candidates possessing minimum Intermediate (12th Class) qualification and aged between 18 to 35 years as on 01 July 2026 can apply online via the official portal http://upanganwadibharti.in. Selection is purely merit-based determined on marks obtained from Intermediate up to Post Graduation. There is NO written examination or personal interview.

Applicants must be permanent local residents of the concerned Gram Sabha (for rural projects) or specific Ward (for urban projects). Priority will be accorded to Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants, widows, and legally divorced/abandoned women. The deadline for online submission is 28 September 2026 (Midnight 12:00 AM).

detailsList: Gender Quota: 100% reserved exclusively for Female candidates (विज्ञापित पदों पर केवल महिला अभ्यर्थी ही पात्र होंगी).

BPL Priority: First priority given to candidates living Below Poverty Line (BPL) income limit within prescribed age. If no BPL candidate is available, selection proceeds to Above Poverty Line (APL) candidates as per seniority/merit.
Widows & Divorced Women: Special preference given to widows (with death certificate and certified Parivar Panjika copy) and divorced/deserted women (with certified court order).

Local Gram Sabha / Ward Domicile: Compulsory residence in the vacant Gram Sabha (rural) or specific Municipal Ward (urban). If no eligible candidate found in Gram Sabha, selection from concerned Nyaya Panchayat.

Digital Certificate Verification: SDM digitally signed Domicile Certificate (निवास प्रमाण पत्र) and Tehsildar digitally signed Income and Caste certificates must be verifiable online on UP e-District portal.
Family Restriction: Two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Anganwadi Karyakatri / Sahayika at the same Anganwadi centre.

Merit is determined based on marks obtained from Intermediate (12th) up to Post Graduation.

Candidates living Below Poverty Line (BPL) are prioritized first within the age group. If no eligible BPL applicant is available, selection is made from Above Poverty Line (APL) applicants. Widows and divorced/deserted women receive special legal preference.

Shortlisted candidates must present original academic credentials, High School age proof, SDM domicile certificate, Tehsildar income/caste certificate, and affidavit at Room No. 110, Ground Floor, Vikas Bhawan, Surajpur, Greater Noida.
Issuance of contractual engagement order on honorarium basis by the District Programme Officer, Gautam Buddha Nagar.

howToApply: Visit the official Uttar Pradesh Anganwadi Bharti portal: http://upanganwadibharti.in.
Navigate to the recruitment section and select 'Gautam Buddha Nagar' district and your respective Block/Project (Shahar, Bisrakh, Dankaur, Dadri, or Jewar).
Select your designated Gram Sabha (rural) or Ward (urban) where the vacancy exists.
Register using your active mobile number and enter accurate personal, academic, and category details.

Upload clear, self-attested scanned copies of required documents: Class 10th marksheet (DOB proof), Class 12th marksheet, Graduation/PG marksheets (if applicable), SDM digitally signed Domicile Certificate, and Tehsildar digitally signed Income and Caste certificates.
Widow applicants must upload husband's death certificate and certified Parivar Panjika copy; divorced/deserted applicants must upload legal court order.
Verify all filled data carefully before final submission. Remember: offline or postal applications will be rejected summarily.
Submit the online form before the closing deadline: 28 September 2026 (Midnight 12:00 AM) and print a copy of the final submission receipt.
For queries or assistance, visit Room No. 110, Ground Floor, Vikas Bhawan, Surajpur, Greater Noida between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM on working days.
documentsRequired: High School (Class 10th) Marksheet and Passing Certificate (mandatory proof of Date of Birth).
Intermediate (Class 12th) Marksheet and Certificate (minimum mandatory qualification).
Graduation and Post Graduation Marksheets / Degree Certificates (if claiming higher qualification merit points).
Domicile Certificate (निवास प्रमाण पत्र) digitally signed by Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) with online e-District verification.
Income Certificate (आय प्रमाण पत्र) digitally signed by Tehsildar with online e-District verification (Revenue Section-9 Order No. 3959/1-9-11-AA-9).
Caste Certificate (जाति प्रमाण पत्र) for SC / ST / OBC candidates digitally signed by Tehsildar.
For Widows: Death Certificate of husband and certified copy of Family Register (परिवार पंजिका नकल) issued by Gram Panchayat Officer or Urban Local Body.
For Divorced / Abandoned Women: Certified copy of legal court order / decree issued by competent judicial court.
Recent passport size color photograph and scanned signature of the applicant.
Valid government Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID).
importantInstructions: Only female candidates are eligible to apply; male candidates are not eligible.

The applicant MUST be a resident of the vacant Gram Sabha (rural area) or vacant Ward (urban area). In rural areas, if no candidate is found in the Gram Sabha, the concerned Nyaya Panchayat pool is considered.
Two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Anganwadi Karyakatri / Sahayika at the same Anganwadi centre.
Selection is 100% merit-based through the online portal; NO written test or interview will be conducted.
No offline or postal application will be accepted under any circumstances.
Any fabricated, incorrect, or unverified documents will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature and legal action.
The number of advertised vacancies is subject to increase or decrease as per departmental requirements.

vacanciesDetails.qualification: For most subjects (Hindi, English, Economics, Sociology, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Commerce, Botany, History, Philosophy, Zoology, Psychology, Political Science, Education, Sanskrit, Home Science, Geography, Physical Education, Military Science, Agriculture-related subjects, Law, Statistics, Geology, and others), eligibility is either: Route A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in the relevant/allied subject from an Indian university (or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university), AND a qualifying NET conducted by UGC/CSIR, or an equivalent state-level test (SLET/SET) accredited by UGC - subject to exemption for candidates awarded a PhD as per UGC (Minimum Standards for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 (and subsequent amendments), provided specified conditions relating to regular-mode PhD, external examiners, open viva-voce, published papers, and presented conference papers are met and certified by the university. Route B: A PhD in the relevant subject obtained (at any time) from a foreign university/institution ranked in the world's top 500 as per QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education (THE), or Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai) rankings. For Art/Drawing & Painting, Music Vocal, Music Instrumental (Sitar), and Music Instrumental (Tabla), eligibility is either the same Master's + NET/SLET/SET or PhD route as above, OR a traditional/professional artist with a Bachelor's degree and outstanding professional achievement in the relevant discipline, having studied under recognized traditional masters/artists, having been an "A" grade artist on All India Radio/Doordarshan, and possessing the ability to teach the subject with sound theoretical grounding - subject to a minimum 55% qualifying marks requirement at Master's level for direct recruitment purposes. A relaxation of 5% in qualifying marks (from 55% to 50%) applies to SC/ST/OBC(non-creamy layer)/disabled category candidates (as specified in the notification) for the purpose of eligibility and evaluation of academic record for direct recruitment. A further 5% relaxation (55% to 50%) applies to PhD-degree holders who obtained their degree before 19 September 1991. A grade considered equivalent to 55% at Master's level under any UGC-recognized university's grading system is also treated as valid. The official advertisement also lists subject-wise inter-related/equivalent subjects (Antarsambandh Vishay) accepted for eligibility against several subjects (e.g., Hindi accepts Linguistics; History accepts Medieval History, Modern History, Ancient History, Archaeology; Sociology accepts Social Work; Economics accepts Applied Economics) - candidates should verify the equivalent-subject list for their subject in the official notification.

overview: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the detailed notification for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2026 (Notice No. E/37/2026-C-2 dated 10.09.2026) to recruit 1,871 Sub-Inspectors across Delhi Police, BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, and SSB under Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400).

Eligible candidates holding a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (or B.Sc PCM / Diploma in Engineering for SI Fire in CISF) and aged between 20 and 25 years (18 to 30 years for SI Fire in CISF) as on 01 August 2026 can submit their online applications via the official portal (ssc.gov.in) from 10 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 (11:00 PM). Male candidates applying for Delhi Police SI must also possess a valid Driving License for LMV (Motorcycle and Car) on the date of PE&MT.

The selection procedure involves a multi-tier assessment comprising Paper-I Computer Based Examination (100 marks, 1 hour with 15-minute sectional timers), Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II Computer Based Examination (320 marks, 2 hours), followed by Detailed Medical Examination (DME / RME) and Document Verification (DV). Final allotment to forces is determined by normalized scores in Paper-II (plus NCC bonus marks) and post preferences.

selectionProcess.description: Objective Multiple Choice Test consisting of 100 questions (100 marks) for 1 hour duration. Divided into 4 parts: Reasoning (25 Qs / 25 Marks), General Awareness (25 Qs / 25 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs / 25 Marks), and English Comprehension (25 Qs / 25 Marks) with a mandatory sectional timer of 15 minutes per part. Negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer. Normalized scores used to shortlist candidates for PST/PET.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Endurance Test (PET)
selectionProcess.description: Mandatory and qualifying in nature (no marks). Male candidates: 100m sprint in 16s, 1.6 km run in 6.5 mins, Long Jump 3.65m (3 attempts), High Jump 1.2m (3 attempts), Shot Put 4.5m (3 attempts). Female candidates: 100m sprint in 18s, 800m run in 4 mins, Long Jump 2.7m (3 attempts), High Jump 0.9m (3 attempts). PST checks minimum height and chest standards. Ex-Servicemen are exempt from PET but must clear PST.

Objective Multiple Choice Test consisting of 160 questions (320 marks) for 2 hours duration: General Intelligence & Reasoning (20 Qs / 40 Marks, 20 mins timer), General Knowledge (20 Qs / 40 Marks, 20 mins timer), Quantitative Aptitude (20 Qs / 40 Marks, 20 mins timer), and English Comprehension (100 Qs / 200 Marks, 1 hour timer). Negative marking of 0.50 marks per wrong answer.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 4: Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Document Verification (DV)
selectionProcess.description: Qualified candidates undergo thorough medical fitness scrutiny by Medical Boards of CAPFs (Distant vision 6/6 & 6/9, near vision N6 & N9, colour blindness test, physical deformity check). Physical document verification is performed simultaneously by CAPF authorities prior to final allocation.

Bonus marks added to normalized scores in Paper-I & Paper-II: NCC 'C' Certificate receives 5% of max marks (5 marks in Paper-I, 16 marks in Paper-II); NCC 'B' receives 3% (3 marks in Paper-I, 9.6 marks in Paper-II); NCC 'A' receives 2% (2 marks in Paper-I, 6.4 marks in Paper-II).

howToApply: Step 1 - One-Time Registration (OTR): Visit the new official SSC portal (https://ssc.gov.in) and click on 'Register Now' under Login/Register. If already registered on the new website, log in using your Registration Number and Password. (Note: Old registrations on ssc.nic.in are not valid on the new portal).
Step 2 - Aadhaar-Based Authentication: Opt for Aadhaar Authentication during OTR for streamlined verification and avoiding exam-day biometric discrepancies.

Step 3 - Fill Application Form: Navigate to 'Latest Notifications\, find 'Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2026\, and click 'Apply\. Select post preferences (Delhi Police, BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, or CISF Fire).

Step 4 - Live Photograph Capture: As per new SSC norms, pre-existing photos are not accepted. Capture a real-time live photograph using a webcam or through the 'mySSC' mobile app in a well-lit space against a plain background without wearing caps, spectacles, or masks.
Step 5 - Signature Upload: Upload a clearly scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format between 10 KB and 20 KB (approx. 4.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
Step 6 - Examination Centre Selection: Choose three examination centres in order of preference within the same SSC administrative region.

Step 7 - Fee Payment & Final Submission: Verify all preview details, agree to the declaration, submit the form, and pay the ₹100/- application fee (exempt for women, SC, ST, ESM) online before 01 October 2026 (11:00 PM). Download and print the submitted application form for future reference.

faqs.question: Is a Driving License compulsory for all SSC CPO Sub-Inspector posts?
faqs.answer: No. A valid Driving License for LMV (Motorcycle and Car) is compulsory ONLY for Male candidates who wish to be considered for Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police on the date of Physical Endurance and Measurement Tests (PE&MT). Female candidates and male candidates applying for CAPFs (BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB) do NOT require a driving license.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and sectional timing for Paper-I and Paper-II?
faqs.answer: Paper-I consists of 100 questions (100 marks) for 1 hour duration divided into 4 sections of 25 questions each (Reasoning, GK, Quant, English) with a sectional timer of 15 minutes per section and 0.25 negative marking. Paper-II consists of 160 questions (320 marks) for 2 hours: Reasoning (20 Qs/40 Marks, 20 mins), GK (20 Qs/40 Marks, 20 mins), Quant (20 Qs/40 Marks, 20 mins), and English Comprehension (100 Qs/200 Marks, 1 hour) with 0.50 negative marking per wrong answer.

faqs.question: How many bonus marks are awarded for NCC Certificate holders?
faqs.answer: NCC certificate holders as on the closing date (30 September 2026) are awarded bonus marks added to their normalized scores in both Paper-I and Paper-II: NCC 'C' Certificate holders receive 5% of maximum marks (5 marks in Paper-I, 16 marks in Paper-II); NCC 'B' Certificate holders receive 3% of maximum marks (3 marks in Paper-I, 9.6 marks in Paper-II); and NCC 'A' Certificate holders receive 2% of maximum marks (2 marks in Paper-I, 6.4 marks in Paper-II).

faqs.question: What are the Physical Endurance Test (PET) standards for Male and Female candidates?
faqs.answer: For Male Candidates: 100 metre sprint in 16 seconds, 1.6 km run in 6.5 minutes, Long Jump of 3.65 metres (3 chances), High Jump of 1.2 metres (3 chances), and Shot Put (16 lbs) of 4.5 metres (3 chances). For Female Candidates: 100 metre sprint in 18 seconds, 800 metre race in 4 minutes, Long Jump of 2.7 metres (3 chances), and High Jump of 0.9 metres (3 chances). PET is qualifying in nature.

overview: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, an Institute of National Importance (INI) under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, has officially released detailed recruitment notification Advt No. PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 dated 09 September 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 243 posts of Nursing Officer (Group 'B', Post Code: NUR/001) for the newly created Advanced Mother & Child (MCH) Centre at PGIMER, Chandigarh.

Candidates possessing B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing, B.Sc. Nursing, or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with State Nursing Council registration (no experience required), OR Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with 1 year experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital and aged between 18 and 35 years as on the crucial closing date of 03 October 2026 are eligible to apply.

Selection is conducted purely on the basis of merit in an all-India Computer Based Test (CBT) comprising 100 multiple choice questions (100 marks, 100 minutes duration, 0.25 negative marking) in English medium. In line with Government of India directives, interview has been dispensed with for Group 'B' non-gazetted posts. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications via pgimer.edu.in from 10 September 2026 until 03 October 2026.

selectionProcess.description: CBT in English language only comprising 100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) for 100 minutes duration. Each correct response carries 1 mark. Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying cutoff is 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories.
Candidates qualifying the CBT will be shortlisted in order of merit category-wise at a ratio of 3 times the number of advertised posts (plus ties) for document scrutiny.
In accordance with Government of India orders, holding of personal interview has been dispensed with for Group 'B' non-gazetted posts. Final selection is 100% determined on CBT merit.

Shortlisted candidates must present all original educational degree/diploma certificates, nursing council registration cards, 50-bed hospital experience certificates, caste/NCL/EWS proofs, NOC (for govt employees), and photo identity proof.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official PGIMER website at https://pgimer.edu.in and click on the Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 application link, or navigate directly to the application portal.
Step 2 - Online Registration: Complete the registration form with your Name, DOB (as per 10th certificate), Mobile Number, and Email ID. User ID and Password will be sent via SMS and Email.
Step 3 - Fill Application Form: Log in with credentials and fill Personal Details, Educational Qualifications (B.Sc/GNM), Nursing Council Registration details, and Experience records.

Step 4 - Upload Photographs & Signature: Upload passport-size color photograph (50-80 KB, JPEG) snapped on or after 01 July 2026 clearly indicating candidate's name and date of photo printed at the bottom. Upload scanned signature (50-200 KB).

Step 5 - Upload Mandatory Documents: Upload scanned copies of 10th certificate, 12th marksheet, degree/diploma, nursing registration certificate, category certificate, and 50-bed hospital experience certificate.
Step 6 - Exam City Choice: Select your preferred examination city from the 29 available cities.

Step 7 - Fee Payment & Printout: Pay application fee (₹1,500 for UR/OBC/EWS, ₹800 for SC/ST, free for PwBD) via Net Banking or Debit/Credit card. Download and preserve the payment slip and final submitted application form.

CBT Medium & Negative Marking: The online examination is conducted strictly in English medium with 0.25 negative marking per incorrect answer.
Duplicate Applications: Submitting multiple applications will lead to cancellation of previous applications; only the latest submitted application will be considered.

faqs.question: What are the educational qualifications required for PGIMER Nursing Officer 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have either a B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized institute with State Nursing Council registration (RN/RM) with NO experience required; OR a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) with State Nursing Council registration PLUS at least 1 year experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital.

faqs.question: Is there any clinical experience required for B.Sc. Nursing candidates?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates possessing B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing, regular B.Sc. Nursing, or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing do NOT require any hospital work experience. They are eligible immediately upon acquiring their degree and State Nursing Council registration.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as on the application closing date of 03 October 2026 (born between 04 October 1991 and 03 October 2008). Relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for the CBT?
faqs.answer: The Computer Based Test (CBT) consists of 100 multiple choice questions (100 marks) for 100 minutes duration conducted in English language only. There is negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer. Qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD.

faqs.question: Is there an interview for PGIMER Nursing Officer posts?
faqs.answer: No. As per Government of India policy, personal interviews have been dispensed with for all Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted) posts. Final selection is based 100% on the merit score secured in the Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by document verification.

faqs.question: What special instruction is given for the uploaded photograph in the PGIMER application?
faqs.answer: The photograph must be taken on or after 01 July 2026 and must clearly display the candidate's name and the date of taking the photograph printed at the bottom. The image must be between 50 and 80 KB in JPEG format with a light background and without caps or dark goggles.

overview: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB), Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu / ZamZam Complex Rambagh, Srinagar, has issued Advertisement Notification No. 08 of 2026 dated 04th August 2026 for direct recruitment to 518 UT, Divisional, and District Cadre posts across four key government departments: Health and Medical Education (421 posts), Higher Education (48 posts), Agriculture Production (46 posts), and Labour and Employment (3 posts).

The 518 vacancies span critical technical, paramedical, and executive designations including Junior Pharmacist (211 posts), Junior Staff Nurse (48 posts), Junior Laboratory Assistant (48 posts), Female Multipurpose Public Health Worker / FMPHW (46 posts), Horticulture Technician Grade-IV (45 posts), Junior Lab Technician (40 posts), Male Multipurpose Public Health Worker / MMPHW (19 posts), Junior Ophthalmic Technician (17 posts), Health Educator (15 posts), Sanitary Inspector (14 posts), Junior Theatre Technician (10 posts), Supervisor (3 posts), Senior Canning Attendant (1 post), and Para Medical Assistant (1 post).

Candidates must be bona fide Domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir possessing a valid Domicile Certificate issued on or before the cut-off date (09 October 2026). Educational criteria range from Matriculation, 10+2 with specialized technical training/diplomas (Basic Horticulture, Pharmacy, GNM, Lab Tech, Operation Theatre, Ophthalmic Tech, FMPHW/MMPHW) to Bachelor's Degree in Science. Pay scales range from Level-2 (₹19,900 – ₹63,200) up to Level-6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400).

Selection will be strictly determined by candidate merit in the Objective Type Written/OMR examination (English medium only, with 0.25 negative marking). There is no viva-voce or interview. Online application registration commenced on 10 September 2026 and closes on 09 October 2026 at www.jkssb.nic.in.

overview: Bank of India (BOI), a leading premier Public Sector Bank headquartered at Star House, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Mumbai, has published official recruitment notification under Project No. 2026-27/02 dated 01.08.2026 for direct recruitment of 205 Specialist Officers in various professional streams across Junior Management Grade Scale-I, Middle Management Grade Scale-II & III, and Senior Management Grade Scale-IV.

The 205 vacancies encompass specialized techno-managerial domains including Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Information Security, DevSecOps, Finacle Application Support, Cloud & Infrastructure Operations, Solution & Technology Architecture, Data Engineering & Analytics, IT Procurement, Database Administration, Law Officers, Fire Officers, Security Officers, and Civil Engineers.

Candidates possessing Bachelor's / Master's degrees in Engineering (IT/Computer Science/Electronics), MCA, Law (LLB), or relevant professional certifications (CISA/CISM/CISSP) and post-qualification experience are eligible to apply. Revised Basic Pay scales range from ₹48,480 (JMGS-I) up to ₹1,20,940 (SMGS-IV) with attractive banking allowances, lease accommodation, and benefits under the Bank's service rules.

Selection involves scrutiny of credentials, an Online Examination comprising English Language (25 Marks, qualifying) and Professional Knowledge (100 Marks, 100 Minutes duration with 0.25 negative marking), followed by a Personal Interview (100 Marks). The final merit weightage between online test and interview is 60:40. Online applications are accepted via IBPS portal from 10 September 2026 to 25 September 2026.

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has released official recruitment notification Rc No. 189 / Rect. / Rect-2 / 2026 dated 29th July 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 7,112 executive and uniformed posts across Telangana Police Department, Special Protection Force (TSPF), Telangana Fire & Disaster Response Department, and Prisons & Correctional Services Department.

The vacancy matrix includes 3,697 posts of Stipendiary Cadet Trainee (SCT) Police Constable (Civil), 1,052 posts of SCT Police Constable (AR), 24 posts of SCT Police Constable (SAR CPL) (Men), 1,380 posts of SCT Constable in Telangana Special Protection Force, 751 posts of Fire Fighter in Fire & Disaster Response Services, 196 posts of Warder (Male), and 12 posts of Warder (Female) in Prisons Department. All posts carry a revised pay scale of ₹24,280 – ₹72,850 plus admissible allowances.

Candidates who have passed Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent recognized by the State Government as on 29th July 2026 are eligible to apply (valid LMV driving license required for Fire Fighter). Under G.O. Ms No. 87 dated 18-05-2026, the Government of Telangana has granted a uniform 5-year upper age limit relaxation for direct recruitment to uniformed services, raising the basic general upper age ceiling from 22 to 27 years as on 1st July 2026, with further 5-year relaxations for SC, ST, BC, and EWS candidates (up to 32 years).

The selection scheme comprises Preliminary Written Test (PWT - 200 Questions, 200 Marks), Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET with 1600m/800m Run, Long Jump, and Shot Put), and Final Written Examination (FWE - 200/100 Marks) followed by Document Verification and Medical Fitness. 95% of district cadre posts are reserved for Local Candidates of Telangana under the Presidential Order 2018. Online application registration is live on www.tgprb.in through 16 September 2026.

howToPayFee: Fee can be paid online only through the payment gateway on the TSLPRB portal (www.tgprb.in).

selectionProcess.description: Objective OMR-based test comprising 1 paper of 200 Questions (Intermediate Standard) for 200 Marks (3 Hours duration). Minimum qualifying cutoff: 30% for OC/EWS (60 marks), 25% for BC (50 marks), and 20% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Home Guards (40 marks). Negative marking: 20% penalty (0.20 marks deducted per wrong answer).

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
selectionProcess.description: First, 1600m Run for Men (within 7m 15s; Ex-SM: 9m 30s) / 800m Run for Women (within 5m 20s) with RFID timing. Height: Men min 167.6 cms (160 cms for ST Agency areas); Women min 152.5 cms (150 cms for ST Agency areas). Qualifying Long Jump (Men: 4.00m, Women: 2.50m) and Shot-Put (Men: 6.00m of 7.26kg, Women: 4.00m of 4kg). For Post Codes 22, 23 & 25, run performance is awarded up to 100 marks via Gradation Table.

Comprehensive 3-Hour examination (Intermediate Standard). Max Marks: 200 for Civil PC (21), Fire Fighter (26), and Warders (27 & 28); Max Marks: 100 for AR PC (22), SAR CPL (23), and SPF Constable (25). Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-SM.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 4: Document Verification & Medical Fitness Examination
selectionProcess.description: Verification of original academic, study/bonafide certificates (Class 1 to 7 for 95% local reservation), community certificate (with sub-classification for SC), BC-NCL, EWS, and LMV license. Followed by strict medical fitness examination at District Headquarters Hospital.

howToApply: Step 1 - Registration: Visit the official TSLPRB website at www.tgprb.in. Register using your 10-digit mobile phone number as your User ID. Keep this number active throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Step 2 - Post Selection & Fee Payment: Select the post(s) you wish to apply for based on your eligibility. Calculate the fee (taking note of multi-post rebates for SC/ST or other categories). Pay the fee via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Step 3 - Part-I Application: Log in with your User ID. Click 'Apply Online' in the main menu to fill in Part-I Application Form with personal, academic, and category details.

Step 4 - Upload Photograph & Signature: Upload a single combined JPG file containing your recent passport-size photograph with your specimen signature below it. File size must be between 30 KB and 100 KB in JPG format.
Step 5 - Declaration & OTP Confirmation: Read all instructions, check 'I AGREE', and confirm your submission with the OTP received on your registered mobile number.

Step 6 - Part-II Application (After PWT): Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Written Test will log in again to fill Part-II Application, exercise post/cadre preferences (Post Codes 21 to 28), and upload scanned certificates.
Step 7 - Print Application Form: Download and print multiple copies of the submitted Part-I and Part-II Application Forms and fee payment receipt for document verification.
howToApplySteps: Visit the official recruitment portal of TSLPRB at https://www.tgprb.in/.
Register using your mobile number as User ID and complete payment of examination fee.
Fill Part-I Online Application form with personal, educational, and reservation details.
Upload scanned image of passport-size photo with signature (30 KB - 100 KB in JPG format).
Submit the form using OTP verification sent to your mobile and print the application summary.
If qualified in PWT, fill Part-II online form with post preferences and certificate uploads.

importantInstructions: 95% Local Reservation: In accordance with the Presidential Order 2018, 95% of vacancies in Police Districts/Commissionerates (Civil PC & AR PC), Revenue Districts (Fire Fighter), and Contiguous District Cadres (Warders) are strictly reserved for Local Candidates of Telangana.

Uniform +5 Years Age Hike: All candidates benefit from the Government of Telangana G.O. Ms No. 87 granting a uniform 5-year upper age extension for uniformed services, setting the unreserved age limit to 18–27 years as on 01 July 2026.

Multi-Post Common Physical Test: Candidates applying for more than one notification issued by TSLPRB within 3 months will undergo PMT/PET only once, and the scores/measurements will remain valid across all notifications.
Negative Marking in PWT: 20% negative marking applies to wrong answers in the Preliminary Written Test (0.20 marks deducted per wrong answer). Unattempted questions carry zero marks.
Single Application Profile: Candidates must not register multiple profiles. One mobile login ID is used across all concurrent TSLPRB notifications.
No Modification Post-Submission: Once Part-I or Part-II applications are submitted, no corrections or changes will be entertained. Ensure all entries are double-checked before generating OTP.
Compulsory Attendance: Candidates must appear for all scheduled tests (PWT, PMT, PET, FWE). Absence in any stage automatically results in outright disqualification.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in TSLPRB Recruitment 2026 under Notification Rc No. 189?
faqs.answer: A total of 7,112 vacancies are notified: 3,697 SCT Police Constable (Civil), 1,052 SCT Police Constable (AR), 24 SCT Police Constable (SAR CPL) (Men), 1,380 SCT Constable in SPF, 751 Fire Fighter in Fire Services Department, 196 Warder (Male), and 12 Warder (Female) in Prisons Department.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification and age limit for TSLPRB Police Constable posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent recognized by the Telangana State Government as on 29 July 2026 (plus valid LMV driving license for Fire Fighter). The age limit is 18 to 27 years for General/OC candidates as on 01 July 2026 (including the uniform 5-year hike under G.O. Ms No. 87), relaxable up to 32 years for BC, SC, ST, and EWS candidates.

faqs.question: What are the physical standards (Height & PET) required for Men and Women?
faqs.answer: Minimum Height: Men must be at least 167.6 cms (160 cms for ST Agency candidates); Women must be at least 152.5 cms (150 cms for ST Agency candidates). In the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Men must complete the 1600 meters Run within 7 minutes 15 seconds, and Women must complete the 800 meters Run within 5 minutes 20 seconds. Qualifying Long Jump (Men: 4.00m, Women: 2.50m) and Shot Put (Men: 6.00m, Women: 4.00m) are also conducted.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for the Preliminary Written Test (PWT)?
faqs.answer: The Preliminary Written Test (PWT) consists of one paper of 200 objective multiple-choice questions for 200 marks with a duration of 3 hours (Intermediate Standard). It covers English, Arithmetic, General Science, History of India, Geography/Polity/Economy, Current Affairs, Reasoning, and Telangana State Topics. A negative marking penalty of 20% (0.20 marks) is deducted for each incorrect answer.

faqs.question: How does the final selection process work for Civil Constable vs AR Constable?
faqs.answer: For SCT Police Constable (Civil), Fire Fighter, and Warders, final selection is based 100% on the score obtained in the Final Written Examination (200 marks). For SCT Police Constable (AR), SAR CPL, and SPF Constable, final selection is based on 200 aggregate marks comprising 100 marks from the Final Written Examination and 100 normalized marks from the Physical Efficiency Test (1600m / 800m Run).

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for TSLPRB Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online application registration on the official TSLPRB portal (www.tgprb.in) closes on 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit Part-I applications, upload photos with signatures, and pay the fee well before the deadline.

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has issued three major detailed recruitment notifications (Rc. Nos. 225, 279, and 234/Rect./2026) dated 29th July 2026 along with an official Press Note dated 10th September 2026 for direct recruitment to 325 executive and technical posts across the Telangana Police Department, Telangana Special Protection Force (TSPF), Telangana State Disaster Response & Fire Services Department, and Telangana Prisons & Correctional Services Department.

The advertised vacancies comprise 275 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 225/Rect./Rect-1/2026 (SCT Sub Inspector of Police Civil - 148, Reserve Sub Inspector AR - 14, Reserve Sub Inspector SAR CPL - 3, Reserve Sub Inspector TGSP - 12, SPF Sub Inspector - 44, Station Fire Officer - 39, Deputy Jailor Men - 14, Deputy Jailor Women - 1); 23 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 279/Rect./Rect-3/2026 for SCT Assistant Sub Inspector (Fingerprint Bureau); and 27 Posts under Notification Rc. No. 234/Rect./Rect-3/2026 for technical posts of SCT Police Constable Mechanics (7) and SCT Police Constable Driver (20).

Under Government Order GO Ms No. 129 dated 09-09-2026 (read with GO Ms No. 87 and GO Ms No. 122), the Government of Telangana has raised the upper age limit by an unprecedented total of 10 years for Constables and 5 years for SI/ASI cadre in uniformed services. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on the official portal (www.tgprb.in) until 5:00 PM on 16 September 2026.

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 1: Preliminary Written Test (PWT) - For SI Cadres Only
selectionProcess.description: One paper of 3 hours duration consisting of 200 objective questions for 200 marks (Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning 100 Qs + General Studies 100 Qs). selectionProcess.stage: Stage 2: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
selectionProcess.description: RFID-based run test: Men must qualify 1600m run in 7 minutes 15 seconds (9 min 30 sec for ESM); Women must qualify 800m run in 5 minutes 20 seconds. Qualified candidates undergo Physical Measurement: Height min 167.6 cm for SI/ASI Men (162 cm for Constable Men; 160 cm for Agency ST Men); Height min 152.5 cm for Women (150 cm for Agency ST Women). Followed by Long Jump (4m Men, 2.5m Women) and Shot Put (6m Men, 4m Women).

selectionProcess.stage: Stage 3: Trade Test / Driving Test (For PC Mechanic & Driver)
selectionProcess.description: For PC Mechanic: 10 parameters evaluated for 100 marks (min 50 marks to qualify). For PC Driver: 8 driving parameters evaluated for 100 marks (min 50 marks to qualify).

For SI Cadres: 4 papers (English 100 marks, Telugu/Urdu 100 marks, Arithmetic & Reasoning 200 marks, General Studies 200 marks). For ASI FPB: 3 papers (English 100 marks, Arithmetic & Reasoning 100 marks, Technical Paper 200 marks). For PC Mechanic/Driver: Technical Objective Paper (200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours).
Original certificate scrutiny and thorough medical fitness evaluation by District Headquarters Hospital / Osmania / Gandhi / Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital.

howToApply: Step 1 - Registration: Visit the TSLPRB portal (www.tgprb.in) and register using your mobile number as User ID.
Step 2 - Post Selection & Fee Payment: Select the posts/notifications you wish to apply for, check the calculated fee, and pay via Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking.
Step 3 - Fill Part-I Application: Log in and fill personal particulars, community details, and local candidature status (Class 1 to 7 study/residence).
Step 4 - Upload Photo & Signature: Upload a combined JPG/JPEG file (30 KB to 100 KB) containing your recent passport-size photograph with specimen signature below it.
Step 5 - Submit & Confirm with OTP: Endorse the declaration, enter the OTP received on your mobile phone, and submit Part-I. Download the PDF copy.

Step 6 - Part-II Application & Document Upload: Prior to PMT/PET, log in again to submit Part-II Application along with scanned copies of educational, community, driving license, and residence certificates before the closing deadline.

overview: District Programme Officer, Amethi (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar Vibhag, Government of Uttar Pradesh) has officially announced direct recruitment advertisement notification (Letter No. C-2615 dated 31.08.2026 and corrigendum C-2667 dated 05.09.2026) inviting online applications from eligible female candidates for 172 vacancies of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Honorarium / Contractual basis) across 13 Child Development Projects (Blocks) in Amethi district.

Only female residents who are permanent inhabitants of the concerned Gram Sabha / Ward in Amethi district and possess minimum Intermediate (10+2 / 12th Pass) qualification with age between 18 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026 are eligible to apply. Selection is purely merit-based calculated proportionally on marks secured in Intermediate (12th), Graduation, and Post-Graduation (percentage divided by 10) without any written test or interview.

Eligible candidates can submit their application online through the departmental portal (upanganwadibharti.in) from 01 September 2026 up to 21 September 2026 (11:59 PM). There is no application fee for any category. Offline or hardcopy applications will not be entertained.

Step 4: Fill in personal details, date of birth strictly as per High School certificate, and enter Marks/Maximum Marks for Class 12th, Graduation, and Post Graduation.

Step 5: Upload mandatory documents: Scanned photograph, signature, 10th certificate, 12th marksheet, degree certificates, online verified Domicile Certificate (निवास प्रमाण पत्र), Caste Certificate (जाति प्रमाण पत्र), and Income Certificate (आय प्रमाण पत्र).

overview: National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) – a Joint Venture of Government of India and the participating State Governments of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh under the administrative control of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – has issued official recruitment notifications Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026 and Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026 dated 10 September 2026 for the induction of Operations & Maintenance (O&M) and Technical staff for the Namo Bharat Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) Project.

A total of 90 vacancies are announced across two categories: 67 posts on Direct Recruitment (Regular) basis under Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026 (Supervisor-I Operations, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil and Junior Maintainer Electrical, Fitter, RAC, Electronics) and 23 posts on Contract (Regular Pay Scale) basis for a 5-year tenure under Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026 (Supervisor-I IT, Full Stack Developer, AFC & NCMC, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications, Electrical, Civil and Junior Maintainer Electrical, Fitter). Selected candidates will draw attractive IDA pay scales of Level S1 (Rs. 37,000–Rs. 1,15,000) for Supervisors and Level NS3 (Rs. 18,250–Rs. 59,200) for Junior Maintainers, supplemented by Variable DA, HRA, and cafeteria perks.

Candidates holding relevant 3-year Engineering Diplomas, Engineering Degrees (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc Engg), ITI (NCVT/SCVT) certificates, or specialized qualifications up to 28 years of age (as on 10 September 2026) are eligible to apply. Selection will be conducted through an objective Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 questions with NO negative marking, followed by comprehensive medical fitness examination (Standards A-3, B-1, or C-1 as per IRMM). Online applications are accepted from 10 September 2026 to 09 October 2026 up to 23:55 hrs.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of NCRTC at https://ncrtc.in and click on the 'Career' section, or directly access https://cdn.digialm.com/EForms/configuredHtml/1258/102029/Index.html.
Step 2: Choose Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026 (for Direct Recruitment) or Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026 (for Contract Basis) and click on the registration link.
Step 3: Register by providing your active Email ID and Mobile Number. A unique Application Number / Login ID and Password will be generated and dispatched.
Step 4: Login and fill in personal details, category, educational qualifications (Degree/Diploma/ITI details, marks, passing year), and select 5 preferred CBT exam cities.
Step 5: Upload scanned photograph (100 KB to 200 KB in JPG/JPEG), signature (80 KB to 150 KB in JPG/JPEG), and category/educational certificates (100 KB to 1000 KB in JPG/JPEG/PDF).
Step 6: Preview the application carefully. Once submitted, details cannot be edited.
Step 7: Pay the application fee of Rs. 500 + GST (if applicable) through Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card.
Step 8: Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and payment acknowledgment receipt for future recruitment reference.

importantInstructions: Two Separate Vacancy Notices: Notice 32/2026 covers 67 Regular O&M posts, while Notice 33/2026 covers 23 Contractual posts on regular IDA pay scales for a 5-year term.
Strict No Negative Marking: Unlike many metro exams, NCRTC CBT has NO negative marking for incorrect answers.
Multi-Post Applications: Candidates can apply for more than one post by submitting separate application forms and fees, but CBT for multiple posts may be scheduled on the same date/shift.
Lasik Surgery Barred for A-3 & B-1: Candidates who have undergone LASIK surgery or radial keratotomy are disqualified from technical posts requiring A-3 and B-1 medical standards.
Surety Bond Mandate: Selected candidates must serve NCRTC for a minimum of 3 years or pay the bond penalty (Rs. 4 Lakhs for Supervisors, Rs. 3 Lakhs for Maintainers).
Closing Deadline: Applications close promptly at 23:55 hrs on 09 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced by NCRTC in 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 90 vacancies have been announced across two notifications: 67 posts under Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment / Regular O&M Staff) and 23 posts under Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026 (Contractual on Regular Pay Scale Basis for 5 Years).

faqs.question: What are the posts available in NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The positions include Supervisor-I (Operations, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, IT, Full Stack Developer, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications) in IDA Level S1 (Rs. 37,000–Rs. 1,15,000) and Junior Maintainer (Electrical, Fitter, RAC, Electronics) in IDA Level NS3 (Rs. 18,250–Rs. 59,200).

faqs.question: What is the age limit and cut-off date for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as on the cut-off date of 10 September 2026 (born between 11.09.1998 and 10.09.2008). Relaxation is admissible for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years), and Ex-SM as per Central Government rules.

faqs.question: Is there any negative marking in the NCRTC Computer Based Test (CBT)?
faqs.answer: No, there is NO negative marking in the NCRTC CBT. Each of the 100 questions carries 1 mark, with an exam duration of 90 minutes.

faqs.question: Can B.E. / B.Tech degree holders apply for Supervisor posts?
faqs.answer: Yes, for Supervisor-I (Operations), any Engineering Degree or Diploma is eligible. For Supervisor-I in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, candidates with full-time B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc (Engg) in the relevant discipline are explicitly permitted. However, for Junior Maintainer posts, an ITI qualification is strictly mandatory.

faqs.question: What is the surety bond amount in NCRTC?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates must execute a Surety Bond to serve NCRTC for a minimum of 3 years: Rs. 4,00,000/- for Supervisor-I posts and Rs. 3,00,000/- for Junior Maintainer posts, along with a 1-month prior notice requirement before resignation.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The closing date for online application submission and fee payment is 09 October 2026 up to 23:55 hrs.

overview: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially published Advertisement No. 11/2026 inviting Online Recruitment Applications (ORA) for direct recruitment by selection to 212 prestigious Group 'A' and Group 'B' Gazetted positions across various Central Government Ministries, Departments, Union Territories, and Autonomous Councils through the official Commission portal at https://upsconline.nic.in.

The 212 vacancies announced under this recruitment drive include 140 posts of Assistant Public Prosecutor in the Directorate of Prosecution (Home Department, Govt. of NCT of Delhi); 60 posts of Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine) and 4 posts of Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy) in the Department of Health and Family Welfare (Ministry of Health & Family Welfare); 4 posts of Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer / Law Officer in the Law and Justice Department (Administration of UT of Ladakh); 2 posts of Assistant Editor in the Indian Bureau of Mines (Ministry of Mines); and 2 Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) posts in Anaesthesiology (1) and Paediatrics (1) under New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC).

Eligible Indian citizens with medical degrees (MBBS + MD/MS/DNB), Law degrees (LL.B with Bar experience), or Journalism qualifications can complete their registration on the UPSC portal. The closing date for submission of online applications is 18:00 Hours on 02 October 2026 for all posts other than UT of Ladakh, and 18:00 Hours on 09 October 2026 for the Ladakh Law Officer post.

Navigate to the fourth module (Post/Vacancy Specific Module) and select the desired post under Advertisement No. 11/2026.
Fill in all educational qualifications, Bar council registrations, teaching experience, and upload supporting documents in PDF format.
Pay the application fee of ₹25/- online (exempted for Female, SC, ST, and PwBD applicants).
Submit the online recruitment application before 18:00 HRS on 02 October 2026 (or 09 October 2026 for Ladakh Law Officer).
Take a printout of the submitted application form for submission during the interview stage.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in UPSC Advertisement No. 11/2026?
faqs.answer: UPSC Advertisement No. 11/2026 announces a total of 212 vacancies across 7 distinct cadres, including 140 Assistant Public Prosecutors, 60 Assistant Professors in General Medicine, 4 Assistant Professors in Anatomy, 4 Law Officers in Ladakh, 2 Assistant Editors in IBM, and 2 Specialists in NDMC.

faqs.question: What is the application closing date for UPSC Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: The closing date for submission of online recruitment applications is 18:00 Hours on 02 October 2026 for Posts 1 to 6, and 18:00 Hours on 09 October 2026 for the Ladakh Law Officer post (Post 7).

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UPSC Advt 11/2026 and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹25/- for General, OBC, and EWS male candidates. All female applicants, SC, ST, and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates are completely exempted from payment of fees.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification and experience for Assistant Public Prosecutor (APP)?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law (LL.B) from a recognized University or Institute and at least three years of active practice experience at the Bar.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Assistant Public Prosecutor in Delhi Directorate of Prosecution?
faqs.answer: The normal upper age limit is 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC, and 40 years for SC/ST. Contractual employees of the Directorate of Prosecution get an age relaxation of up to 5 years.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Specialist Grade III Assistant Professors in CHS?
faqs.answer: Specialist Grade III Assistant Professors (Anatomy and General Medicine) are placed in Pay Level-11 (₹67,700 - ₹2,08,700) plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for the Law Officer / District Litigation Officer post in Ladakh?
faqs.answer: Only candidates who are Domiciles of the Union Territory of Ladakh holding a valid Ladakh Resident Certificate (LRC Category A or Category B) with a Law degree and 2 years of certified bar practice are eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What are the minimum qualifying marks in the UPSC interview for Advt 11/2026?
faqs.answer: Out of 100 marks in the interview, the category-wise minimum suitability marks are: UR/EWS - 50 marks, OBC - 45 marks, and SC/ST/PwBD - 40 marks.

faqs.question: What are the special photo and signature requirements on the UPSC portal?

overview: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a leading profit-making 'Navratna' Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Government of India with annual operational revenues exceeding ₹18,690 crores, has officially published recruitment advertisement No. 16022026. The enterprise invites applications from dynamic, qualified, and ambitious Indian Nationals for engagement as Management Trainees (MT) across 14 specialized engineering, scientific, and corporate disciplines.

The 94 Management Trainee positions comprise Chemical (32), Boiler (6, including 4 backlog), Mechanical (4), Electrical (10), Instrumentation (9), Materials (1), Civil (1), Fire (1), CC Lab (1), Industrial Engineering (2), Information Technology (5), Rajbhasha (2), Finance (10), and Marketing (10). Category-wise distribution provides 34 UR, 26 OBC (NCL), 12 SC, 12 EWS, and 10 ST seats, with horizontal reservation for 4 PwBD candidates. During the 1-year training period, selected candidates receive a monthly lump sum stipend of ₹60,000/- plus free company hostel accommodation. Upon absorption in regular E1 Grade (₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000/-), gross monthly emoluments will be approximately ₹86,320/-.

Candidates holding regular 4-year B.E. / B.Tech degrees with at least 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST), CA/CMA, MBA, or relevant Post-Graduate qualifications can apply online on the official RCF website at www.rcfltd.com via the IBPS registration portal. Selection is based on an Online Computer-Based Objective Test (80% weightage) conducted across major metropolitan cities followed by a Personal Interview (20% weightage).

overview: Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL), a premier State-owned Power Transmission Utility under the Government of Odisha, has officially released employment advertisement notification No. OPTCL-14013/9/2026-T AND D – Part (1) - 14389 dated 29 August 2026 for engagement of 100 Graduate (Engineering & Non-Engineering), Diploma Technician, and Trade (ITI) Apprentices for a one-year apprenticeship training period under The Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended in 1961, 1973 & 2014).

The 100 training seats are allocated across four distinct apprentice categories: Degree Engineering Apprentices (32 Electrical, 1 IT, 1 Telecom); Degree Non-Engineering Apprentices (4 Human Resources, 2 Finance, 1 Law); Diploma Technician Apprentices (20 Electrical, 1 Telecom, 2 Civil); and ITI Trade Apprentices (33 Electrician, 3 Electronic Mechanic). Monthly stipends are fixed at ₹12,300 for Graduate Apprentices, ₹10,900 for Diploma Apprentices, and ₹9,600 for ITI Apprentices. 50% of the stipend is disbursed directly by OPTCL, while the remaining 50% is paid by the Board of Practical Training (BOPT) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

Only Indian Nationals belonging to the State of Odisha who are at least 18 years of age as on 01 August 2026 and have passed their qualifying examination during Academic Years 2023-24, 2024-25, or 2025-26 (holding marksheets/certificates as on 01 July 2026) are eligible to apply. Applicants must first register on the NATS 2.0 or NAPS portal and then complete online submission on the OPTCL corporate website at www.optcl.co.in by 01 October 2026 (11:59 PM).

overview: Office of the District Programme Officer, Jalaun (Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar, Government of Uttar Pradesh) has officially published employment press notice Letter No. C-2117/Ji.Ka./Ba.Vi.Pari./A.Ba.Chayan/2026-27 dated 09 September 2026 pursuant to Government Order No. 2025/3313(1)/58-1-2025(1917687) dated 17 September 2025. Online applications are invited through the official departmental portal at https://www.upanganwadibharti.in for direct recruitment to 110 honorarium-based vacancies of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) in urban and rural Child Development Projects across District Jalaun.

The 110 vacancies comprise 18 Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) posts (UR: 17, SC: 1) and 92 Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) posts (UR: 61, OBC: 20, SC: 11). The positions are distributed across 10 Child Development Projects in Jalaun district: Dakor (30), Kadaura (25), Nadigaon (16), Mahewa (12), Konch (7), Madhaugarh (5), Rampura (5), Kuthaund (4), Orai Urban (4), and Jalaun (2). Selection is conducted strictly on academic merit calculated on the basis of marks obtained from Intermediate (10+2) up to Post-Graduation.

Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the respective Gram Sabha or Urban Ward in District Jalaun, aged between 18 and 35 years as on 01 July 2026, and holding a minimum educational qualification of Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent are eligible to apply. Preference will be given to BPL category candidates, widows, and legally divorced/destitute women. The last date to submit online applications is 30 September 2026 up to 12:00 Midnight.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 for District Jalaun?

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification for Jalaun Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2 / 12th standard) or an equivalent examination from a recognized Board. Candidates with higher qualifications up to Post-Graduation can also apply, and their marks will be factored into the merit index.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Anganwadi Worker and Helper in Jalaun?

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for Jalaun Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for Jalaun Anganwadi Bharti?
faqs.answer: No, the application process is completely free of cost for all categories of female applicants.

faqs.question: How is the merit list prepared for Anganwadi selection in UP?
faqs.answer: Merit is calculated by taking the percentage of marks in Intermediate, Graduation, and Post-Graduation divided by 10. First preference is accorded to eligible BPL category applicants, followed by Widows and Divorced/Destitute women.

faqs.question: Which projects have vacancies in Jalaun district?

faqs.question: What documents are required to prove local residence?

overview: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC), Lucknow has officially published Advertisement No. 21-Exam/2026 (विज्ञापन संख्या-21-परीक्षा/2026) for the State Institute of Rural Development (Senior Instructor Cadre) Main Examination (PET-2025)/21 [राज्य ग्राम्य विकास संस्थान (ज्येष्ठ अनुदेशक संवर्ग) मुख्य परीक्षा (प्रा0अ0प0-2025)/21]. Online applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens for direct recruitment to 132 permanent Group 'C' posts of Senior Instructor (ज्येष्ठ अनुदेशक) across 13 specialized disciplines under the Director General, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya State Institute of Rural Development (DDU SIRD), Bakshi Ka Talab, Lucknow.

Candidates possessing a valid scorecard of UP Preliminary Eligibility Test - PET 2025 (प्रारम्भिक अर्हता परीक्षा-2025) with positive (non-zero/non-negative) normalized marks and meeting the prescribed discipline-wise educational qualifications (such as B.Tech/Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering, B.Sc Agriculture, B.V.Sc/M.Sc Animal Husbandry, B.Sc Home Science/Nutrition, M.A./M.Sc Economics/Sociology/M.Com, or Sanitary Inspector Certification) are eligible to register online. Shortlisting for the Main Examination will be conducted in a 15:1 ratio per category on the basis of PET-2025 normalized scores.

The online registration, application form submission, and fee payment portal opens on 14 September 2026 and closes on 05 October 2026. Candidates are permitted to reconcile fees and rectify permissible fields in their application forms until 12 October 2026. All selected appointees will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) along with standard state government allowances.

education: Mandatory PET Requirement: Candidates must have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test - PET 2025 (प्रा0अ0प0-2025) conducted by UPSSSC and possess an official valid scorecard with positive (non-zero and non-negative) normalized marks.
Discipline-Wise Academic Qualifications (Minimum 50% Marks in Qualifying Degree, 55% for Agriculture PG):
1. Agricultural Engineering: Bachelor's Degree in Agricultural Engineering (B.Tech / B.E. in Agricultural Engineering) with at least 50% marks.
2. Plant Protection: B.Sc in Agriculture with at least 50% marks.
3. Horticulture Science: B.Sc in Agriculture with at least 50% marks.
4. Animal Husbandry: B.V.Sc (Bachelor of Veterinary Science) OR M.Sc in Animal Husbandry with at least 50% marks.
5. Agronomy: B.Sc in Agriculture with at least 50% marks.
6. Women Welfare: B.Sc in Home Science / Home Economics / Nutrition / Dietetics with at least 50% marks.
7. Cooperation: M.A. in Economics OR M.Sc in Agricultural Economics OR M.Com with at least 50% marks.
8. Panchayat: M.A. in Economics OR M.Sc in Agricultural Economics OR M.A. in Sociology with at least 50% marks.
9. Soil Science: B.Sc in Agriculture with at least 50% marks.
10. Agriculture: Master's Degree (Post-Graduation) in Agriculture with at least 55% marks.
11. Agricultural Extension: B.Sc in Agriculture with at least 50% marks.
12. Public Health: Bachelor's Degree in any stream + State Government recognized Sanitary Inspector Certificate.
13. Production: Degree in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering OR Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering with at least 2 years relevant experience.

Preferential Qualifications (अधिमानी अर्हताएं): 3 years relevant teaching/training/extension/manufacturing experience in the concerned subject, minimum 2 years service in Territorial Army, or NCC 'B' Certificate.
eligibility.ageLimit: Minimum 21 Years and Maximum 40 Years as on 01 July 2026. Candidate must have been born not earlier than 02 July 1986 and not later than 01 July 2005.

Candidates from Other States (Non-UP): No age relaxation or vertical/horizontal reservation benefits; considered under Unreserved (UR) category.
experience: Production Discipline (Diploma Holders): Mandatory minimum 2 years of relevant field/industrial experience.
