howToPayFee: Application processing fees must be remitted strictly online using State Bank of India (SBI) Multi Option Payment System (MOPS).
Accepted Payment Channels: Internet Banking, Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), or SBI e-Challan at any SBI branch.
Double Verification: If fee reconciliation is delayed, applicants can click 'Update Your Transaction ID by Double Verification' on the UPSSSC portal homepage under Applicant Segment.
Main Examination Fee: Candidates shortlisted for the Main Exam will be required to deposit the prescribed Main Examination Fee separately before downloading their Main Exam Admit Cards.

examCentres.details: The Main Written Examination will be conducted at designated examination centers across Lucknow and other divisional headquarters in Uttar Pradesh. Examination city and venue details will be communicated via Admit Cards on upsssc.gov.in.

selectionProcess.description: Candidates are shortlisted for the Main Examination strictly on the basis of their Normalized Score in the UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET-2025). Category-wise 15 times the number of advertised vacancies (including all applicants securing equal marks at the cutoff) will be called for the Written Exam.

Objective Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) offline/online paper comprising 100 questions for 100 marks of 2 hours (120 minutes) duration. There is negative marking of 25% (1/4th mark) for each incorrect answer.

Scrutiny of original educational marksheets, degrees, category certificates (issued on or before 05.10.2026), EWS certificate (issued between 01.04.2026 and 05.10.2026 for FY 2026-27), domicile, and photo ID. Candidates will record their cadre/post preferences during DV.
Final merit rank list is prepared purely on marks obtained in the Main Written Examination. As per UP Government rules, interview has been completely abolished for Group 'C' posts.

examPattern.markingScheme: +1 mark for each correct answer; -0.25 mark (25% negative marking) for each incorrect answer

sections.subject: Subject-Specific Knowledge related to Rural Development (ग्राम्य विकास से संबंधित विषयगत ज्ञान)
Analytical Ability and Data Interpretation (विश्लेषणात्मक क्षमता तथा डेटा इंटरप्रिटेशन)
Computer and Information Technology Concepts, Contemporary Developments & Innovations (AI, Big Data, Machine Learning, IoT, Cybersecurity)
General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (UP History, Culture, Geography, Polity, Economy, Agriculture & Current Affairs)

syllabus.section: Part 1: Subject-Specific Knowledge Related to Rural Development (50 Questions / 50 Marks)
topics: Characteristics of Indian Agriculture and the Indian Economy.
Soil and Water Conservation; Soil Pollution and Water Pollution causes and remedies.
Cooperatives, Agricultural Marketing, and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Agricultural Education, Rural Training Methodologies, and Extension Methodologies.
General Information and Flagship Schemes related to Public Health and Rural Sanitation (Swachh Bharat Mission Gramin, Jal Jeevan Mission, etc.).
Government Schemes and National/State Programs related to Rural Development (MGNREGA, PMAY-G, NRLM, PMGSY, etc.).
The Panchayati Raj System, 73rd Constitutional Amendment, Three-tier Panchayati Raj Structure, and Gram Panchayat Development Plans (GPDP).
Central and State Government Schemes related to Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy, and Fisheries.
Information, Schemes, and Protective Legislations related to Women and Child Development (Mission Shakti, Poshan Abhiyaan, Kanya Sumangala, etc.).
Social Welfare, Rural Poverty Alleviation, and Livelihood Schemes for Rural Society.

syllabus.section: Part 1: Analytical Ability and Data Interpretation (15 Questions / 15 Marks)
topics: Logical Reasoning: Statements and Assumptions, Statements and Arguments, Statements and Conclusions.
Logical Deductions, Critical Reasoning, and Decision Making.
Interpretation and Analysis of Tabular and Statistical Data.
Statistical Analysis: Interpretation of Bar Graphs, Histograms, Pie Charts, Line Graphs, and Diagrams to draw knowledge-based inferences and logical conclusions.

syllabus.section: Part 2: Concepts of Computer & Information Technology and Contemporary Innovations (15 Questions / 15 Marks)
topics: History, Introduction, and Fundamentals of Computers, Information Technology, Internet, and World Wide Web (WWW).
Hardware Architecture and Software Components; Input and Output Peripherals.
Networking Concepts: Internet Protocol (IP), IP Addressing, DNS, and LAN/WAN.
IT Gadgets, Mobile Devices, Tablets, Printers, and their practical operating applications.
Email Operations: Creation of Email IDs, sending/receiving attachments, and formal email management.
Word Processing (MS Word / LibreOffice Writer) and Spreadsheet Processing (MS Excel / LibreOffice Calc) key features, formulas, and formatting.
Operating Systems (Windows, Linux, Android), Social Networking Platforms, and e-Governance Portals.
Digital Financial Tools: UPI, AEPS, USSD, Cards, Internet Banking, and Digital Wallets.
Future Skills, Information Security, Cyber Threats, and Cyber Security best practices.
Emerging Technological Innovations: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data Processing, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Internet of Things (IoT), and India's landmark achievements in technology.

syllabus.section: Part 3: General Information Related to Uttar Pradesh (20 Questions / 20 Marks)
topics: History of Uttar Pradesh, Ancient Civilizations, Medieval History, and Freedom Struggle (1857 Rebellion & National Movement in UP).
Art, Architecture, Historical Monuments, and UNESCO Heritage Sites in UP.
Culture, Festivals, Fairs, Folk Dances (Kathak, Nautanki, Charkula, Raslila), Folk Songs, and Cultural Institutions.
Literature, Renowned Authors, Poets, and Regional Dialects / Languages of Uttar Pradesh (Bhojpuri, Awadhi, Braj Bhasha, Bundelkhandi, Urdu, Hindi).
Social Customs, Traditions, and Tourism Destinations in UP.
Geographical Landscape, Physical Features, Relief, Climate, Soils, and River Drainage Systems.
Natural Resources, Forest Cover, Wildlife Sanctuaries, National Parks, and Mines & Minerals in UP.
Economy of Uttar Pradesh, Budgetary Highlights, Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP), Industrial Policies, and One District One Product (ODOP) Scheme.
Agriculture, Cropping Patterns, Irrigation Infrastructure, Horticulture, and Animal Husbandry in UP.
State Polity, Administrative Framework, Legislature, Judiciary (High Court of Allahabad), and Local Self-Governance.
Current Affairs, Major State Events, Infrastructure Projects (Expressways, Airports, Metros), and Notable State Government Awards & Achievements.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official UPSSSC portal at https://upsssc.gov.in and click on 'Live Advertisement Segment'.
Step 2: Select Notification No. '21-Exam/2026' for Senior Instructor Cadre Main Examination (PET-2025)/21 and click 'Apply'.

Step 3: Candidate Authentication / Login: Authenticate through your UPSSSC PET-2025 Registration Number either via Registered Mobile/Email OTP or Personal Details (DOB, Gender, UP Domicile, Category).

Step 4: Application Form Completion: Pre-populated demographic and personal data from PET-2025 will be displayed. Verify all fields, select the qualifying post(s) as per your eligible academic degree/diploma, and enter qualifying marks, roll number, and university.
Step 5: Photo & Signature: Photograph and signature will be fetched automatically from your PET-2025 profile; check preview and click 'Continue'.
Step 6: Declaration & Submission: Read the self-declaration statements, verify preview details, enter the captcha verification code, and click 'Submit'.
Step 7: Fee Payment: Proceed to the payment gateway and pay the ₹25 online processing fee via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, UPI, or SBI e-Challan.
Step 8: Application Printout: After successful fee reconciliation, download and print the final submitted application form for future document verification.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 (Advt 21-Exam/2026)?
faqs.answer: A total of 132 permanent Group 'C' posts of Senior Instructor (ज्येष्ठ अनुदेशक) have been announced under the Director General, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya State Institute of Rural Development (DDU SIRD), Bakshi Ka Talab, Lucknow across 13 specialized disciplines.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have appeared in UPSSSC PET-2025 and possess a valid scorecard with positive (non-zero/non-negative) normalized marks, aged between 21 and 40 years as on 01 July 2026, and holding the relevant degree/diploma in the concerned discipline (e.g. B.Tech Agri Engg, B.Sc Agriculture, B.V.Sc/M.Sc Animal Husbandry, B.Sc Home Science, M.A./M.Sc Economics/Sociology, M.Com, or Sanitary Inspector Certificate) with at least 50% marks (55% for PG in Agriculture) are eligible.

faqs.question: What are the important online application dates for UPSSSC Advt 21-Exam/2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 14 September 2026 and close on 05 October 2026. The deadline for fee reconciliation and application form corrections is 12 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: All categories of candidates (Unreserved, OBC, SC, ST, EWS, Women, Ex-SM, PwBD) are required to pay only an online processing fee of ₹25.00 at the initial application stage. Shortlisted candidates will pay the Main Exam fee separately prior to downloading admit cards.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for UPSSSC Senior Instructor (DDU SIRD)?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates are appointed in Pay Matrix Level-6 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the 7th CPC along with Dearness Allowance, HRA, and other state allowances, resulting in an in-hand monthly salary of approx. ₹52,000 to ₹58,000.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern and marking scheme for the Senior Instructor Main Written Exam?
faqs.answer: The examination comprises a single paper of 100 objective multiple-choice questions (MCQs) carrying 100 marks for a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). It covers Rural Development Subject Knowledge (50 marks), Analytical Ability & Data Interpretation (15 marks), Computer & IT (15 marks), and General Knowledge of Uttar Pradesh (20 marks). There is a negative marking of 0.25 mark (25%) for each wrong answer.

faqs.question: Can candidates from states other than Uttar Pradesh apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, any citizen of India possessing a valid UPSSSC PET-2025 scorecard and the prescribed educational qualifications can apply. However, candidates residing outside Uttar Pradesh will be treated under the Unreserved (UR) category and cannot claim caste or age relaxation benefits.

overview: India Optel Limited (IOL), a premier Defence Public Sector Undertaking (DPSU) under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, has officially released employment advertisement notice No. IOLHqrs/100(6)/2026-Rectt. (CBC 10622/11/0050/2627, EN 24/36). The organization invites offline applications from eligible Indian Nationals for engagement of 160 professionals across various technical, engineering, and administrative disciplines on temporary basis through Fixed Term Contract.

The 160 contractual positions comprise 98 Project Technician positions across Fitter Instruments (39), Fitter Electronics (43), Machinist (3), Optical Worker (12), and Electroplater (1) trades; 57 Junior Project Engineer vacancies across Chemical (1), Electrical (2), Electronics (23), Mechanical (24), and Optics & Coating (7) disciplines; 3 Welfare Officer posts; and 2 Consultant (Coordination) roles. The vertical category distribution provides 78 UR, 29 OBC (NCL), 28 SC, 19 EWS, and 6 ST seats, alongside horizontal reservation for 6 PwBD and 13 Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates.

Candidates holding relevant ITI / NAC certificates, Engineering Diplomas, B.E. / B.Tech degrees, or relevant professional qualifications can submit their duly completed application forms along with self-attested credentials to Corporate HQ at Dehradun. The closing deadline for receipt of applications is the 21st day from the date of publication in Employment News, i.e., 02 October 2026. Complete advertisement details and updates are hosted on the official IOL portal at https://www.indiaoptel.in.

overview: Goa Staff Selection Commission (GSSC), Panaji, has officially announced employment Advertisement No. 3 of Year 2026 (Notification No. 1/164/2026-GSSC/883 dated 11 September 2026) inviting online applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to 222 Group 'C' vacancies across various departments of the Government of Goa. The advertised positions include 204 posts of Lower Division Clerk / Recovery Clerk across 35 state departments, 13 posts of Junior Assistant (General Administration Department and Lok Bhavan), 3 posts of Desktop Publishing Operator (Department of Printing & Stationery), and 2 posts of Data Entry Operator (Chief Electoral Officer and Directorate of Mines & Geology).

Candidates applying for LDC/Recovery Clerk, Junior Assistant, and DEO must possess a Higher Secondary School Certificate (10+2 / HSSC) or AICTE-approved Diploma, minimum 6 months computer course certificate (exempted for CS/IT degree/diploma holders or ITI COPA candidates), English typing speed of 30 wpm, and at least 1 year of working experience (candidates with benchmark disabilities are fully exempted from the experience clause). Desktop Publishing Operator applicants require HSSC, NCVT DTP certificate or Apprenticeship, 3 years printing experience, CorelDraw/Layout proficiency, 40 wpm typing, and Devnagari software knowledge. All candidates must possess valid 15-year Goa residence certificates, active registration with Employment Exchange Goa, and mandatory knowledge of Konkani (knowledge of Marathi is desirable).

Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on the official Goa SSC recruitment portal at https://gssc.goa.gov.in on or before 02 October 2026. The selection methodology involves a Two-Tier Computer Based Test (CBT-I screening followed by CBT-II merit examination) and a qualifying English typing test. A mandatory rule governs CBT-I: candidates must score at least 4 out of 10 marks in the Konkani Language section (Questions 1 to 10) to qualify for further evaluation and merit preparation.

overview: The Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh, Office of the Chairman, Ladakh Police Subordinate Service Recruitment Board (LPSSRB), has released Advertisement Notification No. 02 of 2026 dated 24 August 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 331 vacancies of Constable (Level-02), General Cadre in Ladakh Police. The recruitment drive encompasses 141 vacancies in the Executive, Armed/IRP, and SDRF cadres, 168 vacancies in the Border Battalion across 5 border districts (Nubra, Changthang, Sham, Kargil, and Drass), and 22 vacancies in the Women Battalion across 7 districts (Leh, Nubra, Changthang, Zanskar, and Drass) under the Ladakh Police (Subordinate) Service Recruitment (Revised) Rules, 2026.

Candidates must have passed 10th Class (Matriculation) from a recognized Board of School Education. Serving Special Police Officers (SPOs) of Ladakh Police who have completed at least 3 years of continuous engagement on the application cutoff date are eligible with an 8th Pass qualification. Possession of a valid Domicile Certificate of the Union Territory of Ladakh is compulsory for all candidates. Applicants for the Border Battalion must hold a valid domicile certificate establishing residence in an eligible border village, while Women Battalion candidates are eligible to compete strictly within their respective domicile districts. The age limit is 18 to 28 years as on 01 January 2026, relaxable up to 33 years for SC/ST/ALC and up to 37 years for serving SPOs (3+ years) and Voluntary Home Guards (5+ years). Appointees will draw 7th CPC Level-02 pay (₹19,900 – ₹63,200) along with High Altitude allowances.

The selection will be conducted through a Transparent Recruitment Process (TRP) utilizing RFID electronic timing tags, digital distance measurement, biometric authentication, and CCTV video recording. The selection process commences with the Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET) starting 22 September 2026 onwards, followed by original document scrutiny, evaluation of incentive marks (up to 5% for LMV driving licence with transport endorsement or 1-year AICTE computer course diploma, and 2% to 5% for NCC A/B/C certificates), and a 100-mark written examination (bilingual in English and Hindi, 80 minutes, 100 MCQs, no negative marking). Eligible candidates must submit their application forms on the official Ladakh Police portal at https://police.ladakh.gov.in on or before 15 September 2026.

Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET) are strictly qualifying in nature. Disqualification in PST or PET bars candidates from appearing in the written examination.
Candidates may claim incentive marks for EITHER driving licence OR computer diploma, but NOT both (maximum 5% / 5 marks).
The 100-mark written examination has NO negative marking. The paper is bilingual in English and Hindi with an 80-minute duration.
The Transparent Recruitment Process (TRP) employs RFID timing tags, sensor-based fall detection, biometric scans, and CCTV recording across all event venues.
Appointees are liable to serve anywhere within the Union Territory of Ladakh as required by the Administration.

faqs.question: What is the total vacancy count in Ladakh Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 331 Constable (Level-02) vacancies are advertised under Notification No. 02 of 2026. This includes 141 posts in General Cadre (Executive, Armed/IRP, SDRF), 168 posts in Border Battalion (Nubra 71, Changthang 40, Sham 13, Kargil 43, Drass 1), and 22 posts in Women Battalion (Leh 4, Nubra 4, Changthang 3, Zanskar 2, Drass 9).

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for Ladakh Police Constable recruitment?
faqs.answer: The online application portal on https://police.ladakh.gov.in opened on 29 August 2026 and closes on 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit well before the closing date.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Ladakh Police Constable?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th Class (Matriculation) from a recognized Board of School Education. Serving Special Police Officers (SPOs) of Ladakh Police with at least 3 years of continuous engagement are eligible with an 8th Pass qualification.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and crucial date for age determination?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as on 01 January 2026 (born between 02 January 1998 and 01 January 2008). Upper age is relaxable by 5 years (up to 33 years) for SC, ST, and ALC candidates, and up to 37 years for serving SPOs (3+ years continuous service) and VHGs (5+ years continuous service).

faqs.question: What are the Physical Standard (PST) and Physical Endurance (PET) requirements?
faqs.answer: For Male candidates: Minimum Height is 162 cm, Chest 81 cm (expanded 85 cm), 1600m race in 7 min 30 sec, 12 ft long jump (3 attempts), and 20 push-ups. For Female candidates: Minimum Height is 152 cm, 1200m race in 7 min 30 sec, 9 ft long jump (3 attempts), and 4 kg shot put for 14.5 ft (3 attempts). PST and PET are purely qualifying in nature.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus and marking pattern for the written examination?
faqs.answer: The written test comprises 100 objective MCQs (100 marks) with an 80-minute duration, bilingual in English and Hindi, at matriculation level. There is NO negative marking. Syllabus: General Knowledge (60 marks, including Ladakh History, Art, Culture, Geography), Arithmetic Abilities (15 marks), Reasoning (15 marks), and General Science (10 marks).

faqs.question: How are incentive marks awarded for NCC and technical qualifications?
faqs.answer: Candidates can earn up to 5% incentive marks (5 marks) for holding a valid LMV Driving Licence with transport endorsement OR a 1-year AICTE-recognized Computer Diploma. In addition, NCC certificate holders receive: 5% for NCC 'C', 3% for NCC 'B', and 2% for NCC 'A' certificate.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and how can it be paid?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹600 for Unreserved (UR) and EWS candidates, and ₹500 for SC, ST, and ALC candidates. Fees must be paid online via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, or UPI on the Recruitment Application Software (RAS).

faqs.question: When do the Physical Standard and Endurance Tests (PST/PET) commence?
faqs.answer: PST/PET is scheduled to commence from 22 September 2026 onwards at designated centres in Leh and Kargil. Exact venue, date, and time will be communicated via downloadable admit cards on police.ladakh.gov.in.

overview: Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), District Commandant Office, Deoghar, has officially released employment advertisement notification No. 01/2026 inviting online applications for 772 vacancies for the enrollment of Home Guards (Grih Rakshak - ग्रामीण एवं शहरी गृह रक्षक) across Deoghar district. This recruitment drive offers 635 vacancies for Rural Home Guards across 10 blocks and 137 vacancies for Urban Home Guards across Deoghar and Madhupur municipal areas.

The 772 vacancies are strictly partitioned: 50% of all posts (386 vacancies) are reserved for female candidates (with a 5% horizontal sub-quota for divorced, deserted, and widowed women). For Urban Home Guards, 50% of vacancies are earmarked for technically skilled personnel (doctors, engineers, nurses, drivers, computer operators, electricians, plumbers, etc.) and 50% for non-technical candidates. Educational requirements are 7th class pass for Rural Home Guards and 10th (Matriculation) pass for Urban Home Guards, with age between 19 and 40 years as on 01 January 2026.

Eligible candidates who are permanent residents of the respective blocks (for Rural) or urban areas (for Urban) in Deoghar district must apply online through the official Jharkhand recruitment portal at https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in between 11 October 2026 and 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM). The application fee is ₹100 payable online. The selection comprises a multi-tier physical screening test (PET - 1-mile run, high jump, long jump, shot put), followed by a qualifying Hindi writing ability test (100 marks) and technical assessment (for technical candidates).

overview: Mysuru Mahanagara Palike (Mysore City Corporation, MCC), Administration Division, has officially released employment notification No. CEST (5) : CR : 03 : 2026-27 dated 08 September 2026 announcing a Special Direct Recruitment drive for 116 vacancies of UGD Helpers (Under Ground Drainage Helpers / ಯುಜಿಡಿ ಹೆಲ್ಪರ್ಸ್). This recruitment is being conducted pursuant to the Karnataka Municipal Corporations (Recruitment of UGD Helpers in City Corporations of the State) (Except Greater Bengaluru Authority) (Special) Recruitment Rules 2026 and Directorate of Municipal Administration (DMA) Revised Proceeding Order No. 1359725/DMA/EST/3/Others/53/2024 dated 24 August 2026.

This special recruitment is exclusively open to existing UGD Helpers currently working in Mysuru Mahanagara Palike under direct payment (ನೇರಪಾವತಿ), welfare (ಕ್ಷೇಮಾಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ), equal pay for equal work (ಸಮಾನ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾನ ವೇತನ), daily wage (ದಿನಗೂಲಿ), contract (ಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ), or outsourced (ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ) arrangements who have completed a minimum of 2 years of continuous service. Personnel engaged through Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) and Wet Well contract arrangements are strictly excluded from this drive. Candidates must know how to speak Kannada, possess valid ESI and Provident Fund (PF) contribution records remitted by the Corporation, and be aged between 18 and 55 years as on 08 September 2026.

Prescribed application forms must be collected free of cost from the Mysuru Mahanagara Palike Central Office, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru - 570004. Completed application forms along with 3 passport-size photographs, verified service certificates, and self-attested copies of all requisite documents must be submitted in person directly to the Chairman, Selection & Direct Recruitment Authority & Commissioner, Mysuru City Corporation on or before 09 October 2026 (5:30 PM). Applications sent by post or received after the deadline will not be accepted.

faqs.answer: Selected UGD Helpers will receive a pay scale of ₹27,000 to ₹46,675 per month, along with admissible allowances including DA, HRA, CCA, and statutory EPF/ESI coverage.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this Mysuru City Corporation UGD Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: This special recruitment is restricted to candidates who know how to speak Kannada and are currently working in Mysuru Mahanagara Palike as UGD Helpers under direct payment, welfare, equal pay for equal work, daily wage, contract, or outsourcing arrangements with at least 2 years of continuous service. Workers engaged under STP and Wet Well contracts are strictly excluded.

faqs.question: What is the prescribed age limit for Mysuru UGD Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and not exceed 55 years of age as on the official notification date (08 September 2026).

faqs.question: How is the selection made for UGD Helper posts in Mysuru City Corporation?
faqs.answer: Selection is made strictly based on the length of continuous service rendered in Mysuru City Corporation. Candidates with longer service receive top priority. If service duration is identical, the older candidate is selected. If both service and age are identical, selection is made via lottery. A 20% waitlist valid for 1 year will also be prepared.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for Mysuru UGD Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: No, there is no application fee (₹0). Application forms are distributed completely free of cost at the MCC Central Office and are not for commercial sale.

faqs.question: What is the last date to submit the application for MCC UGD Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form in person at the Mysuru City Corporation Head Office is 09 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faqs.question: Can I submit the application form by post or online?
faqs.answer: No. Applications must be submitted in person directly to the Office of the Commissioner & Chairman, Selection and Direct Recruitment Authority, Mysuru Mahanagara Palike, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru - 570004. Postal submissions or late submissions will not be entertained.

faqs.question: Are Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) or Wet Well workers eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: No. The official notification explicitly excludes UGD helpers working in Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) and Wet Wells from this special recruitment drive.

faqs.question: Where can I check official notices and updates regarding Mysuru UGD Helper recruitment?
faqs.answer: Official notifications, shortlists, and announcements are published on the official Mysuru City Corporation portal at http://www.mysurucity.mrc.gov.in/ and displayed on the MCC Central Office notice board.

overview: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), Bengaluru, on behalf of the Directorate of Municipal Administration (ಪೌರಾಡಳಿತ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನಾಲಯ), Government of Karnataka, has officially released Notification No. ED/KEA/46/Rect/2026(KK) dated 11 September 2026 inviting online applications for direct recruitment to 210 Group 'C' vacancies in Urban Local Bodies (City Municipal Councils, Town Municipal Councils, and Town Panchayats) under the Kalyana-Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka) local cadre under Article 371(J). The advertised posts comprise 80 vacancies of Water Supply Operator (ನೀರು ಸರಬರಾಜು ಆಪರೇಟರ್), 3 vacancies of Electrician Grade-1 (ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಿಷಿಯನ್ ಗ್ರೇಡ್-1), 122 vacancies of Assistant Water Supply Operator (ಸಹಾಯಕ ನೀರು ಸರಬರಾಜು ಆಪರೇಟರ್), and 5 vacancies of Electrician Grade-2 (ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಿಷಿಯನ್ ಗ್ರೇಡ್-2).

Candidates must have passed SSLC (10th Standard) or equivalent examination recognized by the Government of Karnataka. For Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-1, candidates must possess a 2-year ITI course certificate in Electrical or Fitter trade (National Trade Certificate - NTC) along with 1-year National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC). For Assistant Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-2, a 2-year ITI NTC in Electrical or Fitter trade is required (apprenticeship is not compulsory for Assistant/Grade-2 positions). The age limit is 18 to 40 years for General Merit (GM), 18 to 43 years for Categories 2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B, and 18 to 45 years for SC, ST, and Category-1, inclusive of the 5-year upper age relaxation sanctioned under Government Order No. DPAR 262 SeNeNi 2025 dated 29.01.2026.

Selection is made strictly through a competitive examination consisting of Paper-1 (General Knowledge - 100 Marks, 2 Hours) and Paper-2 (Specific Technical Subject - 100 Marks, 2 Hours) with negative marking of 0.25 marks per incorrect response and a mandatory 35% minimum qualifying threshold, preceded by a Compulsory Kannada Language Test (150 Marks, 50 marks to qualify, with standard exemptions for SSLC Kannada students). Selected appointees receive 7th State Pay Commission scale ranging from ₹34,100 – ₹67,600 (Assistant Operator & Electrician Gr-2) to ₹37,500 – ₹76,100 (Water Supply Operator & Electrician Gr-1) under the National Pension System (NPS). Eligible candidates can apply online at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ from 16 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 (fee payment up to 01 October 2026).

Click on 'Recruitment' and navigate to 'Directorate of Municipal Administration - Group C KK Cadre (Advt No. 46/2026)'.
Read the notification guidelines thoroughly and click on the 'Apply Online' registration link.
Enter basic demographic details, Aadhaar number, mobile number, and email ID to create login credentials.
Fill in educational qualifications (SSLC marks, ITI trade certificate details, NAC apprenticeship details if applicable).
Enter caste/category reservation details along with valid 15-digit Revenue Department (RD) certificate numbers.
Select Kalyana-Karnataka Article 371(J) reservation and furnish the Annexure-A certificate RD number.

Pay the prescribed application fee (₹750 for GM/OBC, ₹500 for SC/ST/Cat-1/ESM, ₹250 for PwD) online via Net Banking/Card/UPI before 01 October 2026.
Submit the final application form before 30 September 2026 and download the computer-generated acknowledgment copy for verification.

overview: Government of Karnataka, School Education Department (Department of Public Instruction) has officially notified 15,000 teaching posts across 35+ educational districts in Karnataka under the 'Karnataka Education Department Services (Department of Public Instruction) (Recruitment to Certain Teaching Posts) (Special) Rules, 2026' and 'Karnataka Education Department Services (Department of Public Instruction) (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2026'. These statutory rules and district-wise employment gazettes were officially published in the Karnataka State Gazette (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪತ್ರ - erajyapatra.karnataka.gov.in) between 10 August 2026 and 12 August 2026 for the 2026–27 academic recruitment cycle.

The 15,000 vacancies encompass Graduate Primary Teachers (GPT - Classes 6 to 8 for Mathematics & Science, Social Science, and Languages), Primary School Teachers (PST - Classes 1 to 5 General), Computer Science Teachers (Classes 1 to 8), Physical Education Teachers Grade-II (Classes 1 to 8), and High School Assistant Teachers Grade-1. The recruitment implements statutory quota allocations for Kalyana Karnataka Local Cadre (LC - Article 371J with 80% reservation in Hyderabad-Karnataka districts and 8% in statewide non-KK districts) and Residual Parent Cadre (RPC / NKK with 92% statewide and 20% in KK districts).

The online application submission deadline has been officially extended to 25 September 2026 (11:59 PM), with the application fee payment window open until 28 September 2026. Eligible candidates holding PUC/12th + D.El.Ed, Graduation + B.Ed with K-TET/CTET, or B.Sc/BCA in Computer Science can register online via https://schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in. Selection will be executed via a State-Level Competitive Written Examination followed by composite merit weightage (50% Competitive Exam, 20% TET, 20% Degree, and 10% Teacher Training).

faqs.question: What posts are included in this 15,000 Karnataka Teacher recruitment drive?
faqs.answer: The posts include Graduate Primary Teacher (GPT - Classes 6 to 8: 8,500 posts), Primary School Teacher - General (PST - Classes 1 to 5: 3,500 posts), Computer Science Teacher (Classes 1 to 8: 1,200 posts), Physical Education Teacher Grade-II (Classes 1 to 8: 1,000 posts), and High School Assistant Teacher Grade-1 (Classes 9 & 10: 800 posts).

faqs.question: What is the extended last date to apply online for Karnataka 15,000 Teacher recruitment?

faqs.question: Is K-TET or CTET mandatory to apply for Graduate Primary Teacher (GPT) and PST posts?

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Karnataka 15,000 Teacher recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years for General Merit (GM) candidates. Upper age relaxation of 3 years is available for Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B (up to 43 years), 5 years for SC, ST, Category-1 (up to 45 years), and 10 years for PwD/Ex-Servicemen (up to 50 years).

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary or pay scale for Graduate Primary Teachers in Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Selected Graduate Primary Teachers (GPT) and Computer Science Teachers receive a pay scale of ₹37,900 to ₹70,850 per month. Primary School Teachers (PST) and PET Grade-II receive ₹27,650 to ₹52,650 per month, plus DA, HRA, and medical allowances.

faqs.question: How are candidates selected for the 15,000 teacher posts in Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Selection is based on a composite merit formula: 50% weightage from the State Competitive Written Examination, 20% weightage from K-TET/CTET marks, 20% from Degree/Graduation marks, and 10% from B.Ed/D.El.Ed training marks, followed by 1:2 document verification.

faqs.question: What is the reservation quota for Kalyana Karnataka (Article 371J) candidates?

faqs.question: How much is the application fee for Karnataka Teacher recruitment?

overview: Government of Tamil Nadu, Health and Family Welfare Department, and National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN) / State Health Society (மாநில நலவாழ்வு சங்கம், தமிழ்நாடு) have officially released employment notification DIPR/802/DISPLAY/2026 inviting applications for 4,724 vacancies for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse (ஒப்பந்த / தற்காலிக செவிலியர்). These appointments are purely on a contract basis and temporary in nature under the respective District Health Societies (DHS).

The 4,724 recruited Staff Nurses will be deployed across state government healthcare facilities operating under four major directorates and local bodies: the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine (DPH), the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services (DMS), the Directorate of Medical Education & Research (DME&R), and the Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC). Eligible candidates must hold a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved private nursing college recognized by the Indian Nursing Council (INC), possess an active registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNC), and not exceed 50 years of age.

Prescribed application forms and district-wise vacancy matrices can be downloaded directly from the official NHM-TN portal at https://nhm.tn.gov.in. Duly filled-in applications accompanied by self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents must reach the Office of the Executive Secretary, District Health Office / Respective District Health Society on or before 25 September 2026 by 5:00 PM. Please note that this notification is not applicable to Tiruppur and Chengalpattu districts where the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) for elections is currently in force.

faqs.answer: A total of 4,724 vacancies have been announced for Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse (ஒப்பந்த / தற்காலிக செவிலியர்) under notification DIPR/802/DISPLAY/2026 across various District Health Societies in Tamil Nadu.

faqs.question: What is the last date to submit the application for NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse recruitment?
faqs.answer: The completed application form along with relevant document photocopies must reach the office of the Executive Secretary, District Health Office / Respective District Health Society on or before 25 September 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for NHM TN Staff Nurse?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have completed Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved private nursing college recognized by the Indian Nursing Council (INC), and must possess a valid, active registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNC).

faqs.question: What is the age limit for NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 50 years (50 வயது வரை) as on the notification date across all categories.

faqs.question: Which districts are excluded from this NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse notification?
faqs.answer: As stated in the official notification, this recruitment is NOT applicable to Tiruppur and Chengalpattu districts where the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) for elections is currently in force.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse recruitment?
faqs.answer: No. There is no application fee. The application process is completely free of charge for all candidates.

faqs.question: What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faqs.answer: The application mode is Offline. Candidates must download the application form from https://nhm.tn.gov.in, fill it out, attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, and submit it in person or by post to the Executive Secretary, District Health Office of the respective District Health Society.

faqs.question: Where will the appointed Staff Nurses be deployed?
faqs.answer: Selected Staff Nurses will be deployed in government health institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine (DPH), Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services (DMS), Directorate of Medical Education & Research (DME&R), and the Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC).

faqs.question: Is registration with Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must have a valid and active registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNC). Candidates from other states must transfer and register their credentials with TNC before applying.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse posts?
faqs.answer: Selection is conducted on the basis of academic merit in GNM / B.Sc. Nursing, Tamil Nadu communal reservation guidelines, weightage for relevant clinical experience, and original certificate verification by the District Health Society committee.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the application form and district-wise vacancy breakdown?
faqs.answer: Application forms and district-wise vacancy matrices are available for download on the official National Health Mission Tamil Nadu website: https://nhm.tn.gov.in.

overview: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada has released Brief Notification No. 07/2026 (dated 15 September 2026) for direct recruitment to 163 prestigious Group-I Services vacancies in the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

The 163 provisional vacancies span 13 executive cadres including Deputy Collector in A.P. Civil Service (11), Assistant Commissioner of State Tax (14), Deputy Superintendent of Police - Civil (36), DSP Communications (03), District Educational Officer (14), Divisional Development Officer in Panchayat Raj (35), Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies (15), Assistant Audit Officer (14), Municipal Commissioner Grade-II (12), and Regional Transport Officer (03).

Pay scales range from ₹54,060–₹1,40,540 up to ₹65,360–₹1,54,980 per month. The educational qualification is a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised university (B.E./B.Tech in ECE/Telecommunication for DSP Communications).

Online applications will be open on the official website (psc.ap.gov.in) from 06 October 2026 to 27 October 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). The selection process comprises an offline OMR-based Screening Test (240 marks), a descriptive Mains Written Examination (750 marks across 5 papers plus qualifying Telugu and English), and an Interview (75 marks) for a total evaluation of 825 marks.

appsc-inspector-assistant-recruitment-20.board: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada
overview: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada has released six official Brief Notifications (Notification Nos. 09/2026, 10/2026, 14/2026, 20/2026, 21/2026, and 22/2026, dated 15 September 2026) for direct recruitment to 255 provisional vacancies across various state services.

Major vacancies include Assistant Statistical Officer in A.P. Economics & Statistical Subordinate Service (196 posts), Analyst Grade-II in A.P. Pollution Control Board (18 posts), Assistant Director in Economics & Statistical Service (17 posts), Inspector of Factories (12 posts), English and Telugu Reporters in Legislature Services (11 posts), and Assistant Director in Tribal Welfare State Service (01 post).

Pay scales range from ₹37,640–₹1,15,500 (for ASO) up to ₹65,360–₹1,54,980 (for Inspector of Factories) per month. Qualifications range from Bachelor's Degrees in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Chemistry, and Engineering to Master's Degrees for Assistant Director positions.

Online applications will be received through the Commission's official web portal (psc.ap.gov.in) from 13 October 2026 until 02 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). A Detailed Notification carrying full reservation breakups and examination guidelines will be released on or before 13 October 2026.

overview: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada has released eight official Brief Notifications (Notification Nos. 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, 23, and 24 of 2026, dated 15 September 2026) for direct recruitment to a total of 299 provisional vacancies across eight subordinate services of the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

The posts include Executive Officer Grade-III (104), Industrial Promotion Officer (78), Supervisor Grade-I (29, exclusively for women), Forest Section Officer (26), Forest Beat Officer (23), Draughtsman Grade-II / Technical Assistant (20), District Probation Officer Grade-II / Intake Probation Officer (15), and Forest Range Officer (04).

Pay scales range from ₹25,220–₹80,910 up to ₹54,060–₹1,40,540 per month. The minimum educational qualification ranges from ITI Draughtsman certificate and Intermediate pass (for Forest Beat Officer) to Bachelor's and Master's degrees in designated disciplines.

Online applications will be accepted at the official portal (psc.ap.gov.in) from 16 October 2026 to 05 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). A Detailed Notification covering reservation breakups and syllabus will be published on or before 16 October 2026.

I (Electrical - 7, Civil - 1), Engineering Assistant (Electrical - 10, Mechanical - 1), Scientific Assistant (Chemistry - 2), Technician Gr. Chemistry, Bachelor Degrees, or B.E./B.Tech Engineering degrees are eligible to apply. Detailed eligibility criteria, syllabi, exam schemes, and the online registration portal link are being activated on the official CPRI career portal (https://cpri.res.in/en/career).

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for Mizoram Public Service Commission Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been officially announced for Peon under Mizoram Public Service Commission Recruitment 2026.

faqs.question: What is the official Advertisement Number for this Mizoram Public Service Commission recruitment drive?

faqs.question: What educational qualification is required to apply for Peon in Mizoram Public Service Commission?

faqs.question: What is the prescribed age limit for Mizoram Public Service Commission Peon posts?
faqs.answer: The prescribed age limit is Min: 18 years, Max: 35 years. Standard age relaxations apply for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen as per government norms.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary or pay scale offered for Peon in Mizoram Public Service Commission?

faqs.question: What is the mode of application for Mizoram Public Service Commission Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The application mode is Apply Online. Candidates should follow the official submission guidelines carefully.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply or interview date for Mizoram Public Service Commission Peon?
faqs.answer: The last date for application submission or scheduled event date is 13 October 2026.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for Mizoram Public Service Commission Peon recruitment?
faqs.answer: The selection process involves initial scrutiny of qualifications, shortlisting, personal interview / skill assessment / written test, and document verification.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted for this Mizoram Public Service Commission vacancy?
faqs.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Mizoram or designated project sites/campuses under Mizoram Public Service Commission.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for Mizoram Public Service Commission Peon Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Application fee details are specified in the official notification. Reserved categories and female applicants are generally exempt or entitled to concessions.

faqs.question: Are candidates in their final year/semester eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess the requisite degree and final mark sheet on or before the crucial closing date specified in the notification.

faqs.question: Is age relaxation applicable for reserved category applicants?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard age relaxations (5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and 10+ years for PwBD) are applicable as per Central/State Government rules.

faqs.question: What documents are required during interview and verification?
faqs.answer: Candidates must carry 10th certificate for DOB proof, degree certificates, all semester mark sheets, caste certificate, experience certificates, photo ID proof, and self-attested photocopies.

faqs.question: Can candidates currently employed in Government/PSU apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates working in Central/State Government or PSUs can apply provided they produce a 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.

faqs.question: How can I download the official notification PDF for Mizoram Public Service Commission Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the official link: https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is this a permanent post or contractual engagement in Mizoram Public Service Commission?
faqs.answer: Please refer to the official advertisement (No.A.12026/33/2026-MPSC(PRE)) for the precise tenure and engagement terms (regular/contractual/project-basis) for Peon.

faqs.question: Where can I check updates regarding admit cards, interview schedules, or results for Mizoram Public Service Commission?

faqs.question: Can candidates from all states and UTs in India apply for Mizoram Public Service Commission vacancies?
faqs.answer: Yes, Indian citizens fulfilling the required educational qualification, age limit, and language proficiency criteria are eligible to apply.

overview: Office of the District Basic Education Officer (BSA), Gorakhpur has published an official notification (Letter No. SSA/BASHI/6585-92/2026-27) inviting offline applications from eligible female candidates for contractual engagement in 20 Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBVs) across District Gorakhpur.
A total of 132 vacancies have been advertised across two school levels: 48 posts in Class 06–08 KGBVs and 84 posts in Upgraded Class 09–12 KGBVs.

Available posts include Principal, PGT Teachers (Hindi, English, Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science), Full-Time Teachers (Maths, Science, Hindi, English, Social Science), Part-Time Teachers (Computer, Art/Craft/Music), Accountant, Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Watchman/Guard.

All advertised positions are strictly reserved for female candidates only. Selection for teaching and administrative roles will be based on academic merit (Quality Points), while Class-IV staff will be selected through practical assessment and screening by the District Selection Committee.

uksssc-pa-recruitment-2026.title: UKSSSC Personal Assistant & Stenographer Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 101 Group C Posts
overview: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC / उत्तराखण्ड अधीनस्थ सेवा चयन आयोग) has released an official detailed notification (Advertisement No. 81/UKSSSC/2026, dated 08 September 2026) for direct recruitment to 101 Group 'C' (समूह 'ग') vacancies.

The advertised posts include Personal Assistant (वैयक्तिक सहायक), Stenographer (आशुलिपिक), Stenographer Grade-3 (आशुलिपिक ग्रेड-3), and Stenographer Grade-2 across key state departments, judicial bodies, and public corporations including Commercial Tax Tribunal, Industrial Tribunal, Forest Development Corporation, UJALA, PTCUL, BRIDCUL, and Housing Development Authorities.

Pay levels range from Level-04 (₹25,500 – ₹81,100) up to Level-07 (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400) under the 7th CPC. The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (10+2) or Graduation (for PTCUL) with Hindi shorthand speed of 80 WPM and Hindi typing speed of 4,000 Key Depressions Per Hour (KDPH).

Eligible candidates can submit online applications through the official portal (ukssscrecruitment.in or sssc.uk.gov.in) from 14 September 2026 to 14 October 2026. The tentative offline OMR-based written competitive examination is scheduled for 20 December 2026.

uksssc-pa-recruitment-2026.howToPayFee: The application fee must be deposited online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI gateway integrated into the UKSSSC online portal before the final application cutoff date.
selectionProcess: Stage 1: Offline Objective Written Competitive Examination (100 Marks, 100 MCQs, 2 Hours duration, OMR sheet based) covering relevant post qualification subjects.
Marking Scheme: 1 mark awarded for every correct answer; 0.25 (1/4th) mark deducted for each incorrect answer. Minimum qualifying marks: UR/OBC/EWS: 45%, SC/ST: 35%.
Stage 2: Shorthand & Computer Typing Skill Test (Qualifying nature). Candidates equal to 4 times the vacancies (1:4 ratio) will be shortlisted on the basis of written exam merit.
Skill Test Benchmarks: Hindi Shorthand speed of 80 WPM and Computer Hindi Typing speed of 4,000 KDPH (plus English steno/typing for specific posts).
Stage 3: Document Verification (अभिलेख सत्यापन) of original academic degrees, computer certifications, category/domicile certificates, and employment exchange registration.
Stage 4: Final Merit List publication and department-wise allotment based on cumulative merit score and candidate preference.
howToApply: Visit the official UKSSSC recruitment portal at https://ukssscrecruitment.in/ or click the application link on www.sssc.uk.gov.in.
Click on 'New Registration' and sign up using your Aadhaar number, valid active mobile number, and personal email ID.
Fill in all required profile details, including personal information, correspondence address, Uttarakhand domicile status, category, and educational qualifications.
Ensure your registration with any Employment Exchange in Uttarakhand is active as of 14 October 2026 (unless holding Uttarakhand permanent domicile).
Upload scanned copies of recent color photograph (150w x 200h px, JPG), signature (150w x 100h px, JPG), and left-hand thumb impression (150w x 100h px, JPG).
Pay the prescribed online application fee using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Review the application preview carefully and submit the form before 14 October 2026. Correction facility will be available from 17 to 19 October 2026.
Download and print the completed application confirmation page for verification during counseling and skill test.
howToApplySteps: Step 1: Go to ukssscrecruitment.in and complete Aadhaar-based candidate registration.
Step 2: Enter personal details, address, employment exchange registration, and educational scores.
Step 3: Upload photograph, signature, and left thumb impression in JPG format.
Step 4: Remit online application fee (₹300 for UR/OBC, ₹150 for SC/ST/EWS/PwBD).
Step 5: Verify all entered details and click 'Submit'.
Step 6: Print out the final application receipt for future records.

importantInstructions: Registration in an Employment Exchange in Uttarakhand is mandatory on or before the last date of application (14 October 2026) for candidates not holding permanent domicile.
Reserved category benefits are strictly restricted to permanent residents/domiciles of Uttarakhand State.
Only 1 application should be submitted by an applicant. Multiple submissions will lead to rejection.
Negative marking of 0.25 marks is applicable for every wrong answer in the offline OMR-based written test.
Use of whitener, scratching, or cutting on the OMR answer sheet is strictly prohibited and results in automatic negative marking / disqualification.
Candidates shortlisted at 1:4 ratio must qualify the mandatory shorthand and typing test on computer to be eligible for final recommendation.
